titleStmt.author: Vatsarāja

text.body:
kirātārjunīyavyāyogaḥ sā pātu vastryambakacumbitāyāḥ kapolapālī ciramambikāyāḥ | pragalbharomāñcabhareṇa yasyāḥ puṣpāyudho'bhūtkṣaṇamaṅkarāstraḥ|| 1 || (nāndyante) sūtradhāraḥ -- kaḥ ko'tra bhoḥ? | (praviśya) sthāpakaḥ -- bhāva kimucyate? | māheśvaro'si, tadapi māheśānyeva nāndīpadāni ghorarasānuviddhānyaparāṇi paṭhatu bhāvaḥ | sūtra -- (vihasya) mārṣa! kimetat? | sthāpaka -- paṭhatu tāvadbhādhaḥ | sūtra -- yenottambhitadrarbhadāndhatanucchatrasya daṇḍāyitaṃ yatprāpyāyudhamaṅganā'pi danujadhvaṃsaṃ cakārā'mbikā | yaḍṛṣṭvaiva ghiḍaujaso likhitavaddambholirāsītkaraṃ candrārddhabharaṇasya tadbhagavataḥ śūlaṃ śivāyāstu vaḥ || 2 || tadidānīṃ kathaya kimetat? | sthāpakaḥ -- bhāva! vīrasaikavāsanāvāsito'paṃ kālañjarādhipatistrailokyavarmadevaḥ kavivatmasarājaviracitaṃ kirātārjunīyaṃ nāma vyāyogamabhinetumādiśati | tena mayā vīrarasātmakānyaparāṇi catvāri nāndīpadāni paṭhitāni sūtra -- (sadarpam) yujyate | śayāmā sadaṅgasubhagā karapaṅkajāgradurlālanā viharamāṇamanojñakāmyā | trailokyavarmanṛpatermanasi pramodamāviṣkaroti karavālalatā, na kāntā ||3|| (vicintya sollāsam) kaveḥ kavitvaṃ paṭutā naṭānāṃ bhagrgārjunīyaṃ caritaṃ pavitram | tadaihikāmuṣmikasaukhyahetudaitto niyogo'dya nareśvareṇa || 4 || mārpa! kā punarabhinayavelā nisrūpitā'sti? | sthāpakaḥ -- bhāva l nanvayameva sūv𳆫hāv̱ābhirāmaḥ śayāmārambhasamayaḥ | atra hi candro'rjunaḥ samadhikṛtya purandarāśāmāsādayaṭudayahetumasau girīśam | unmudrayannacirameva jagatpramodamāviṣpkariṣpyati vipakṣatamaḥpraṇāśam || 5 || (neparyaye) sādhu śaitchṭrapaśiromaṇe! sādhu || gṛhīoteyaṃ sadupaśrutibhaivatu phalaśālinī | sūtra -- (samākarṇya saharpay) mārpa! himavati tapasyato'rjunasya ddhaipāyanopanīto'yamanucaraḥsiddhādeśovyāharati||tadehyāvāmanantarakaraṇīyaṃ sampādayāva || (iti nipkrāntaiau) prastacanna | (tataḥ praviśatyarjunaḥ siddhādeśaśca) siddhdrādeśaḥ -- āyupman! kiṃ punaḥ samagrasamīhitasiddhisāmagrīsambhave'pi vimanā iva vibhāvpasai? | arjunaḥ -- (sakodhāhaṅkāram) ka me vaimanasyopaśāntiḥ! | apārthaḥ pārtho'haṃ dhanuradhimuṇaṃ nirmuṇamidaṃ visārā ete'pi prasaraṇaparāḥ samprati śarāḥ | na yāvanno rājā samarabhuvi kauravyabalavatkabandhānāṃ nṛtyairanubhavati netrotsavasukham || 6 || siddhā -- āyuṣman | kimevaṃ khidhate bhavān? | indrajālapurupā iva ddaśyamānā apyavighamānā eva tava śatravaḥ | idānīmapi gharmātmaja eva rājā | tathāhi tadvairiṇāṃ yamasamāgamahetu rājyaṃ yuṣmākameva sutarāṃ prakaṭopayogam | satkṣatriyocitadurodarasampradattaṃ gharmātmajaḥkeimu na pupyati tena dhamaim ||7|| api ca | viśadakodaṇḍavedavidyāvidagdhasya vāsudevadvitīyātmano bhavataḥ kaṭutaratapaḥkleśasahanasāhasamapi nocitaṃ manye | arjunaḥ -- sakhe siddhādeśa! guru̱nideśuvśaṃvadvere̱'haṃ tapasi praṣṭṛttaḥ || māṃ punansgha eva munijanasamācāraḥ samutkaṇṭhayati | ākarṇayatu bhavān krūrārātikṛtāvadhivyatikaraśyāmāvakāśe gate dordaṇḍodayaśailaśālini mahāśauryāryamaprodgame | kroghagniṃ pratibodhya durmadabhaṭastomāṅgavallīsamiddhomapremaparāyaṇo munirahaṃ bhūyāsamityarthaye || 8 || api ca cetaḥ parākramamapaṃ paṭimā''yughepu prauḍhau bhujau bhujabhṛtāmayameva panthāḥ | astraprayīgaparikarmaṇi mantrayogaṃ vrīḍākaraṃ tamapi kārmaṇameva manye || 9 || siddhā -- (puro'valokya saharṣam) mahābhāga! dipṭayā varddhase | phalitameca tava tapaḥ | paśya paśya bhānorvibhāṃ rūkṣatamāṃ manojñaiḥ pratyantaratnairavamānayantī | himācalaṃ kāñcanaśailayantīo tvāṃ vyomato'bhyeti vimānamālā || 10 || arjunaḥ -- (sopahāsam) a̱ho rabhusaḥ priyavapasyasya| itthaṃ kila samaramanorathapūraṇonmukhepu pratyarthirathepu locanapathāvatīrṇepu paraṃ paritupyate | siddhā -- upahasatu mahābhāgaḥ | ahaṃ punarjāne duścaratapaścaraṇameduritapuṇyarāśīneva ghṛtācīrambhātilottamorvaśīpramukhasurāṅganāvimānānyupasarpanti | arjunaḥ -- (sāvajñaṃ vihasya) kiṃ māṃ lobhayati vayaspaḥ? | māṃ vā ripuṃ vā yudhi dīrghasupsametāḥ samepyanti yadā grahītum | vimānayānaṃ surakhandarīṇāṃ ddaṣṭvā tadā'haṃ bhavitā hṭapṭaḥ || 11 || (nepayye) lāaṇṇalaharipihidaṃ ageṃ taṇuattaṇaṃ vahantassa | jamaṇiyamadūmidassavi picchaha cagattaṇaṃ muṇiṇo || 12 || 1 lāvaṣyalaharīpihittamaṅge tanutvaṃ caddataḥ | yamaniyamadūtasyāpi paśyata ghaṅgatvaṃ muneḥ || 12 || arjunaḥ (ākarṇya) kathaṃ nikaṭāvattaraṇāni vyomato vimānāni! | (sakhedam) aho me saṃsoḍhabāhyaripuparābhavaspa duḥsahaśārīraripoḥ kusṛmāyudhasya sarvaṅkapo duṣpratīkāraḥ parābhavaḥ samupasthito'yam | etāhyapsarasaḥ kusumāyudhasya mahāyudham | (savitarkam) pṛpatkavyāpāraḥ prabhavati purandhrīpu katamaḥ prayukttaḥ śāpagniḥ kraśapati tapaḥkośanicayam | tadetāḥ pratyagrasmararasamahānāṭakanaṭīniṃrākarttu śaktto bhavati ka upāyaḥ suravadhūḥ || 12 || tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) sakhe siddhādeśa! śaśāṅkaśekharaprasādaphalatapaḥ parāyaṇaspa na yujyate surasundarīdarśanam | tadihoparipṭādipupaṭalamapaṃ vitānaṃ vitanomi (iti tathā karoti) siddhā -- (samantādavalokya sāścaryam) mahābhāga savyasācin! bahuśo'nubhūtāni mayā dhanadasadane mahānidhānāni | ananubhūtamidaṃ baṭunighānuṃṃ dhūmurnidhānaṃ mayā | nahyekadhanupā dvibhujena parimitaśareṇa dhanvinā karmaitadvighīyata | (nepathye) kiṃ pātālamagādvihaṅgamapatistatrnāsavitrāsitāḥ protsarpanti sarīsṛpāḥ parilasanniśvāsaśavdormayaḥ | svairī kinnu divāpi nṛtyati śivastanmauligaṅgājalavyāviddhasya lalāṭanetraśikhino dhūmaiḥ kimujṛmbhitam || 13 || (punarnepathye) āḥ ko'yaṃ kutarkaḥ! | nanu vyaktameva lolanti nārācamālāḥ, vyāvarttanta vi̱mānāni̱ | mā kadā𳇊na māpāmapamahāsurasannipāto'paṃ bhaviṣpati | tadidṛdānīmapathyameva munijanopasarpaṇamapsarasām | purandarānusaraṇameva śaraṇam | sa evaitadadbhutānurūpaṃ yatkiñcitkaripyate | siddhā -- (vibhāvya) partha! nivarttitānyeva vimānāni pākaśāsanasaciyaiḥ | arjunaḥ -- (svagarta saharpam.) dipṭyā śarācchādanavibhīpikayopaśāntaḥ pratyūhabhūto'psaraḥsamāgamaḥ | tapaḥsāghanatapanavimvadarśanāya dhṛtaṃ ca chidramekam | siddhā -- (sākṣcaryam) aho tava hastalāghavam! | paśya! aviralaśarajālaiśchamanyaunyalagnairdinaparivṛḍhavimvavyakttaye kṛptarandhram | upari caturacaurairdattasandhiprakāraṃ sadanamivavikṣvametadvibhāti || 14 || arjunaḥ -- sakhe siddhādeśa | samadiśa tau nijakirātau yatheha na kakṣcidavijñātaḥ samāpatati | siddhā (nepathyāmimukhamavalovaya) sakhe śārdūla! sakhe kaṇṭhīrava! | ubhau -- (praviśya) āṇavedu mahābhāo | siddhā -- bhadrau | tiṣṭhatamavahitau bhavantau parataḥ | mā kakṣcidihāviditaḥ samāpatatu | kirātau -- haṃdo vi a sasaṇeṇa samagamissadi | (niṣtramya punaḥ praviśya) ajva! mahāmuṇī kovi muṇijualajutto samedi | arjunaḥ -- (sādaram) samāgacchatu mahartiḥ | kirātau jahā āṇavedi sāmī | (iti nittrkāmataḥ) (tataḥ praviśāti yayānirdiṣṭo muniveṣo mahendraḥ) mahendraḥ -- (….. … …) …. ……. saṃdarśanam | (sānutāpam) vañcitāni paraṃ mayā vepāntaratirohitānītaravilocanāni | (sakarūṇam) athavā sādhu saṃvṛttam | sūnorvatrkasarojadarśanasudhāsvādena darīkṛtairapyakṣṇāṃ nicayairmamāgha vijitaṃ taireca guptātmabhiḥ | yaireyaṃyighamasya dāsuṇadaśādattograduḥkhodgamaṃ dṛṣdvā niḥsaradupṇavāppasalilairlaibhe na dāhodayaḥ || 15 || arjunaḥ -- (munivepaṃ mahendramāṭīkya saharṣam) sakhe siddhādeśa! aho mahānuvatā mahāmuneḥ | svīkaro̱ti karuṇāmayamṛrttimamayaṃ sapadi̱ yate̱'pi sunīndraḥ | apyaho paricpayakramaghāpye snihyatīha pitarīova mamātmā || 16 || tadeṣyabhyuttiṣṭhāva | (iti yayāvadṛmyutthāya) dhaipāghrapadyagoghro madhpamapāṇṣṭayo'bhiyādayate bhayantam | mahendraḥ -- abhilapintabhājanaṃ bhūpāḥ | siddhā -- (āptanamupanīpa)alaṅkiyanāmāsanam | (sarve yayocitamupapiśanni) mahendraḥ -- mahābhāga! tyadepadolāyito na jāne kapā'bhyupapattyā bhavantamupacarami | tadhāhi abhyasnāḥ śrutayo mahāssṛtipaye kṣupaṇaṃ madopaṃ mano dṛpṭāste'pi maharpapaḥ paricniāste te parivrājakāḥ | māpyāloki purandarasya paripannādarśiī nāśrāyei yā phodaṇṭepudhiyalkalākṣavalayālaṅkāramirtya tapaḥ || 17 || sadidaṃ yvpāharāmiyaghetāṃ caturanyurāśiparikhāmuyī yumukṣurbhayāṃstayāpo'yamupāsyanāṃ kraśapami prāṇaṃ tapobhirmṛpā | mukttau makttirathāsti te parihara krṛrāmimāṃ prakripāṃ marpagraiya yinidramauṣṭadaramrme manpehi śuddhaṃ manaḥ || 18 || arjunaḥ -- (mageī darpamuñṇaṃ ga neiḥdhamya) ayidinapṛttāntasnāto māmerya ppāharavi | bhuphirbhamgaprapāle gṛnabhapaṭaśanaiḥ maṃṣṭanā yairipagaiḥ rājñā pāśena paṭaḥ kayamipa nṛpaneḥ prāpnuyāṃ mukttimaumyan | tanme klainpai kapṛśerdelapani hadapaṃ bhukimukayoḥ kathā'pi prārambhośpaṃ guruṇāṃ padahamiha tapāsaṃpighāne nipuktta || 19 || mahendraḥ -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) kathaṃ māṃ tāteti vatso vyājahāra | na khalvanena tapaḥsamudbhūlātīndriyajñānenavidito'smi | bhavatvahamapi sandigghenaiva vyāharāmi (prakāśam)vatsa! kiṃmadyāpi te mohamalīmsaṃ mānasam | muñcamuñcaduradhyavasāyam | paśya paśya na khalu tvadanahatairvairibhirna martavyam | na ca tvayā nihatavairiṇā na marttavyam | nahi kavalitamūyikeṇa viḍālena na mriyate | na ca vañcitaviḍālakavalanāpāyairmūpakairna triyate ' tadevaṃ sādhāraṇakṛnāntavyāpadāmupahasanīyo'yaṃ durvyāpāraḥ | tadatrabhavate mahodaya eva svadatām | arjunaḥ -- (sānutāpam) tāta! ananubhūtaparābhavābhipaṅgo'si | kimucyate? | tadatrabhavantaṃ viśapapāmi | anatikramaṇīyavacano'si | naivaṃ punaḥ punarvyāhara | utkṛtyūāyasasūāyakena samare darpoddhatānvidvipastadrimvaṃ divaseśvarasya saddassū bhittvātmanā patriṇā | mukttiryā samavāpyate bhavatu naḥ saiva pramodāspadaṃ karmajñānasamuñcayopajanitāṃ dvare namasyāmi tām || 20 || mahendraḥ -- (svagataṃ saharpam) aho! vīrarasaikagrahilatā vatsasya | aho! sthiravairatā | dipṭhavā nippannameva bhuvo bhārāvataraṇam | tathāhi murārimārutaphīto ghanastrayaghanañjayaḥ | gurūnapi dvipadvaṃśānaśepānepa dhakṣyati || 21 || tadahamidānīṃ prakaṭībhavāmi samāśvāsanāya vatsasya | (iti tayā karoti) arjunaḥ -- (vilokya sāśvarya sahūrpam) kathamayaṃ sahastranapano nayanotsavāya saṃvṛttaḥ | tadidānīṃ saviśepaṃ praṇamāmi | (ityupamṛtya padayoḥ panati) mahendraḥ -- (utthāpya śirasi samāghrāya) vatsa | astrākṣīccaturānanaḥ sa bhagavānpatpūrvamambhaḥ kramāddevo dānavasṛdanaḥ pratikalaṃ yalpālayāñcakrivān | tadviśvaṃ sahasaiya tau ca dalayankalpāntakāloddhatavyāpāraḥ parameśvaraḥ praharatu prasyarthinastāghaphān || 22 || arjunaḥ -- (saprakṣrayam) bhagavan! gīrvāṇavargacakravarttino'trabhayato bhagavati bharge'pi nideśa evāyaṃ na punarāśoḥ | mahendraḥ -- vatsa! vatsa!| maivam | yatprāptuṃ taralībhavatpatha mano vyāvartate vrīḍapā yasyopāyanirūpaṇe nayavidāṃ mandāyate naipuṇam | te'pi vrahjanārdunambhrutayo nyañcanti yatprārthitāstānnetrāñcalalīlayaiva ghaṭayatyekaḥ paraṃ śaṅkaraḥ || 23 || siṣdrā -- bhagavan sahasrākṣa! bhavanaḥ sākṣātkāreṇaiva pūrṇamanorathaḥ pārthaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | tathāhi kathamandhavalātteṣāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ bhavedbhayam | sahasranayanaḥ pakṣe yepāmujcāgaraḥ sadā || 24 || mahendraḥ -- ayi dyuhyakottama! maivam | aikyaṃ gataḥ kṣrīpurupottamena kṛtvāndhakoddāmavalapraṇāśam | śivaprasādena śivānubhāvaḥpṛthāsuto'yaṃ bhavitā suśakttiḥ || 25 || tadāpṛcchatu māṃ vatsaḥ | arjunaḥ -- (sakaruṇapraśrayam) tāta puruhṛta! premārdranetrotpalakānanāḍhayaṃ tvatkayakāsāramimaṃ vimoktum | durvṛttadāyādanidāghataptaḥ samīhate bhe na manomarālaḥ || 26 || mahendraḥ -- vatsa! vatsa! mā vipīda | prasāditacandraśekharaṃ candraśekharāstranirastāśepakauravyaṃ punastvāmahaṃ drakṣyāmi | (iti tiroghatte) arjunaḥ -- sakhe siddhādeśa! ehi bhagavartīṃ bhāgīrathīmupāsya bhagavantaṃ bhargamupāsmahe | (nepathye) atyāhitamatyāhitam | kurvanghargharamārapaṃ pṛthurado ghoṇāṃ samutaphullayannaṅghāsaṅghamivoccakaisnanurusnomaṃ dadhatpīvaram | gaṅgātīratapasvivaiśāsarasavyāsakttacitto javātkroḍo'yaṃ kalitaḥ kudhā kaliriva krūrāśayo dhāvati || 27 || kuddālīyati sāndrakandapaṭale vāḍhaṃ kuṭhārīyati skandhāgrepu paraśvadhīyati śikhāśākhāsu sampātinī | rdapṭreyaṃ vikaṭā kiṭeḥ pratipadaṃ mārgadrumadroṇipu kūrakrūraparākramapraṇayinī kiṃ kiṃ na sampadyate || 28 || arjunaḥ -- (saptambhrarma vivṛtyāvalokya) kathamayaṃ kṛtakarṇakāpaḥ kaṭuḥ kolāhala eva kṣrūyate? | na ko'pi locanapathamavatarati | siddhā -- kka punastau kirātau? | na khalu vyāpāditau | (pravidaya) kiratau -- mahābhāā! parittāadha parittāadha | eso khu paaṃḍatuṃḍābhihadavialantavisālantajālanivaḍantasavaravarasarīravisamīkaamaggo ruhirohapiṃjaridadāḍhājuo dārantovva saalabhuaṇāiṃ ghoraghurukkārehiṃ bhīsaṇo koci bhūārarūo avamiccū paviṭṭo | arjunaḥ -- (sāvataṃ vihasya) bhadrau! na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyam | siddhā -- mahābhāga gāṇḍīvadhanvan! sujjībhava sajjībhbhaca | ayamāgata eva netrapātratāṃ potrī | arjunaḥ -- (dhīraṃ vilokya sāścarye savitarkam) vikrānto vahirambhasastaraladhīrdapṭrāmipādavjinīkandacchedasṛkhaḥ kimepa salilastamveramasyārbhakaḥ | saṃhāre'pi nijaprasakttipaṭutāṃ saṃdarśayannutkaṭāṃ sākṣādādivarāha eva kimayaṃ prāguhṛtakṣmātalaḥ || 29 || (nepathye) kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ śiāvasevaikanāne tapasi pravṛtto'pi kathamayaṃ vikaṭakaṭukoṭikiṃṭidaṃṣṭrābhighātamāpadyate munīndraḥ | āḥ śaṅkara! paritrāyasva paritrāyasva | kimudāsīno'si, kimiti svenaiva svanāma proyrghñchasi? | arjunaḥ -- (śrutvā sakaruṇamākāśe lakṣyaṃ vaddhavā niḥśvasya) pārthastapasvitāṃ lebhe durdaiva! prīyatāṃ bhavān | munayo hanta śaṅkante bhūdārāddāruṇaṃ mayi || 30 || (punarnepathye) ayi munīśvara! sevyaḥ paraṃ sa bhagavānnavacandracūḍastasyāpi'daivavaśataḥ karuṇānuroghaḥ | asminvane munijanavyasanopaśāntyai kodaṇḍapāṇirayameva haraḥkirātaḥ || 31|| tadayamevābhyarthya munerasya prāṇatrāṇāya niyujyatām | arjunaḥ -- (samākarṇya) ahaha! idamanyadatidāruṇataramupasthitaṃ yanmāṃ kirātaḥ paritrāpate | siddhā pārtha! tvameva prathamaṃ sapatrākuru potriṇam | arjunaḥ -- (gāṇḍīvamuhiśya sakaruṇaṃ sāstram) yattāṇḍavavyatikareṇa raṇe muharttaṃ tāddakkavanghaśatatāṇḍavakelirāsīt | gāṇḍīva! tasya bhavataḥ kiṭipāṭanārthamāropayannapi guṇaṃ vyaparopayāmi || 32 || (iti satrtraṃ karoti | nipaṅgato vāṇākarpaṇamabhinayan) kathaṃ na nirgacchanti vāṇāḥ? | kimamī ciravyāsaṅgagāḍhalagrā, uta lajjante 'nucitakarmaṇi? | (kapaṃcidākṛpya niḥśvasya) ayi vāṇāḥ | upituṃ sādhu yupmābhirnipaṅgāyāmavāṅbhukhaiḥ | idānīṃ hanta! sandhatte pārtho vaḥ potripātane || 33 || (iti sanghatte) (nepathye) mahābhāā! imāo mā bhāaha mā bhāaha | eso khu amha sāmī ekkavāṇeṇa cāredi duṭṭabhūāāraṃ | uvvarido mahāmuṇī | arjunaḥ -- (śrutvā sasambhramam) kathamayaṃ mattaḥ kirāto'graṇīrbhaviṣyati? | (iti kṛtavego bāṇamokṣaṃ nādayatei) siddhā -- (vimānya sāścaryam)mahābhāga! paścādbhūtaste bāṇaḥ | paśya! paśaya! spṛṣṭaḥ kasyāpi ddapṭayā nahi nahi viharatyantare kuṇṭhavego marmacchedapravṛttairanumitapatanastāracītkārabhāraiḥ | kasyāpyākasmiko'yaṃ layasamayamahāmārutasyeva pūro nārācaḥ**'drāgatanutanukuṭīṃ caṇḍaśakttirbhanaktti || 34 || arjunaḥ -- (savailakṣyam)'kathaṃ vijapino'pi mamāyamavijayeivāṇatāṃ vāṇaḥ prapede yatkirātaśareṇāpātite potriṇi papāta? | bhavatu na yācaditaraḥ ko'pi lakṣayati, tāvadātmavāṇgapmānayāmi | (ityupamṛtya bhūdāraṃ vibhāvya sāścaryam) ahaha! na mayāpi kadāpi evaṃvidhaviśālakāyaḥ kolo'valokinastatkimepa māyāmayaḥ ko'pi kauravānugrahagrahila, utāho svairāhāravihārapuṣṭo varāha eva | bhavatvādadāmi tāvannijavāṇam | (iti tayā karoti) sidhdā -- (nirūpya) mahābhāga! ghātarandhramevāspāṅge dvitīyamavalokapāmi | tatkāraprṇa tatpratyabhijñāya gṛhāṇātmaghāṇam | kadācitprahāradāḍharvādulcaṇobhapapāśvaikṛtarandho bhavadvāṇa eva nirgatya ghacidgato bhavet | arjunaḥ -- siddhādeśa | ayameva me vāṇo, na dvikatthano mithyā vyāharipyāmi | siddhā -- naiya tarhi kirātamātraṃ, mahānayaṃ ko'pi ,yasya patrī potrī kutra gata iti na jñāyate | arjunaḥ -- '(savitarkam) na khalu nijavāṇaṃ gṛhītvā kirāto gato bhavet | siddhā -- pratipālaya tarhi muharttam | kimiha ko'pyāghāvatei | purupaḥ -- (praviśya pṛro'valokya)kaghaṃ esa so muṇī!|(sasambhramupasṛtya)ayi muṇiṃda! ṇa tumaṃ ediṇā duṭṭabhnūāreṇa kirādavāhiṇīsavāṇaghāaveñaṇāmohakaarjhapeṇa kahiṃpi pīḍaido | (arjunaḥ sāvajñaṃ sasmitamavalokate) kaṇṭhīravaḥ -- (sākṣepam) re re gomāuā! kosa aṇucidaṃ mantesi | ṇaṃ suṇiṃdeṇaṃ yeva sammuhamupasappanto esa duṭṭakolo vāvādido | kiṇṇa pekkhasi lohialittaṃ hatthe saraṃ | gomāyukaḥ -- (svagatam) ancchariyaṃ! acchariyaṃ! | auvvo kovi esa koaṃḍamaṃḍido muṇī | (prakāśaṃ sapratyabhijñamiva) ayi vīramuṇiṃda! so amha sāmiṇo saro | arjunaḥ -- sakhe siddhādeśa! kaṣṭaṃ kapṭam | patrī madīyo vidhivaiparītyātkrūraṃ kalaṅkaddhayamadya lebhe | vghāpārito patkiṭikīṭaghāte bhameti ghaccāha hahā! kirātaḥ || 35 || gomā -- mupiāvīra! taṇuladāe taṇuattaṇāmettaphalaṃ tua tavaṃ saṃyuktaṃ, jaṃ evaṃ akaaṇṇuosi,jaṃ evaṃ paravatthulohiosi | eso khu maggaṇo tuha parittāṇaparāaṇeṇa amha sāmiṇā imammi duvvisahavarāhammi mukko | saṃpai tumaṃ avamiccumuhādo uvvarido | phullaṃtagallo jaṃpesu jaṃ paḍihāadi | ṇa llu amha sāmī tumaṃ ṇiakittikkhaṃbhaṃ bhaṃjayissadi | kaṇṭhīravaḥ -- (sākṣepam) re re sahūlaa | amhāṇaṃ esa kalaṃko jaṃ amha purado gomāuo bhaaṃ vaggadi | gomā -- (sāvakṣahāsam) re re kaṃṭhīrava! re re saddūlaa! tumhāṇaṃ kiṃ kiṃ agoaro amha vāhiṇosavāṇāṇaṃ pasaro | (sākūtamiva) ahaha ṇa esa sūaro pasṛ, so yyeva pasṛ jo eārisaṃ ghi kirādacakkavaṭṭiṃ visihalīlātisāyidamavalokaanto ṇa attāṇaṃ jāṇedi | arjunaḥ -- (sāvajñam) māṃsaṃ muhurvanamahīpu gavepayanti tajjīvanaikaśaraṇāḥ śavarāḥ kirātāḥ | tepāṃ varāhamṛgarohipakhaṅgaraṅkunyaṅkucchidāsu katamo'yamaho prakarpaḥ || 36 || gomā -- (saptambhramam) mahābhāa! ṇihuaṃ japesu | ihayyeva mahāvaṇatirohido mā suṇādu vāhiṇīṇāho | arjunaḥ -- (sākṣepam) yadi śropyati tatkim? | sidhdrā -- āgamipyati | arjunaḥ -- padyāgamipyati tatkim? | siddhā -- pārtha! āgatya tvadīyaśaraśaravpaḥ parāsṛrmā bhūditi gomāyuḥ svāmibhakttaḥ śaṅkate | gomā -- ṇa khu tumaṃ ahido muṇiṃdassa jaṃ eaṃ mantesi | (arjunaḥ uccaiḥkāraṃ māṃsaṃ muhurvanamahīpvityādi paṭhatei) (nepayye kalakalaḥ) siddhā -- (ākaṇrya mayāminayaṃ kṛtvā) | pārtha! tvadvacanaśravaṇānupadameva pravṛttā kirātānakinīti jāne || ahuhū! sasaṃrambhanyāsasphuradururavairaṃghripatanaiḥ kaṭhorajyāvallīpanyataraṭaṅkārapaṭalaiḥ | prasarppahordarpaprabalagalagarjāparikaraiḥ kirātāḥ sāśaṅkaṃ surasadanamapyāśu dadhate || 37 || (sātaṅkabhiva) tatyakathamadhunā bhavipyati? | ahaha naipa sūkaraḥ paśuḥ, sa eva paśuḥ ya etādṛśamapi kiragtacanphavatinaṃ viśikhalīlātiśāyitamavalokayan nātmānaṃ jānāti | arjunaḥ -- (sāvajñaṃ sopahāsam) sakhe siddhādeśa! bhavajjhampāṭopairyadi śalabhakolāhalabharastataḥ syātkā śaṅkā hutabhuji śikhācakravipame | kṣaṇādevodañcatyatha pṛyuladurgandhaśavalastadaṅgalopotthaścamiti ninadaḥ kiṃ na kalupaḥ || 38 || gomāyuḥ -- (sasambhramam) murṇid vārido mae | kiṃ karemi | āgado dārṇi sāhaso so kirādo | (arjunastadidānīṃ palāye iti vihasyāgrataḥ padāni dadāti) harakirātaḥ -- (praviśya)gomāuā…………saavmudo joo | karhi so muṇī?| gomāyuḥ -- (sahāsam) ṇāha! eso yyeva so muṇīsaro| harakirātaḥ -- (svagataṃ nirūpya) aho māhātmyaṃ kṣātrasya tejasaḥ! | tathāhi ekaḥ karaḥ kalayati sphaṭikākṣamālāṃ dhoraṃ dhanustaditarakṣca vibhatti hastaḥ | dharmaḥ kaṭhorakalikālakadarthyamānaḥ satkṣatriyasya śāraṇaṃ kimivānuyātaḥ || 39 || arjunaḥ -- (keirātamālokya svagataṃ sāścaryam) aye naipa kirātamātraṃ, devatāparigṛhotamivainamavalokayāmi | (savitarkam) ayamiha munisaṅgādadrikṣṛṅge kirātaḥ phacidapi kimu cakre cākṣupoṃ tryakṣasevām | upacayaparatantrā vikramotsāhaśakttirnahi nahi mahimānaṃ cāndracūḍaṃ vinā syāt || 40 || kirātaḥ -- gomāuā! eso pyeva amhāṇaṃ vikkamukkarisamasahanto āsi? | gomāyuḥ -- atha kim? | harakirātaḥ -- (tākṣepaṃ pārthamuddiśya) re re uasappa uasappa | jaṃ dullahūṃ dukkaradukkarehiṃ tavehi vi̱tthārṛidatāṇavehiṃ || . muṇida! tatte kaakammaṇāsaṃ ghāṇeṇa! ṇivvāṇamahaṃ daissaṃ || 41 || arjunaḥ -- (sopahāsam) ā pratyūpapradīpaṃ vipinaviharaṇairāmipāhārakāraḥ prāleyasyandakalrpa paripivasi muhunairjharaṃ svacchamambhaḥ || dhiktvāṃ dhiktvāṃ kirāta! kṣipasi kimu padaṃ vartmani kṣatriyāṇāṃ prāṇāpremānapekṣo nahi nahi bhavati tvādṛśāmepa yogyaḥ || 42 || harakirātaḥ -- (ravagataṃ sāśaṅkamū) aye! ekaḥ pārthaḥ, prabhṛtā kirātānīkinī | tatprakārāntareṇāsya karomi jīvarakṣām | (prakāśam) ayi muṇivīra! ṇ sudāī mae tuha'bhaṇidāhaṃ kirādkalaūleṇa | tā vāremi dāva ede | re re capalā kirādā! eso kiṃ vīradhammo jaṃ tumhe gaṇaṇāvāhirā, eso a ekko muṇivīro | tā osakkagha osakkagha | arjunaḥ -- (solluṇṭham) ayi kirātavīra! dattaṃ tāvattvayā vairaphalam | yataḥ tapaḥprasaṅgādbhatasaṅgarāṇāmupopitānāṃ mama sāyakānām | kirātaracaikttai"****grasupasthitā kiṃ kriyate sutucchā || 43 || siddhā -- (saptambhramam) pārtha! pārtha! kartha varpantyeva tvayi śarāsāramavadhīritanijādhīśśāsanāḥ kiratādhamāḥ | (arjunaḥ bāṇamokṣaṃ nāṭayati) siddhā -- (saddarṣāścayaim) ayi vīraśiromaṇe! paśpa! paśya! nijavāṇavegāvaibhavasya phalam | sāṭorpa śravaṇānta…………….kṛpya maurvām̐latāṃ ye muttā ripubhiḥ pradīpiladiśaḥ prārabdhaghorāravāḥ | kṛtairarddhapathe tvayā rayavaśādyāvṛtya sampātibhistairevārdhaśaraiḥ kirātapṛtanāvṛnde'tra vairāyitam || 44 || harakirātaḥ -- (vivṛtyāvalokya svagatam) kathamatikrāntaṃ kirātaiḥ! | pārthenaiva kṛtā nijā rakṣā | (prakāśam) didviā khu muṃkkaṃ cāvalaṃ kiradehiṃ | uvarado kolāhalo | kaṇṭhīravaḥ -- (sopahāsam) uvaradaṃ dāva kirāderhi yeva | saṃpai tāṇaṃ kalaalo kaantaṇaare vaṭṭadi | (harakirātaḥ sasambhramamavalokate) arjunaḥ (sopahāsam) mā vibhetu mahābhāgo mayā vāṇaparamparā imā dūrīkṛtāḥ | harakirātaḥ muṇivīra! diṇṇā mae tuha paṇatikkhā | karedu bhavaṃ sarabhasaṃ mai ṇiasarāiṃ akkhadāiṃ | arjunaḥ -- (sākṣepaṃ sagarvam) re re kirāta! śākuntānvayajā vayaṃ nahi nahi vyāpārayāmaḥ śarānsarvatraiva raṇānabhijñamanasāṃ vārttaiva kā tvādṛśām | tvāmāvarttayate'tha kiṃ mama dhanurvidyādidṛkṣārasastatpaśyādriśilāvipāṭanakalāṃ mā yātu te jīvitam || 45 || videśepataśca drāvayati māṃ munibhāvādviguṇāvirbhāvaḥ karuṇārasaḥ | harakirātaḥ -- (sopahāmam) kiṃ bhaṇṇai | diṭṭaṃ yeva tua koaṃḍavijcāmāhappaṃ, jeṇa tumaṃ ṇiāyakajñcāiṃ sāhiduṃ apahuppamāṇo tavassīkao | arjunaḥ -- (sakrodham) sarvataḥ kaniṣṭa midhyapā̱gariṣṭa! tyāmekavāṇavyayahelayaiva kirāta! karttāsmi kṛtāntavaśyam | chūṭṭadi sthitasyādyadhanurddharasya pinākapāṇeḥ paramasni lajcā || 46 || harakirātaḥ -- (sollasahāsam) aho me kammalāhacaṃ saṃvuttaṃ, jaṃ tuha hiae vāṇabhinne tumaṃ tuha gurū a yāvādido bhavissadi (iti bārṇe kṣipati)| kaṇṭhīravaḥ -- (antare bhṛtvā bāṇaṃ patantamādāya |)re re ṇa attāṇaṃ suṇesi, ṇeryaṃ murṇidaṃ muṇesi | harakirataḥ -- (sakrodham) re re sahulaa! kargha turma ṇa vāresi rkaṭhoraaṃ? ṇādivarāhaparammuho haṃ | teṇa eaṃ vaggoadi, tā saṃpadda taṃ pi karissaṃ | śārdūlakaṇṭhīravau -- (sākṣepama) ehi ehi erve ………. | harakirātaḥ -- (svagatam) kathaṃ sāvajñaḥ pārtho na prakāśayati mayi paurupam! | naccāvijñātapaugpanikapāya deyamidaṃ mahāratram | tadahaṃ duryodhanarūpamāsthāya parīkṣe paurupamasya | (itei duryodhanarūpaṃ nāṭayati) siddhā -- (veimāvya sāścaryam) mahābhāga pārtha! paśya paśya kopyayamanya eva saṃvṛttaḥ | arjunaḥ -- (svagarte takrīdham) āḥ kadhamapaṃ durātmā kurūvaṃśarpāsanaḥ! | kiṃ kuto'pi rākṣasādeḥ śikṣitamāyākramaḥkirātavepacchadmānā duryodhano māṃ draṣṭumāyātaḥ? | tatkimatrocitam! | athavā tāṃ mahārājakṛtāṃ maryādāmapyatilaṅghayipye, natvenaṃ vadhaprāsamidānīomupekṣipye (praphārśaṃ sopahāsam) re re kurukulakalaṅka! duryodhana! bhavāneva.jānātyucitamātmanaḥ | yatpātakamayaṃ rūpaṃ kairātamurarīkṛtam || 47|| haraduryodhanaḥ -- (sākṣepam) re madhpamapāṇḍava! kgha gataṃ taca gāṇḍībakodaṇḍapāṇḍiḍatyam? | samprati tapasvitayā rājyamabhilapase | arjunaḥ -- (sākṣepam.) re re durmada kaurava! ....kṣīṇa eko'smyarha tāstāḥ satvaramānaya kṣitibhṛtāmakṣauhiṇīrduḥsahāḥ | bhīṣmadroṇakṛpāṅgarājaśakuniprāyaiḥ sahāyairvṛtaḥ kṛtvā matka……… vighehi suddaḍhaṃ , rājyaṃ vimārgārjitam || 48 || athavā | ahamihaikastvamihaikaḥ | gṛhāṇa vāṇāsanam | eko guruḥ kurukule khuralī na bhinnā bhinnaṃ kulaṃ na ca janmabhūmiḥ | adya prakāśaya śarāsanavāhusāraṃ sāmye'pi vīra! bhavato vijayaṃ dadāmi ||49|| haraduryodhanaḥ -- (sākṣepam) etā visarjaya jaṭāstya………………….. …….. kṣapatravalayaṃ kuru thīramudrām | duryodhano nahi tapasvikṛte kadāpi sajjaṃ karippati dhanurjagadekavīraḥ || 50 || arjunaḥ -- (sakrodham) āḥ kirāta | kathamevaṃ māṃ vicikitsasi? | saṃhuārakāro jagatāṃ sa eva vriśūlapāṇirgiriśastapasvī | tadraudrabhāvānugṛhītavāhurdāhaṃ karipyāmyaha || 51 || haraduryodhanaḥ -- re re draupadīdayita! dṛrīkuru durāśāmimāṃ mayei kāpurupa! | tadānīṃ janakārjitaṃ rājyamapi na rakṣitavānasi | kathamidānīṃ vikatthano nāpatrapase | ayi harisuta! dhanyāste'pi tārṇāḥ pumāṃsastṛṇaghaṭitapṛthapatkepvāsamudrābhavantaḥ | janitapṛthubhavānāṃ kṣe ………………. jāmabhibhavati kuraṅgānaṅgaregvaiva yepām || 52 || arjunaḥ -- (vihasya solluṇṭham) ayi suyodhana | lajjāvahaivāsmākaṃ vikatthanatā tvadagre | yena tyayā kṛtāda…… tkāreṇa paśayatām | asmākaṃ rājyamācchidya gṛhotam haraduryodhanaḥ -- (sanogham) āḥ phālguna! upahasasi mām l tadānīṃ durodareṇopakṛtam, adhunā samarasaṃmarddena kuru sarjīvaṃ nirjīm̐rva gāṇḍīvam | (iti cāpamāsphālayati) arjunaḥ -- aṭutamaṭutam | prasavasamaya eva kroṣṭuvatkrośanastvaṃ na……..haṃ vyakttimenāmakārpīḥ | kathamadhigatadhāṣṭargho bhāpase yuddhahetoraparamiva viśaṅke tvāṃ na duryoghano'si||53|| haraduryodhanaḥ -- (svagatam) āḥ! khalu jñāto'smi | bhavatvecaṃ tāvat | (prakāśaṃ sāvantaṃ vihasya) pārtha! pārtha | tathyamevaitat | yaudhiṣṭhire yannijavastukośe duryodhano'nyaḥ vihitā'dhikāraḥ | pravāsayanpāṇḍusutānvanānte duryodhano'haṃ punaranya eva || 54 || taddarśaya śarāsāraśauṇḍatvam | arjunaḥ -- (sāvajñam) ayi suyodhana! masṛṇo'mi dhanurvedavidyāyām, uḍuro'si gadāvidyāyām | tadgṛhāṇa gadāvatkṛtvā gadābhāve kodaṇḍam | ahamapi tathā ttathā karipye | ehi vimarddakṣa ……. | (umau tayā kurutaḥ) kaṇṭhīravaḥ -- (sakautukama)sahūlaa! peccha peccha ghaḍidā duye vi mahāvīrā koaṃdaṃḍasaṃgarammi | śārdūlaḥ -- (sāṭaḥcamatkāram) kaṇṭhīrava! peccha peccha donha vi hatthalāghavaṃ | aho! pāalāhavaṃ,jaṃ koaṃḍaṇimmidapaṃjaravbhaṃtaraṭṭidavva duvevei dīsanti | siddhā -- āḥ | paśyata paśyata | kauravyaṃ ……………. dhanupā maulau madhonaḥ sutaḥ (sākṣcavai sasambhramam) samprāptāsare'tra hanta! rudhire vālenduramyughataḥ | (saharpabh) heho! paśyata paśyateśamunayaḥ sākṣādbhayānīpatirbhāsāṃ pūramanaśvaraṃ parikiransānandamujjṛmbhate || 55 || (sarve saharpāścaryamālokante, arjunaḥ śaṅkaramālokya sasambhramaṃ namaste namaste iti sāṣṭāṅgamavanau nipatati) śaṅkara -- (saharpoīlāsam) vatsa vatsa dhanañjaya! uktipṭottiṣṭa | arjunaḥ -- (sahasotthāya śirasi cadvāñjaliḥ) bhagavan pīyūpamayūkhaśekhara! namaste namaste | bhaghasi sukṛtnapākaiḥ stenakasyāpi sākṣānnahi nahi tava rūpāṇānīśo'sti kaścit | ' kimiti nikṛtimenāṃ nātha! kṛtvā vicitrāṃ kṣaṇamanucitakāraḥ sevako vañcito'ham || 56 || śaṅkaraḥ -- (sapramodaṃ vihasya) vatsa pārtha! nāghijñātapaurupanikapāya mahāstramidaṃ pradeyamityepa tvadvimaḥmaparīkṣopāyaḥ kṛtaḥ | samprati gṛhāṇainanmahāstram | (iti mahāstraṃ dattvā'rjunasya mūrdhni hastaṃ dadāti) siddhā -- ākṣcaryamākṣcaryam | nirgatya netradummiṃtraṃ jyotiḥ kimapi śaṅkarāt | nīrājitakakupcakramākrāmatyārjunaṃ vapuḥ || 57 || arjunaḥ -- (saharpam) deva deva trijagadguro! kiṃ te gurudakṣiṇāṃ dadāmi? | tvāṃ viśvatrayasargapālanalayavyāpāralīlāmaya prīṇīyāṃ katamena bhargga! vidhinā…… sitaṃ kāmadam | kiṃtu krūraraṇaprakarpavidalatsadvīramuṇḍotkaraprālamvapratikarmasambhṛtimahaṃ sampādaghipye muhuḥ || 58 || śaṅkaraḥ -- (saharṣam) phalitamasmākaṃ mahāstrapradānena, yadevaṃ tāvadāvirbhāvasamanantarameva vatsaḥ prakāmutsahate | ghanyo dhanaṃjaya! pitā tava devarājo ghamarmo'grajaḥ priyassuhṛtpumrūpottamasya | etāṃ bhuvaṃ mama tanuṃ gurubhārabhugrāṃ ladhvīopharipyasi hatapravarapravīraḥ||59|| arjunaḥ -- (sapraśrayaṃ viddasya) mama tanuṃ laghvīkaripyasītyanucitamapi mayi karuṇārasavaśaṃvadāḥ samādiśānti pādāstadetatpramāṇām | śaṅkaraḥ -- (saparivopam) vatsa kapidhvaja! kathaya kiṃ punastava priyamupakaromi | arjunaḥ -- (sapraśrayaṃ saparitoṣam)`bhagavan jagannātha! kimataḥ praraṃ prārthaye bhavantam | astrajyotiḥ……………... nādha! dattaṃ tvayā bhe yatpradyotaiḥ kurukulatamaḥ srastamadyaiva manye | sampūrṇaśrīrnikhilabhuvanaṃ pūrayanharpapurairadyaivāsītpraka……sūnurdineśaḥ || 60 || tathāpīdamastu parjanyo vṛṣṭimiṣṭāṃ vitaratu karuṇāvāriṇā pūryamāṇo nyāyopāyapravṛttā avanimavanipāḥ pālayantu prasakttāḥ | mohadhvāntapraṇāśāṃ manasi ca mahatāṃ śaṅkarādvaitamāstāṃ vākūpīyūpaprapābhistribhuvanamaniśaṃ modayantāṃ kavīndrāḥ || 61 || iti śrīkirātārjunīyo nāma vyāyogaḥ kavivatsarājaviracitaḥ samāptaḥ | dāsye'haṃ parirambhaṇāni kitava! ghūte jitāni tvayā bhithyautsukyamidaṃ yataḥ śātamahorātrāstadīyā'vadhiḥ | ityuktaḥ śivayā niśādivasakṛjjyotirmayākṣidvayadrāgunmepanimeṣakoṭighaṭanavyagro haraḥ pātu yaḥ || 1 || api ca smerāḥ kākṣaśatairnivārya nibhṛtaṃ cāturyadhuryāḥ sakhīḥ sāriṃ sārayato mṛpā gapagayataḥ sthānānyatikrāmataḥ | kaṇṭhākṣleṣapaṇe durodaravidhau candrārddhacūḍāmaṇerdevīṃ vañcayato jayanti gahanacchdmakramāḥ kelayaḥ|| 2 || (nāndyante) sūtradhāraḥ -- (saharṣam) aye! adya kila nīlakaṇṭhayātrāmahotsavasamāgatairvidagdhasāmājikaiḥ kālañjarapatermahārājaśrīparamarddidevasyāmātyena kavinā vatsarājena viracitaṃ karpūraccaritābhidhānaṃ bhāṇamabhinetumādiṣṭo'smi | yasyaikapātraprayojyasyābhinaye suśikṣito me kanīyān bhrātā | pūrvaraṅgamaṅgalamātra eva mamopayogaḥ | (diśo'valokya saharpam) aye!prāpta evāyamabhinayocitaḥ svabhāvasubhago vibhātasamayaḥ | samprati hi dampatyoḥ smarasaṅgaravyatikare prāravdhasāhāyakakrīḍājāgaraṇotsavena rajanipratyantamāsedupaḥ | siñjānairnṛpaveśmanirgatacaladvārādvārāṅganānṛpuraiḥ pratyūṣe'pi na dīyate ratipaternidrāvakāśo manāk || 3 || api ca ācchidya sadyaḥ pratināyakasya candrasya mandapratibhasya lakṣmīm | tāṃ śambhalīṃ rātrimapāsya dūre dhūrto ravighau gaṇikāmupaiti || 4 || (ākāśe karṇe datvā) mārpa! kimāttha? | āḥ kimedaṃ aṇucidaṃ mantīadi | kahiṃ surāsuramahaṇipyamāṇapāaphaṃso bhaavaṃ sṛro | kahiṃ māāvaṃcidasaalabhuaṇo dhuttajaṇo | (samayam) alamalamuccaiḥkāramālāpena| kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā divā nirīkṣya vaktavyaṃ rātrau naiva ca naiva ca || sañcaranti mahādhūrtta vaṭe vararuciryathā || 5 || kimāttha?| kiṃ maṃ bhāesi! ṇatthi me dhuttādo bhaaṃ | (nepathye) āḥ kṣudra midhyāgariṣṭa! tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | utsaṅge sindhubharturvasati madhuripurgāḍhamākṣlipya lakṣmīmadhyāste vittanātho nidhiniyahamupādāya kailāsaśailam | śakraḥ kalpadrumādīnkanakaśikahariṇo'dhītyakāsu nyadhāsībhhṛrtebhyasrāsamitthaṃ dadhati divipado mānavāḥ ke varāphāḥ ||6 || sūtra -- (stutvā) aye! karpūrako nāma dhūrto'yamitaḥ phruddho'bhyupaiti | tanneha yujyate sthātum | (ini neiṣkrāntaḥ) prastāvanā (tata praśiāti karpūrakaḥ.) karpūrakaḥ -- (sakrodham) api ca | re mārya! bhakalalokakāmadughāṃ māpāyidyāṃ dūṣyataḥ kathaṃ na yidīrṇaṃ rasanayā bhavataḥ? paśya re paśya! phathamakṛta raghūṇāṃmagraṇīrvālibhaṅgaṃ kathamagmadalyāmagnitulyāṃ biḍaujāḥ| ghalidamanakārṣīganapāṇiḥ kathaṃ yā na bhayati yadi māyā niṣpidhānaṃ pidhānam || 7|| athavā | alaṃ me khalālāpasamādhānanirvandhena | tadahamidānīmajitārthatīrthapratipādanāya durodaraśālāmeva vrajāmi | yataḥ ghūtakrīḍāvihīnasya veśyāsu vimukhasya ca | vidyamānamapi vyakttaṃ dhanaṃ svapnadhanopamam || 8 || (ākāśe) vayasya candanaka!tiṣṭa tiṣṭa | māmapi pratipālaya | krimāttha? sattaṭṭavāsarāiṃ durodaravirahiṇo ṇa tuha muhaṃ puloīadi | (sasmitam) alaṃ me vittaśanyasya dopodbhāvanena | vittaśāṭhyaṃ hi kramātikrame garhitam | kiṃ vravopi? | vilāsavadīdinnahiaassa ṇa rkipi te paḍihāadi | (vihasya) vidito'smi vayasyena | evamevaitat | aharaharabhutā apyapūrvāpamāṇā nirupadhimadhurāsnāḥ subhruvaḥ premalīlāḥ | kṛnaniviṭasamādhirbhāvayannantarātmā pariśithilitavṛttirvarttate'nyakriyāsu || 9 || (iti sthita eva paṭhati) (āphāśe karṇe datvā) eyaṃ me vayasyo vravīti | suṭṭu khu me koūhallatāoppemmalīlāo āaṇṇiduṃ, jāhiṃ saalabhuaṇamohapṇo tumaṃpi mohido | (satrīḍasmitam) kathayāmi yadi na subhagammanyaṃ manyate vayasyaḥ | ekadā mayei kelikalahāntarite suguptaṃ saudhapṛpṭhācalagne aratibharanirastanidrayā tayā gāthā paṭhitā | seyamutkīrṇeva manasi varttate | agvai ṇa tattha dhutte vāvāro kovi iaradūīṇa | āṇesu siviṇae taṃ mā ṇidde ṇiddayā hohi || (iyāsīnastathā tathā aratiṃ nāṭayati) (punarākāśe) kiṃ vravopi? | kimetāṃ vīṇāmutsaṅge dhārayasi? | satatamiyaṃ tadaṅkadurlālitā seyaṃ māṃ proṇāti | etayā kila sā bhagavatīṃ bhavānīmuṣavīṇayati | vipakṣapurato'picchalena madgotrāṅkaṃ geyamupagāyati (iti vīṇāṃ durśayati) | kimāttha? | taṃ yyeva geaṃ attaṇo gāesu | ākarṇapatu me vayasyaḥ | ratiramaṇapriyasuhṛdā śaśāṅkasubhagena nirvṛtikareṇa | karpūreṇa viyogo bhagavati rudrāṇi! mā bhavatu || 10 || (iti vīṇayā bahuvidhaṃ gāyati | dhyānaṃ nāṭayitvā sorastāḍaṃ pārṇi vidhūya) kimāttha? | kiṃ uṇa tumaṃ maulāantaṇetto hiaaṃ tāddesi, pārṇi dhuṇesi | (sāsraṃ) vayasya! sakhīṃ kṛtvā yuktayā sphudamadanukārapraṇayinīṃ tayā sāddha ghūtavyatikaramathārabhya sutanuḥ | muhujiṃtvā jitvā ddaḍhatarasamāliṅganapaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭā draṣṭavyā punarapi mayā guptavapupā || 11 || śāntam | athavā maraṇāmeva tadanusmaraṇam | (kṣaṇaṃ vicintya ūrdhvagavalokya bāppaṃ muñcatei) (ākāśe) krimāttha?|kiṃ uṇa tumaṃ sahasañcia bāhacchohapakkharāvilamuho saṃvutto?| vayasya | paśayāmīva puratastamadya saudhaśiravaraṃ, yatrāhaṃ premavigrahānutāpaparavatyā candrātapopaḍhaukitayā svayameva tayā praṇayena kṛtārthīkṛto'smi | prathamaṃ hi sā tatra ghanasāraparāgapaṭalaniculitasphaṭikaśilādhiśāyinī sakhījanābhimukhyena māṃ śrāvayantīo candraṃ pratītthamuktvatī ihāsti nūnaṃ tuhināṃśuvimve kalaṅkadhūmānumito hulāśaḥ | ānaya svapne taṃ mā nidre nirddayā bhava || asyāṃśupūraḥ kathamanyathā'sau jcālācalīḍamvaramātanoti || 12 || tato'haṃ tadantika evānākarṇitakena sthitaḥ svayameva tayā vilusavrīḍamutthāyāvarjito'smi| anponyaṃ karatāḍanena hasatu svacchkandamālījanastpakttā mānakathā kṛtā'ñjalirasāvaṅgīkṛtaṃ lāghavam | āgaḥśalyaparamparāḥ subhaga yākṣcitte mama tvatkṛtāḥ sarvāstāḥ śaśivimvacumvakaśilālokena dūrīkṛtāḥ || 13 || (nepathyāmimukhamavalokya sāśaṅkamākāśe) kiṃ punarvihasitamukhaḥ priyavayasyaḥ? | na khalu māmupahasati bhavān | kimātya? | jai eriso kaatthīkaakusumaśaro paropparamaṇurāavandho, tā kīsa tuma tissā dūdībhavia gahidapāhuḍo paḍibhuaṃgaṃ maṃjīraamaṇusaṃdhiduṃ gadosi tti hāseṇa phuṭidomhi | vayasya evaṃ mā hāsyo vaideśikaḥ | kāryācāryakathāsu kinna śrutaṃ tvayā garvormibhirahāryāṇāṃ kāryakauśalaśālinām | nyakkāro'pi śubhodarkkaḥ spṛhaṇīyaḥ kkacidbhavet || 14 || tattvāṃ phalasampattirevārādhayiṣyati | (ākāśe karṇe datvā) kimātya? | suddu khu me koūhallaṃ, tā kaghesu me vitthareṇa ṇiaduattaṇaṃ |ākarṇayatu me vayasyaḥ| gato'haṃ manodyāne pānagoṣṭīgatasya mañjīrakasya pārkṣvam | (iti hāsa nāṭayitvā) evamāha bhavān | kiṃ uṇa āraṃbha eva hāseṇa cilaṭhadi bhavaṃ| vayasya! tadepaceṣṭānusmaraṇena hāsaparyākulo'smi | kimātya? | tā maha purado taṃ pyeva paaḍesu| kiṃna kathayāmi vayasyāya? | vakro jūṭaḥ khala iva sadā karṇadeśāvalagnaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kūrco bhaṭa iva muhurlabdhalohamasaṅgaḥ| haste śāstrī bhramiśatakarī lāsikeva pragalbhā vākrasaṃrodhī gad iva mukhe kiñca tāmbūlagolaḥ || 15 || api ca ucrcairgāthāpaṭhanamaśubhaṃ śrotrayorātmagītaṃ hastāghātairurasi taralairmaurajī vādyavidyā | bhūyo bhūyaḥ kararuhapadotsaṅgite dṛṣṭiraṅge (iti tathā tathā'bhinayaṃ darśayitvā) kartuṃ śakttaḥ ka iva yadi vā tasya duśceṣṭitāni || 16 || vijñapsaścāsau mayā katicitpāśvaisthalaṭakasahacarakṣlāghābhirutyaphandharaḥ | (sapraśrayam) āutta maṃjīraa! pesidamhi tuha saāsaṃ attāe kalāvadoe bhaṇidaṃ ca tīe | putra mañjīraka | tāvakīyaṃ vilāsavatī, kāhamasyāḥ kṛpāyām || kiṃ nu tvadviyogadahanena vipannāyāmasyāṃ tvameko me tanayaḥ kalaṅkakalupo bhavipyasīti vepate me hṛdayam | samprati hi harahimakaralekhādurvalā dehaballī kṣvasilapayanayātrāmātra evodyamo'pi | tava subhaga! viyoge viklavāmitthametāmapi virahaviroghī śocate pañcavāṇaḥ || 17 || tatastenokttam | astyevamamvāyā hṛdayaṃ, vilāsavatyāstu karpūrakāsakttacetasaḥ ke vapam | tato mayā'bhihitam | ṇatthi erva ṇatthi | tataḥ sa māmabhyadhāt | bhadra | navāgamanatvādanabhijño bhavān | aghāmyā kalahāyitā saha mayā kāryaṃ mapāgha vrataṃ vādhante'dya mamāṅgakāni nṛpaternāṭave niyogo'dya me | itthaṃ matpratipeghavaddhamanasastasyāḥ prabhūtāruceḥ sphūrttiḥ kāpi vijṛmbhate navanavavyājoktiyuktikrame || 18 || api ca mayyāravdhakathe sakhījanamabhiprastauti vāktantaraṃ sākṛnaṃ phurute muhurmama samasyā'nyasya garhāgraham | madvijñānakalāsu kṛṇitamukhī maunaṃ samālamvate nidrāṃ nāṭayate karoti ca punarvyakttiṃ purāṇāgasām || 19 || kimākhyātaiḥ? | vyattameva kiṃ nādarśi tvayā vilāsavatyāḥkeligṛhe karpūrakālekhyaṃ yatrāyamālikhitaḥ kṣloko'sti vācālatvaṃ padālagno mañjīraḥ kurunāṃ cirāt | krapraira eya sarvāṅgasaṅgasaubhāgpabhājanam || 20 || tannāmasāmyaprītyā ca śiśire'pi karpūreṇā sarvāṅgāni cchurayati | (karṇe datvā) kimāttha? | aho de dhannantaṇaṃ jaṃ paḍivakkhamruhādo ṇiāasohaggaṃ ṇisuṇidaṃ | (vrīdṛāmabhinīya) priyavayasya! samagraṃ tāvadākarṇaya | tatastaddhacanamākarṇya karṇau pidhāyābhyadhāyi mayā | kalahāido āutto evaṃ japedi | śiviṇaevi ṇa edaṃ saṃbhāvīadi!saṃpadaṃ khu, sā rāabhariahiaā asarisakhassa saalusuaṇammi | tuha viggahassa virardi ahilasai aṇaṇṇavācārā || kimāttha? | kiṃ teṇa vinnādaṃ vivarīdatthaṃ tuha edaṃ caaṇaṃ? | (vihatya) kudo vinnādaṃ? | anenaiva vacanopanyāsena parituṣṭena gṛhītaṃ tāmbūlacandananavīnāṃśukādiprābhṛtakam | ukttosmi ca saparitopam | bhadra nipuṇāka! gaccha gaccha tenāsmadaṅgulīyakābhijñānena grahīpyasi pāritopikamatmadgṛhe dīnārasahastram | vayamapyāgataprāyā eva | (nepathyabhimukhamākarṇanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā saparaiitopamākāśe) cayasya candanaka! ākarṇaya ākarṇaya evamihoghujyate | evaṃvidhaddherevaṃvighameva phalaṃ yujyate | yadyanena dagdhamañjīrakeṇa gaṇikāyāścandrasenāyāḥ parimupitaṃ vastu tatkimepa tvadīyacīnāṃśukakṣṛṅgāritaḥ suvyakttaṃ paryaṭati catyarepu | tadidānīmasya rājakārāgārakīlitasya kaḥ pratīkāraḥ? | arthasañcayo'pyapya kenopi chalakalitāṅgulīyakābhimānena sarva evāpahṛtaḥ | kimāttha? | kiṃ tae gaṇiāe caṃdaseṇāe parimusiūṇa taṃ tae cīṇaṃsuaṃ kuvaḍapāhuḍe maṃjīraassa diṇṇaṃ? | (saharṣam) vayasya! atha kim? | (punarākāśe) evamāha bhavān | sāhu vaassu sāhu! pācidaṃ mae tuha mittīe addhaṃ phalūṃ jaṃ tae caṃdaseṇāe parimusidaṃ satrvassaṃ | ahaṃ khu tīe haāsāe hāradattadinnahiaāe ṇiāddhaṇīkadomhi 'taiā uṇa samaggaṃ phalaṃ bhaṇidavvaṃ jaiā hāradatto tae karhipi saṃkaḍe pāḍidavvo | cayasya! pratipālaya kiyantamapi kālam | tadapi phalitaprāyam | (punarākāśe) evamāha bhavān | paramaṃ khu edaṃ paharisaṭṭhāṇaṃ tā vitthareṇa ṇivedehi | jahā tae caṃdaseṇā parimusidatti | ākarṇayatu me vayasyaḥ | upaḍhaukito mayā hāradattahārastasyai | ukttaṃ ca | sāmiṇi diṭṭiā vaḍḍhasi | jidaṃ jūammi sāmiṇā hāradatteṇa hāradtteṇa saalajūdaarasavvassaṃ | ahaṃ khu tugraṃ vaddhāviduṃ pesidomhi | tataśca sā kimayamamṛtavāpyāṃ ranānakeliprasaṅgo ghaṭayati kimu vṛrṣṭi mākarandīṃ vasantaḥ | kimu samupagatā'haṃ vaidhavīṃ rājadhānīmiti hṛdi hariṇākṣī hāramāmucya mene || 21 || pravṛttaśca taḍhrahe hāradattāgamana iva hāramāghrāgamane'pi mahotsavaḥ | uttaścāsmi tadamvayā māyāvatyā || vatsa! vatsa! amhāṇaṃ khu ajja mairāparāhīṇo pariaṇo | edaṃ amha sacvassaṃ tuha yyeva | to appamatteṇa bhodavvaṃ | tato mayā'bhyadhāpi | ṇātthi ettha saṃdeho | appamattoyyeva ciṭṭhmi | athāhaṃ tadgahe mattasusaparijane asvāmika iva prakāmaṃ sarvasvamādāyāpakrānto'smi | (punarākāśe) vayasya candanaka! kimevaṃ kupyasi? | kīsa taṇe maha paḍivakkhassa hāradattassa pesaṇaṃ kadaṃ | prasīd prasīda | nahi nahi mayā tatprepyeṇaitadadhyavasitam | ākarṇaya ākarṇaya (sopahāsam) jānātyeva tadā bhavān | granthicchṭāvikaṭajīrṇapaṭaikavittaḥ skandharpitavdiguṇavāhuyugottarīyaḥ | krodhopabhukttakaṭhinīdhavalādharakṣrīrghūtaprabhorahamabhūvamatiprasādī || 22 || tāddagvighaceṣṭitakṣcāhaṃ gato māṇibhadrasyāyatanam | evamāttha? | kiṃ tuha jūdaarassa māṇibhaddeṇa? | vayasya maivam | rūpāntaraṃ purārāteḥ pratyarthidalanoddhura | vinidrayati bhadrāṇi māṇibhadraḥ sadaiva naḥ || 23 || upālavdhakṣca mayā daurgatyopatasena bhagavānmāṇibhadraḥ | pūjopahāraviniyogaparamparābhirāyāsayanti ca dhanāni ca saṃharanti | aśśāmprayaṃ dṛḍhabhapi draḍhayanti pāśaṃ viścapralambhanaparā hi sadaiva devāḥ || 24 || tanmamārpaya prāgarpitapūjopahārān | māṇiābhadra'! dṛṣṭā tvayā madīyā bhaktiḥ | abhakttirapīdānīṃ dṛśyatām | iti parupākṣaramudīrya viśrānte ca mapi (ityarddhokttau dīrghamupṇaṃ ca ni śvasya vaiklavyaṃ nāṭayani) (panarākāśe) vayasya candanaka! kimāttha? | kiṃ uṇaṃ tumaṃ yyeva evaṃ vihalosi | vayasya samaraṇamapi sudāruṇaṃ tādṛgdaśāyāḥ | tathāhūiṃ nidānaṃ rāgāṇāmajani rajanīpūrvasamayo jajṛmbhe sā hṛdyā madhuramadirāgandhalahariḥ | udīrṇā sā yūnāṃ sahajasubhagā gītasaraṇirmamāsīdāsannaṃ yamanagaradauvārikavacaḥ || 25 || atha purupaḥ saharpaṃ kaścidabhyetya bhagavantaṃ māṇibhadramabhyadhṛāt bhaavaṃ māṇibhadda! ṇamo de | saalovi esa tuha pahāvo jaṃ me sāmī hāraṃdatto jūammi jaalacchīvallaho tā genha edaṃ pūopahāraṃ | avia | jai me kaṇiṭṭhabhāduo ṇiuṇao deśāntarapavāsido āgamissadi, tā eso ahaṃ cadurao savvasseṇa vi tumaṃ paritosaissaṃ | ityākarṇya ca mayā bhavitavyamasmādasmākaṃ kiyatāpyādhisamādhāneneti kṛtaniścayena sa caturako nirgacchannupayātaḥ | atha sa caturakaḥ paribhalāhūtarolambacakravālakakṛnīlatiraskaraṇīvibhramaṃ viveśa śauṇḍikāgāram | atha tadaṅgaṇādadūrataḥ sthitena prārebhe mayā karuṇasvaraṃ kapaṭaśokābhinayaḥ | yathā kila sāhu bhaṇidaṃ khu keṇa vi subhāduarasapṇṇueṇā edaṃ | deśe deśe kalatrāṇi deśe deśe ca vāndhavāḥ | taṃ tu deśaṃ na paśyāmi yatra bhrātā sahodaraḥ || 26 || haddhī haddhī | aho me duṭṭajīovidassa sudiḍhattaṇaṃ, ja tārisassa subhāduassa caduraassa vi viraheṇa ṇa ṇīharadi | adha tena madālāpasamuddīpitasamadhikakaruṇārdrahṛdayena sasambhramamabhyetyābhihito'smi | bhadda ṇa tumaṃ maha kaṇiṭṭabhāduo ṇiāñuṇao | atha mayā sakṣreṇa tūpṇīmev sa caraṇporgṛhītaḥ | tato'haṃ tena bhrātṛvipogaduḥgvabharavijṛmbhamāṇatārākranditena kaṇṭhe gṛhīto'smi | atha mayā'bhyadhāyi | muṃcadu muṃcadu maṃ ajjo | aliabhāduo ravu ahaṃ | saiyyeva ajjassa dukkhamuppādemi | (punarākāśe) evaṃ vihasati bhavān | aho de aliapiāuṇaassa vi vaṃkavaaṇammi saccaṃ ṇiuṇattaṇaṃ | vayasya candanaka! kiṃ vacanena? | paśya me kārya eva naipuṇam|kṣṛṇu tāvadagrataḥ | atha sa caturakeṇa samadhikāramahotsavena śauṇḍiko'bhyadhāyi | tumaṃ khu me dhammapidā | dehi me avaraṃ mairaṃ | māṇaissaṃ mahūsavaṃ | milido me cirapavāsido kaṇiṭṭabhāduo ṇiuṇao | edaṃ khu hāradattapesidaṃ hāraṃ samappiaṃ jaṃ caṃdaseṇāe saāsādo pāvissaṃ tatte samappissaṃ | atha mayā jaradambaragranthitaḥ samunmocya samupanītaṃ tasya hiraṇyaśakalam | ukttaṃ ca mayā ayya caduraa! genha edaṃ | mae khu tuha pahāveṇaṃ yyeva vahudaraṃ ajjidaṃ | kiṃ upga caurāvahārādo edaṃ yyeva uccaridaṃ | atha tenokttam | vatsa! aṇucidaṃ khu edaṃ, kaṇiṭṭho tumaṃ | tato mayā'bhyadhāyi | ayya! kiṃ edaṃ vatyudaṃ | mae uṇa ajñassa pasāeṇa vahudaraṃ ajjidavvaṃ! atha sa tadbhṭṛhītvā jagrāha bhūpasīṃ madirām | kimāttha? | kiṃ uṇa tae aṭṭhāṇe daviṇao cakado | cayasya mā bhaipīḥvyabhicarati na dāhacchedakāpakriyābhirjagadupakṛtipātraṃ jātarūpaṃ tadanyat | kanakabhinīddagvikṣvavikṣvāsaghātapraṇayigahanamāyājālajātātmalābham || 27 || atha sa caturakaḥ nisthāmakaraṇagrāmaḥ prakāmaṃ sīdhusevayā | nidrayā sāndrayā grastaḥ sannipātādivāpatat || 28 || ahaṃ ca capakacumbanamātraparo madirayā'nabhibhūtastadutsaṅgato,hāramādāya nipkrānto'smi | (nepathyābhimukhaṃ kalakalākarṇanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā puro'valokya sasam) (ākrośe) virodhaka | kimuddhānto dhāvāsei? | āpṛtpraśāntipu parā tava vuddhisiddhirna trāsaleśamapi tattyayei sampratīmaḥ | kāpi pramādaparavānasi cettadepa taghrāsti me ripukulāntakaraḥ kṛpāṇaḥ || 29 || (ākarṇanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā) kimāttha? | ṇatthi me kimpi bhaaṃ ṇatthi | ahaṃ khu caṃdaṇaaṃ vaddhāviduṃ pahāvidomhi | eso khu edassa paṭighakkho hāradatto rā apuriserhi ṇiāgihīdo ṇivvāsīadi | eassa kila bhicceṇa caduraeṇa aliabhakaṇaadāṇeṇa soḍio vaṃcido | amavareṇa a ṇiuṇāeṇa hārāhiṇṇāṇadāṇavaṃcidāe cadaseyāāe savvassaṃ parimusiaṃ | tujjhavi sā paḍivakgvabhūdā kuṭṭaṇo kalāvadī duhidāe vilāsavadīe gaṇiāgaṇassa purado kaasavṛhaṇivvandhaṃ ājammaṃ paricattā | (saharpam) vayasya virodhaka! dīrgha jīva dīrghaṃ jīva | pīyūpasindhurajanipṭa vinaṣṭanakraḥ procchinnadurjanakathā'jani kāvyagoṣṭhī | jātādya candanalatā bhujagīviyuktā yatkuddanīvirahitā gaṇikā vabhūva || 30 || tatkathaya kathamidaṃ saṃvṛttam | (ākarṇanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā) evamāttha? | mae khu paḍhamaṃ bhaṇidā sṛṇihudaṃ sā kalāvado! esā khu tuha duhidā jūdaarakappūrammi vilaggahiaā tuha savvassaṃ ukkhaṇia tassa samappissadi | to tae appamattāe bhodavvaṃ | puṇo a mae vilāsavadīo evaṃ gahidatthā kayā | jahā keira esā tuha antiā kappūraapakkhavādakāraṇeṇa virattā tuha savvassaṃ ukkhaṇia kahiṃpi gamissadi | tā ajja raaṇīe ṇikikhadavvā tae esā | tado jāmiṇīe paḍhamajāmammi kalāvadī daviṇaṭṭāṇamukkhaṇantī vilāsavadīe sakesaggahaṃ kalahāvidā ṇivvāsidā a | (saharpamākāśe) vapasya candanaka! paśya paśya `bhagavato māṇibhadrasya prasādamahimānam | dvitraireva dinaiḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ smaḥ | (pṛnarākāśe ākarṇanāminayaṃ kṛtvā sāścaryam) evamākāśavāṇī kṣrūyate | vatsa karpūraka! na tathā tvadbhaktyā parituṣṭo'smi yaṃthā taddine ropagarbhairupālambhaiḥ | tartika te bhūyaḥ priyamupakaromi | (sāścaryaharpamākāśe praṇamya) bhagavanprasīda prasīda kṣamasva durvinayam | epa punaḥ punaḥ praṇato'smi | vipatpayoghau nihitā vipakṣāḥ pūrṇāḥ prakāmaṃ kanakairnikāyāḥ | śānto'ntarāyaḥ pramadāsukhanāmabhyarthaye tatkimarha kṛnārthaḥ || 31 || tathāpīdamastu lokaḥ sadā nandatu pūrṇakāmaścandrārddhacūḍe niviḍāmurāgaḥ | varpantu kāmaṃ salilaṃ payodāḥ kṛpārdracittāḥ kanakaṃ narendrāḥ || 32 || sapāpto'yaṃ karpūracaritābhidhāno bhāṇaḥ | kṛtiriyaṃ mahākavervatsarājasya | daramukulitanetrā smeraghaphrāmyujakṣrīrupagiripatiputri prāptasāndrapramodā | manamijamayabhāvairbhāvitadhyānamudrā vitaratu rucinaṃ vaḥ śāāmbhavī dambhabhaṅgiḥ || 1 || api ca upalaśakalakalpaḥ kaustubho yāmipho me ṭṭadi taya ramaṇīnāṃ vāryate kena yātrā | tvamasi kuvalayābhastatkaṭākṣopamarddairbhaṇitibhiriti lakṣmyāḥ pātu mūko murāriḥ || 2 || (nāndyante) sūtradhāraḥ -- (saharpam) diṣṭayā manoratha iva drāgupagataḥ paritopayati māmabhinayasamayaḥ | ahaṃ hi kālaśñjare cakrasvāmiyātrāsamāgatavidagdhasāmājikairādiṣṭo'smi | yadadya candrodaye devasya cakrasvāminaḥ purato rukimaṇīharaṇādvayaḥ . kavivatsarājaviracita īhāmṛgo'bhineyaḥ | (sautsukyam) kiṃ punarviśravdhāyate mama parijanaḥ? | sthāpakā -- (praviśya) bhāva! tvaryatāṃ tvaryatāṃ samatikrāmatyabhinayavelā | paśyetu bhāvaḥ | udayagirikuraṅgīrāgapāśena kṛpṭaḥ paripatatu kuraṅgo mā mamāyaṃ vimūḍhaḥ | dṛti ṭṭadi kṛnaśaṅgo nṛnameṇāṅka epa tvaritapadamupaiti vyomaraṅgasya madhyam || 3 || sūtra -- (vihamya) aho me parijanasya nijadopāropaṇe paramūrddhani naipuṇam | bhavanta eva viśravdhā, bhavanta eva māṃ tyarayanti | sthāpakaḥ -- (vihamya) kṣāmyatu kṣāmyatu bhāvaḥ | sa tava prasādabhṛmirduḥ śīlo nāma śailūpaḥ kāmapi kanyāṃ durlabhāmanpakāmāṃ samīhamānaḥ sambodhya samvodhya nipidhyamāno vilamvamiyantaṃ kāritavān | (nepayye) api yūthanātha! kariṇīṃ kāmapi ramaṇīṃ kurupva ramaṇīyām | abhramusamāgamāśābhrāntiriyaṃ dārugṇ bhavanaḥ || 4|| (ākāśe) api bhadra | gatvā śrāvayaitāṃ gāthāṃ taṃ duḥśīlaṃ śailūpaṃ, taṃ ca śiśupālam | (nepayye) śrāvaya śaichṭrapaṃ, mā śiśupālam | bhavatvepo'vimṛśyakārī vipadāmāspadam | sūtra -- mārpa!akrūro'yaṃ rukmiṇīśiśupālapariṇayāsūtraṇāśravaṇājjhagiti pragalbhamāṇaropāṅkuro vyāharati | tadehyāvāmanantarakaraṇīyaṃ sampādayāvaḥ!| (iti niṣkrāntau) prasnāvanā (tataḥ praviśatyakṛraḥ) akūraḥ -- (saropāścaryam) aho! vāliśatvaṃ śiśupālasya | padpaṃ madhukaiṭabhāripremasarasīrājahaṃsīṃ rukmirṇīṃ nijamanomarumaṇḍale valena vāsayitumabhilapati | kadhitaṃ hi me suvuddhayā parivrājikayā rukmiṇīvṛttāntam | pulakodgamapīnāṅgī kṛpṇavivāhaṃ niśamya sā bhavati | manute vivāhamanyaṃ svapnavivāhaṃ kuraṅgākṣī || 5 || rukimaṇīdhāmreyikayā suyatsalayāpītthaṃ niveditam | te hi ruvimaṇīprahite dve'pi kṛpṇaṃ nirūpayituṃ sugutamāgate || sā ca sucuddhiparivrājikā rukmiṇyā gaurīomantropadeśagururanulaṅghayanideśā | rukmiṇīkṛṣṇaghivāhāya ca ddhe'pi te kṛnapratijñete gate | daivamagrataḥ pramāṇam | athavā varayatu varayatu śiśupālo rukmiṇīm | alaṃ me harpāvasare vaimanasyena | so'yaṃ mahānabhyudayo yadūnāṃ yaditthamāgāṃsi karoti caidyaḥ | tadrattkavarpaikasamo murāreḥ kroghāgniru̱ktiṣṭati nānyathāsya || 6 || . na cādyāpi kapati karṇo kṛpṇasya rukmiṇīvarāntaraparigrahavārttādurvātā varttaḥ | aho! mahadvaimanasyamāyātaṃ janārddanasya | kathitaṃ hi me tadāsannaparijanena kiṃ kathyate śravaṇgamātraparigrahe'pi dattotsavā danujavairiṇi rukimaṇī sā | ālokiteva nikaṭāgnikaṭīkṛteva sotprāsacāṭuvacanairanumoditeva || 7 || tadahaṃ tameva devamupasarpāmi sandhukṣayāmi ropānalamasya cedīndradāruṇadurṇayodantadāruṇā | (parikramya puro'valokya) aye! prāsa evāhaṃ sabhāsīdham | (nirūpya saharpam) kathaṃ dvāvapīha rāmakṛpṇau | aho! jagadvikhyātā vandhuprītiranayoḥ | tathāhi eke rāmaṃ marakatamayā vibhrate vimvitāṅgaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caike sphaṭikaghaṭitā vyakttamevodvahanti | tatsaubhrātraṃ sahajasubhagaṃ saṃvidānairmanojñaiḥ saudhastambhairapi kimanayoḥ kalpitaḥ saṃvibhāgaḥ || 8 || kathaṃ pratīhāramānnaparijanāvetau! | kimetat! | (katicitpadāni datvā) kiṃ punarimau krodhāvipṭāviva dṛśyete | tathāhi kapolau svedāmbhaḥkaṇakavacito dṛṣṭiramṇā vapustāmracchāyācchuritamagharau vepathumayau | pralamvaghnasyetthaṃ bhavati madayoge'pi racanā vinā krodhotsedhaṃ na punaramarārātijapinaḥ || 9 || tadupasarpāmi | (ityupasarpati) pratī -- (sapraśrayam) ayei devau rāmakṛpṇau! praṇamati yuvāmakrūraḥ | (akrūra praṇamati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sālarayamiva) āsanam | (pratīhāraḥ āsanamupanayatei) akrūraḥ -- (sapraśrayaṃ sasambhramam) kiṃ punaratra bhavatorvaimanaspamiva paśyāmi? | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sāvajñam) na kiñcit | rāmaḥ -- (saropaviśam) api akrūra! ghīrakṛpṇa eva kṛpṇaḥ | ākarṇayatu bhavān | govarddhanamacalendraṃ tṛṇalayavavuddhacaiva yaḥ kilātulapat | vīrastṛṇāya kṛpṇaṃ tameva vana manyate rukmo || 10 || akrūraḥ -- (sāścarpam) mkmī śārṅgapāṇau garvāyana iti na pratyeni hṛdayam | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sāvalepasmitam) pratīhāra! nivedaya yathāvṛttam | pratī -- iha mayā kṛpṇadeve samāgacdhchati vijūyatāṃ deva ityudīritam | tataḥ kaścidiha vahiḥsthito vandī sasaṃrambhaṃ vabhāpe | ācchāgha devabhaṇirti bhuvi bhavyabhogān re bhūbhumujo bhajata muktamudhābhimānāḥ | saraṃvdharukimaśaragocatatāṃ gatānāṃ yuṣmākamastu surasadmani devaśabdaḥ || 11 || api ca dāvāgnimāliṅgati kaḥ pramattaḥ | kṛpṇāhinā kroḍanni helayā kaḥ | prāṇāḥ priyāḥ kasya na jīvaloke ko rukimaṇaṃ ropayane raṇāya || 12 || akrūraḥ -- (sasaṃrambham) tataḥ kimukttaṃ rāmeṇa? | pratī -- pakṣcādihāyātaṃ pralambāriṇā kṛpṇavīreṇa kimanukttamāsīt | akrūraḥ -- (sautsukyam) kimuktam? | pratī -- evamuktaṃ samānaya taṃ vīraṃ samarāṅgayam | paramānandakṛddānaṃ yugapattava rukmiṇaḥ | draviṇena kṛpāṇena karipye samarāṅgaṇe || 13 || akrūraḥ -- sādhūkttaṃ kṛpṇadevena | ahaṃ punarna pratyemi murārau rukramī vairāyate | chāgo muhuvailgati gāḍhagarvakṣchgana sāddha prasaratpramodaḥ | kaṇṭhīravaṃ vīkṣya saśavdakuṇṭhaṃ ko vetti vaiklabpamupaiti kīdṛk || 14 || vandinastu vandyā eva | kinnaite ghadanti | ayi vīra śiromaṇe kṛṣṇadeva | tvardūīyamandakāndolamāsūṃte̱nāpei sadrumaḥ | vaikuṇṭhaḥ kamyate'tyarthe rukmiyāḥ paramo guruḥ || 15 || ākarṇito mayā avinayaḥ śiśupālasya | na ca vijñapayituṃ yujyate tatra prahitamiiryavadasyānāgamane | (nepayye) kaḥ ko'tra bhoḥ | nivedayata kaupiḍanapurādāgataṃ priryavadam | (pratīhāraḥ sahasopasṛtya priyaṃvadena saha praviśati) priyaṃvadaḥ -- (sahasopasṛtya) epa priyaṃghadaḥ praṇamati | akṛraḥ -- (upaviśya) nivedayatu bhavān | (priyaṃvadaḥ upaviśya tiṣṭati) akṛraḥ -- (syagatam) mukhavikāra eva vyākaroti prayojanāsiddhim | tadapi punaḥ pṛcchāmi | (prakāśam) pniyaṃvada! vijñapaya | (priyaṃvadaḥ tathaiva tūmrṇīmāste) akṛraḥ -- priyaṃvada! kiṃ na vijñapayasi? | priyaṃ -- jai viṇṇaviduṃ ucidaṃ bhodi tā kinna vinnavemi | ko maha tahā viṇpāvide dudīaṃ jīhaṃ daissadi | rāmaḥ -- (sasaṃrambham) kinna vijñapapasi yathāvṛttam?! kimiha tavaigha krimapyāgaḥ? | priyaṃ -- (sabhayam) tadavi ahaṃ na viṇṇavissaṃ | lehoyyeya eso viṇṇavedu | (iti legtramarpayati) akṛraḥ -- (vācayati) paśodāpāḥ stanyaistava tanarayāsīdupacayaṃ vanāntepu bhrāntastvamasi saha taistarṇakaśanaiḥ | yadi tvādṛkkaścidvata nṛpatiputrīṃ varapate tadānīṃ kaḥ kroghaḥ kimu na śaśiānaṃ ghāñchati śiśuḥ || 16 || priyaṃ -- esa uṇa leho sisuvāleṇa ruppiṇīkae pesido | ruppiṇāvi edaṃ kesavassa daṃsayissasitti bhaṇia maha hatthe samappido | (iti dvitīyaṃ lekhamarpayatei) akūraḥ -- (vācayati) gataḥ pupṭiṃ vālyātprabhṛti ciramābhīrabhavane tataḥ syāmidrohavyatikarasarūmahimā | savaikuṇṭhaḥ sūro yadi hṛdi vilagno'sti sutarāmakuṇṭho'smatkhaṅgastadayamapi gaṇyo'stu bhavatām || 17 || śiśupālasya prakṛtiduḥśīlasya nedamadbhutam | rukmiṇaḥ punaḥ prakṛtivaiparītyamidam | (sāścaryam) priyaṃvada! śruto bhūtāveśaḥ kimu na bhavatā tasya vipamaḥ priyaṃ -- (viddasya) lā kadhaṃ iarakajje kusalo? | akrūraḥ -- pradatto'yaṃ lekhaḥ kimu na madirāpānasamaye | preiyaṃ -- ṇa hu ṇa hu | akūraḥ -- na kṛpṇastenānyo manasi kalito bhrāntivaśataḥ | priyaṃ -- (spahāptam) avarovi kiṃ kanho balabhaddabhāduo vasudevasuo deyaīnaṃdaṇo? | akrūraḥ -- dhuvaṃ kraddhaḥ kālo vighaṭayati saduddhimacirāt || 18 || rāmḥ -- (sasaṃrambham) nahi vahati narendre kkāpi sadvīramudrārabhasarasadaridre jāṅgale lāṅgalaṃ me | upacitasukharāśiṃ caidyadehaṃ khananto phalatu kṛpiridānīṃ sādhu saṅkarpaṇasya || 19 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagataṃ saharpam) citta prasīd samupaiti manorathastvāṃ sā vallabhā'dya sulabhā'jani durlabhāpi | tyatā gṛhasthaparipāṭikadarthanā sā jāto'dhunā sapadi nandaka eva dūtaḥ || 20 || rāmaḥ -- (khaṅgamāsphālayan saharṣe sasaṃrambham) svacchandaṃ madhupānakelipu mayā svātmā sukhaṃ sthāpitaḥ prītastatra kṛto nijaḥ parijanastvaṃ vañcitaḥ kevalam | iṃho khaṅga | pitra prakāmamadhunā samyanghino rukmiṇāḥ svādusphāramahāsrapūramadirāṃ lumpāmi dopaṃ nijam || 21 || akrūraḥ -- (sahāsaṃ saropam) ayi vīraśiromaṇe rāma! śiśupālamkmiṇīpariṇaye'pi bhavatāṃ rukmī samvandhī | rāmaḥ -- (saroyaṃ sasaṃrambham) ayi akrūra! yādṛgakrūro na bhāpate tādṛgukttam | kaṃsāriḥ pariṇeppate paramapaṃ tāṃ ruvimaṇīṃ kanyakāṃ cedīndro vihariṣpyate suravadhūyargeṇā sārddhaṃ cirāt | yaghetatsamarāṅgaṇe saphalayāmyunmudradorvikramo nāmoddāmaguṇai bhavipyati paraṃ tatkāmapāleti me || 22 || api pratīhāra | dīyatāṃ samaravijayaprayāṇadundubhiḥ | pratī -- yathādiśati svāmī | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ayi rauhiṇeya! kalpāntakruddharūdrāpavādaḥ ko'yamakāṇḍe dāruṇaḥ saṃrambhaḥ | mahadidamanucitumū | kṣatasamadagajānāṃ kumbhamukttāphalauvairvitarati vanadeśe kesarī yaścatupkam |
capalacaṭakaḍimbhe dātumicchokṣcapeṭaṃ kathamiva vata lajjā tasya naiyojjihīte || 23 || rāmaḥ -- kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! tiṣṭha naipa vilambāvasaraḥ | kṣudrakṣanniyakīṭakairaviditakṣātravrataiḥ kalpitaṃ vākpāruṣpamapāvanaṃ kalayatormatkarṇayordāruṇam | prāpakṣcittavidhirbhaviṣyati dalattatkīkasollāsitā tepāṃ kaṇḍananiḥsvanena muśalairyuddhaṇodūkhale || 24 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sasaṃrambham) āḥ! kimakṛṣṇā pṛthicī yaditthamuttāmyasi | matkāraṇena guruṇā mama durmadāriphrūrākṣarakṣravaṇaduḥkhamasahyatedam | kṛṣṇo'smi cedahaha! tatparitopayipye karṇau tavotkaṭatadīyavadhūvilāsaiḥ || 25 || rāmaḥ -- (savātsalyam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇā! maivam | śāstrāstravighāsu na vāliśo'si tathāpi me keśava! vāliśo'si | tyāṃ rukimaṇīpaṇinipīḍanāya varaṃ na yoddhāramahaṃ kariṣye || 26 || akrūraḥ -- (saharpam) nandantu yādavāḥ, yadi ddhepinippepāya rāmakṛṣpṇāvitthaṃ kṛtapratijñau | rāmaḥ -- (sāvegam) akrūra! samākarṇaya vairivadhavilamvāsahaṃ mama duṣpkaraṃ niyamm | ddasārātikṣatajamadirāsatradātuḥ śivābhyo yāvannāspa praṇamati padau keśavo rukmaṇī ca | prāṇebhyo'pi pripataraguṇāṃ sammadādvaitakatrī hālāṃ hālāhalamigha halī manyatāṃ tāvadepaḥ || 27 || akūraḥ -- ahaha! duṣkaraḥ kṛto rāmeṇa niyamaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ -- āḥ! kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭam || kimakāṇḍe naḥ kaṣṭamaṅgīkṛtamāryeṇa | atrkūra! tadidānāṃ prātareyāstu prayāṇotsavaḥ | akrūraḥ -- evamevāstu | sampati hi pratīcīprayāṇotsuko varttate gabhastimālī| (nepaśye) yāmānimānkatipayānaparāmburāśisaudhasthito gamaya mīlitaraśimanetraḥ| sṛrya! prasīd punarabhyudyādhirūḍhaḥ prahādayiṣyasi jagannavakāntikāntaḥ || 28 || rāmaḥ -- (śrutvā saharpam) aho! sadupaśrutiḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ -- upaśrutyā prabodhito'smi | tadehi bhavane yāminīmetāṃ samara rgalāmativāhayāvaḥ (iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve) prathamo'ṅkaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ -- (puro'valokya) kadhaṃ eso devoe redhadīe sovidallo adhayadīvao idomuhaṃ parikkamadi| tā jāṇemi imādo reghadīramaṇabuttantaṃ | (upasṛtya) ayya dīvaa! eso piyaṃvado paṇamadi | dī̱pakaḥ -- daityā̱riprasādabhājanaṃ bhūyāḥ | priyaṃ -- ayyadīvaa | paḍivuddho baladevo? | dī̱pakaḥkadā prasupto valadevaḥ? | priyaṃ -- (sasambhrama sāścaryaim) aho! koyasamāveso mahāvīrassa | tā kiṃ samaggaṃ ghyeva jāmiṇiṃ jāgarido | dīpakaḥ bhattānsallya kuñjarānharivarānparyāṇayojjāgarānśauryasyāvahasaro'dya tiṣṭata bhaṭāḥ kaṣṭaṃ kka naṣṭā dvipaḥ | utsvapnāyitabhaṅgibhirmukharitaḥ krūrābhirābhirmuhuḥ krodhotsedhamahantarayaviralāṃ nidrāṃ sipeve valaḥ || 1 || priyaṃ -- kahiṃ puṇa apyo patthido? | dī̱pakaḥprevitosmi prayāṇārambhāya baladevena devakīnandanasakāśam| priyaṃ -- ahaṃ uṇa kāmavālaṃ āṇeḍhuṃ kaṇheṇa pesidomhi!ciṭṭadi kanho uddhavaakkūrasañcaisahido sahārmaḍavammi | tā edu ayyo | sahidayyeva valabhaddavaṇaṃ gacchamha| dīpakaḥ -- kroghanaḥ pralamvāristadahaṃ yathādiṣṭaṃ sampādayāmi | tvamapi nijaniyorga sampādaya | (iti niṣkrāntau) viprakambhakaḥ (tataḥ praviśati sabhāmaṇḍape yathānirdiṣṭaḥ kṛṇṇaḥ) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagtaṃ sotkapṭhaṃ saropam) ahahad! taralayataḥ smararopau durmadaripumadanakeliramaṇīyau | māṃ pāṇipoḍanavidhau rukimaṇyā asilatāyāśca || 2 || api ca aho! madanaprabhāvayaibhavam | śrutiparicayamātrāccārunetrā priyā sā hadamapi gṛhītvā kimkaraṃ māṃ karoti | yadayamadayayuddonmardalīlāraso'pi sphurati tadanurodhādeva vidvepipepī || 3 || tadeyaṃ tāyat | (prakāśaṃ sakrogham) ayi sumantriṇaḥ! kimucyate yuṣmāsu | dambholirutpalapalāśamṛdustadagre yairakripanta paramāṇucayaibhaivantaḥ | tairddasavairiparupākṣaratīkṣṇaṭaṅkairyepāmaphāri gṛṭdayepu na ko'pyupādhiḥ || 4 || sātyakiḥ -- (gtāvajñam) ayei janārdana! vijñapayāmi | ye kecinmadayegalupsamanayo ye yātaghātṛlitā ye garvagrahalaṅghittā vikṛtikṛtṭṭadvaḥ sa yebhyo yamaḥ | tepāṃ kī pumpākṣarepu gaṇanā hāmaḥ paraṃ yujyate durvṛttocitadaṇṭapātanavighau kastepu dolāyate || 5 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saharpam) tadidārnīṃ kiṃ vilamvena? | uddhavaḥ -- (saminam) kṛpṇā! kimītsukyena? | darpotphaṭāḥ pratibhaṭārūnvayi samyugvīne, yāsyanti krinnu parihatya raṇotsavaṃ te | kiṃ tepu te nayanagocaratāṃ gatepu vandhyo bhaviṣyati śarāsana epa śārṅgaḥ || 6 || atrkūraḥ -- (sapraśrayam) api devakīnandana! kiṃ cedirājanagarāya kimuta kauṇḍinapurāya dīyatāṃ prayāṇamiti saṃśathāndhakāre bhavatu devasya mhotsāhaviśepaḥ | (dīpakaḥ praviśya) dīpakaḥ -- (sapragābhaṃ sapraśrayam) deva! prepito'smi rāmeṇa kauṇḍinapurāya prayāṇakaṃ kārayitum | (kṛṣpṇaḥ sasmitamakrūramukhamīkṣate) atrkūraḥ -- bhadra dīpaka | vijñapaya gatvā valadecamihāgamanāya | siddhamevaitat | kṛṣṇaḥ -- prepita eva mayā tatra meirpavadaḥ | priyaṃ -- (praviśya) deva! āgado esa samararaṇaraṇañajāgareṇa kahṛkahavi gamidajāmiṇīsamaoo rāmavīro | (tataḥ praviśati rāmaḥ) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sasagbhramam) āsanamāsanamatrabhavate | (priyaṃvad āptanamupanayati | rāmaḥ sarvānyapecitaṃ sambhāvyopaviśati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (rāmaṃ vibhāvya svagataṃ saharpar) vighvastaritrapurīpurīparivṛḍhaḥ prāptaiva sā rukimaṇī rukamī sopi nirākṛnāhavabharaḥ klaivyaikapātraṃ kṛnaḥ | itthaṃsiddhamivāvagatya rucitaṃ bāḍhaṃ manaḥ prīyate ddaṣṭvoṃtsāhacibhūṣaṇaṃ vapuridaṃ tphāraṃ pralamvadruhaḥ || 7 || uddhavaḥ -- (saharpākṣcarye svagatam) aho | sarvātiśāyitā vīrāṇām |
tathāhi dṛṣṭe vale valīyasi saṅkamati śauryemasmadāghe'pi | galahasnita iva sahasā niṣkrāmatyupaśamo hṛdayāt || 7 ||
rāmḥ -- (saropopahāptam) ayi mantriṇaḥ!| kimadyāpi mantrayante bhavanta? | adhavā vegāduccāṭayantī suciramupacitaṃ kṣātradharmaprarohaṃ kiṃ stutyo mantraśaktiḥ sphurati nirupamā kāpi sanmantriṇāṃ vaḥ | krodhāgnistambhikā yā danujadamayiturmānasaṃ mohayantī dṛptakṣmānāthanārīnayanayugajalasnambhamāvipkaroti || 9 || uddhavaḥ -- (sāvakṣahāsam) ayi rāma! vairivarga eva vijṛmbhatāṃ bhavataḥ prakopaḥ | iha sampradhāritameva prayāṇam | priyaṃvada! āhuyantāṃ mauharttikāḥ | rāmaḥ -- (sopahāsam) kimanena mudhā vistareṇa | sarve grahāḥ prasannā nandakamuṣṭigrahānukūlyena | āyāso gaṇakānāṃ mithyā grahagaṇitavisnāraiḥ || 10 || api ca vyonni prahitya muśalaṃ grahamaṇḍalīṃ tāmāvartya sādhu ghaṭayāmi tathā yathā''ttha | uñcāvacasthitiviparyayato'nukṛlā sampādayipyati samīhitasiddhimeva || 11 || uddhavaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ayi pralamvāre! gharmoddhārāya kṛnāvatārā bhaghantastanmaivam| siddhayanti kāmā valināṃ valena lokasthitiḥ kintu na laṅghanīyā | dṛṣṭayaiva saṃharttumalaṃ girīśaḥ śannucchide snnayati triśūlam || 12 || rāmaḥ -- (sotsāham) ayi āṅgirasaśiāpya sarvajñaśiromaṇe! ahameva tava mantragarti saphalīpharomi | ānaya mauharttikān, pariniṣṭīyatāṃ vivāhalagram | āmukttakaṅkaṇabhujo madhukaiṭabhāriratraiva tiṣṭhatu vivāhadinapratīkṣaḥ | vīreṇa tena sahasā saha rukimaṇaiva tāṃ rukimaṇīmahamihaiva samānayāmi || 13 || uddhavaḥ -- api rāma! maivaṃ maivam | vātāndolacalācalaghvajapaṭakṣreṇīmilanmaṇḍape siñjanotkadadundubhidhvanimaye saṅgāmalīlāṅgaṇe | udvāhaṃ vijayaśriyaḥ kṣitibhujāmagre gurūṇāṃ hariḥ kṛtvā bhīṣmakaputrikāpariṇayaṃ paścātkariṣdayatyasau || 14 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sapsaṃrambhaṃ sopahāptam) yujyana eva jyeṣṭhasya valadevasya| tathāhi aripṭasya dhvaṃsaḥ kapaṭahayakeśipramathanaṃ sa cāṇūracchedasnadapi mathurānāthadalanam | iti svalpoghoge nikapitabhujaṃ dāruṇanare dayālustālāṅka kathamiva raṇe yojayati mām || 15 || rāmaḥ -- (saharṣahāptam) ayi mantriṇaḥ! manaḥkuṭīre madhukaiṭabhārerabhyudyataḥ kroghahutāśano'yam | ihaiva durvuddhisamidbhirāstāṃ prayāṇamāṅgalyavighānahomaḥ || 16 || api madhukaiṭabhāre!taduttiṣṭhābhivādya pinarau vijayaprayāṇāya sajñībhavāvaḥ| (tataḥ praviśati vasudevo devakī pratihārī ca) pratī -- ido ido edu devo, ido ido edu devī | rāmaḥ -- (vilokya saharpam) ayi kṛpṇa! kṛṣṇa! paśya paśya smaraṇamātrādevopasthitau pitarau | tadanena sunimittena manorathasiddhimapi tava drāgabhimukhīṃ vibhāvayāmi | tadubhyuttiṣṭhāvahe tāvatpitarau | (i̱yutyāya nāṭayena praṇamataḥ) vasudevaḥ -- (ubhau śirasyāghrāya) ayi rāmakṛpṇau! na jāne kimāśāse bhavatoḥ | bhūyāstāṃ samastamanorathapātraṃ bhavannau | devakī -- ajarā ajeā aho nu maha puttaā | (uddhavādyāḥ tapambhramamutthāya praṇamanti | prartīhārīṃ priyaṃvadā cāsanānyupanayataḥ | sarve yathocitamupaviśanti) kṛpṇaḥ -- (svagataṃ saharpokiṇṭham) etāṃ vilokya jananīṃ sahajojjihānavātsalyamuddhaṭayate kamapi pramodam | janmāntarairupacitāmiva tāṃ yaśodāsnehasthirti nanu tadapyavajetumīṣṭe || 17 || rāmaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) kimādiśanti guravaḥ? | (vasudevo devakī mukhamīkṣate) devakī -- ayi rāma! kanhavivāhatthaṃ gamismadha koṇḍinapuram | bhodu maha nanaṃdāe naṃdaṇo visamasarāhiṭṭāṇaṃ rattaṃbaramaṃḍido paramasuhabhāaṇaṃ | rāmaḥ -- (sākūtasmitam) ayi kṛppā! pranīccha pitrorādeśam | kṛpṇaḥ -- śirasi vaddhāñjaliṃ siddhamimamādeśāṃ manyantāṃ pādāḥ | udhdravaḥ -- (apavārya) ayi sātyake! api akrūra! granthau vadhnantu bhacanto devyā devakyā nideśṭhām | ayi rāma! kṛpṇavivāhāya kaupiḍanapuraṃ gacchata | bhavatu mama tatra nanāndṭanandanaḥ -- (ityaddhokttau smitaṃ nāṭayati) akrūrasātyakī -- tiṣṭatu tiṣṭatu | alaṃ vyākhyayā | devakī -- (saharpam) ayi vijaye! gaccha samāṇesu śiśupāladūaṃ | pratī -- jaṃ devī āṇavedi | (iti nipkramya tena saha praviśati) devakī -- (saharṣam) api saṃdhāṇaa! uñasappa kanhaṃ sarāmaṃ | sandhānakaḥ -- jayadu jayadu rāmeṇā samaṃ kaṇho | suhalakkhaṇasaṃpuṇṇaṃ aṇurattaṃ raaṇasāliaṃ edaṃ| aidullahamavarerhi ronha tumaṃ kaṇha! naravaḍaṇo || 18 || (iti māṇikyamālāmupanayati | kṛpṇo nāṭayena gṛṇhāti) devakī -- vijaye āsaṇaṃ saṃdhāṇañassa | sātyakiḥ -- (apavārya) mantriśiromaṇe uddhava! akrūra! jīne anena vacanopanpāsena ratnamālāsamānayanena ca hastagatā hareḥ saṃvṛttā rukmiṇī | uddhavākrūrau -- (saharpollāsam) sādhu sādhu! evamevaitat | (nepayye) āsūtritāmahaha! kṛpṇakṛte kimetāṃ tvaṃ mālatīṃ spṛśasi pāṇitalena mohāt | dhigghikapramādyasi mudhaiva vipatpravedādvāraṃ janā anucitācaraṇaṃ vadanti || 19 || uddhavaḥ -- (saharpam) aye! bodhayati sadupaśrutiriyaṃ śiśupāladūtaṃ, yadi paraṃ jānīte | rāmaḥ -- (saropamiva) priyaṃvada! jñāyatāṃ ko'yaṃ kasya mā jihīrpati | priyaṃvadaḥ -- (niṣkramya punaḥ praviśya mālatīmālāṃ kṛṣṇāyopaḍhaukayan) kanhaeva! genha genha | esā khu mālaīmālā tuha kae mālāāreṇa uaṇiyyamāṇā keṇavi gahidumīhitā | puṇo so mālāñāracaṃḍavaāṇāhikkhivido palāido | (rāmaḥ sākūtaṃ vihasya uddhavādīnālokatte) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagataṃ saharṣam) sarvasvaṃ kusumepoḥ kāmapyānandasampadaṃ dadhatī | sā rukimaṇīyamāgānmama karakamalaṃ na mālatīmālā || 20 || uddhavaḥ -- (saharpam) ayi kṛpṇadeva! vivāhayātrārambhasamayasamāga -- teyai mālatomālā sunimittassṛcikā | paridhīyatāṃ drāgiyamavyayā | (kṛṣṇaḥ saharpa tayā karoti) vasudevaḥ -- ayi sanghānaka! kadā punarvivāhotsayaḥ? | sandhānakaḥ -- ihayyeve māhave vivāho bhavissaditti bhaṇami | uddhavaḥ -- (sākūtam) satyamākhyāti sandhānakaḥ | rāmaḥ -- (sākūtasmitam) ayi kṛpṇa! kimadyāpi ghilamvate | vaiśākha eva rukimaṇīvivāhaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ -- api sandhānaka! nivedaya cedīśvarāya | āgatā eva vayaṃ vivāhapratyāsattau kauṇḍinapuram | akrūraḥ -- kośādhyakṣānsamādiśya dattapāritopikaṃ prepaya sandhānakam | sandhānakaḥ -- ayi deca kanha! kaha ṇu deviṃ devaī pariccaia gado tattha uccarāmi? | devakī -- saṃdhāṇaa! rāmakanhā varapattiā āaṇṇia piucchāe bhavissadi parioso | kiṃ mae | sandhā -- tā ihayyeva vahū tuha pāavaṃdaṇanthaṃ āgamissadi | sātyakī -- ko'tra vipratipadyate | etadeva vadhūgṛham | vayadevaḥ -- vayameva sandhānakaṃ dattapāritopikaṃ visarjayāmaḥ | bhavantaḥ sajjībhavantu prātaḥprayāṇāya | vijaye! ādiśa panthānam | pratī -- ido ido devo, ido ido devī (iti niṣkāmataḥ) (nepaṭaye) udapati madalakṣmīrdantino'supya sadhaḥ samiti piśunayantī vairivargasya bhaṅgam | madhuripuvarayātrāsatvaraḥ sīrapāṇiḥ kathamiva phalamasyāḥ prāpsyati vyagracetāḥ || 21 || rāmaḥ -- (samākaṇrya saharṣamucaiḥ) ayi'hastipaka! sādhu sādhu diṣṭayā vṛttā mama dantino madakṣrīḥ | mā vipīda | bhavipyati phalamasyāḥ | nahi nahi varayātrā kevalaṃ komaleyaṃ raṇabhuvi bhavitnāro'mutra romāñcakārāḥ | samadaripunarendrasthūlavakṣaḥsthalāsthikrathanakaṭuravāste dantidantaprahārāḥ || 22 || athi kṛpṇa! tadrayaṃ sarve'pi nijanijabhavanaṃ gatvā prayāṇāya sajjībhavāmaḥ | (iti nipkrāntāḥ sarve) dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśati subuddhiḥ) subuddhiḥ -- (dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasya) ahaha! sukaṣṭaḥ kanyakābhāvaḥ| tathāhi hṛdayaṃ madanāyattaṃ vapurāyattaṃ ca gurujanasyaiva | maraṃṇaṃ daivā̱yattaṃ kathaṃ na sīdanlu kulakanyāḥ || 1 || aho! me suvuddherdvaryundvitvaṃ, yadahaṃ svātmārāmasvairavihārahariṇī kaśamalamanupyapremāṅkuralālasā svayameva mohapāśe ātmānaṃ pātitavatī | tadidānīṃ ruvimaṇīprāṇātyaye sakalaṅkaṃ me jīvitam | sakalaṅkā bhavānīmantropadeśaśaktiḥ | ipameva cārgalā rukmiṇīprāṇānāṃ yadatra varayātrāvyapadeśenāpi kṛpṇāgamanam | śārada ivaipa dicasaḥ sukhayati śopapati rukmiṇīmaniśam | kṛpṇaghanāgamaśiśiraḥ śiśupālakharātapaḥ krūraḥ || 2 || (dviśo vimāvya | syitvā camatkṛtya)āḥ! kka nu prasthinnāsmi |(savailakṣyam) kathaṃ rukmiṇīmandirāya prasthināyā mama padānyanyataḥ pravṛttāni! | (nirūpya) bhavatvanenaiva pathā vrajāmi | ayameva hi dhātreyikāyāḥ suvatsalāyā rukmiṇībhavanagamanāya panthāstadiha mā kadācihuḥkhasaṃvibhāgāya sāpi me milati | (tataḥ praviśati suvatsalā) suvatsalā -- bhaavadi suvuddhie! karhi uṇa turidapadaṃ parikkamasi | paḍivālesu ma | subuddhiḥ -- (parivṛtyāvalokya) kathaṃ pṛṣṭataḥ sameti suvatsalā! (tthitvā) ehi vatse! ehi | suva -- milidamhi | caladu caladu idāṇiṃ bhaavadī | kahiṃ uṇa gammai? | sucuddhiḥ -- (dīrve niṃ,śvasya) kutryānyatra? | suva -- ruppiṇīe bhavaṇaṃ patthidā bhaavadī? | (sāsram) bhaavadi! tuha suyuddhittaṇaṃ maha suvacchalattaṇaṃ pi visaṃvaditaṃ | …… ruppiṇīe dolādhirūdvabva dolaha jīvidāsā | sucuddhiḥ -- anumaraṇe'pi visaṃvaditaṃ mama suvuddhitvaṃ, na tu tava suyatsalātvam | suva -- bhaavadi! jaṃ tuha viyuddhivihao mantasattīvi visaṃvadai taṃ ruppiṇīe duddaivaṃ avarajjhadi | kanho uṇa ruppiṇiṃ parihavissaditti ṇa maha hiaaṃ pattiāadi | bhaavadīe vi tattha kanhapariaṇādo edaṃ vididaṃ yeva jāvaccia harihiae ruppiṇiṇāmaṃti akakharo manto | saṃcario tāvaccia uvvasiaṃ iaradaiāhi || 3 || tā naṃdañasahāattaṇeṇavi sahalā bhavissadi bhaavadoe mantasattī | sucuddhiḥ -- suvatsale! ehi tāvadāśvāsayāmo vatsām | suvatsalā -- bhaavadi! tīe āsāsaṇatthaṃ pesidaṃ maha maaraṃdiāhatthe kanhassa ālekkhaṃ | tā edu bhaavadī | kanhasiviraṃ gadua alakkhidā savvaṃ jāṇiaṃ turidamughasappamha ruppiṇi | sughuddhiḥ -- suvatsale! adyāpi padi tvamitthaṃ sotsāhāsi, taṭṭahāṇa lakmiṇīsanāthamālekhyaṃ | yena kṛpṇo vilobhyate | suvatsalā -- tā imiṇā maggeṇa surehaṃ cittaaraṃ ālekkhasaṇāhaṃ nanhia gamissāmo | (iti niśykrānte) vipkambhakaḥ (tata praśiti kṛpṇalestyavyagrahastā rukmiṇī makarandikā ca) rukmiṇī -- (sānutāpaṃ ni śvasya) ṇṛṇaṃ mae jammantare caṃdaseharassa paḍighivaṃ yeva ārāhidaṃ, jaṃ eassa suhaassa ālekkhametteṇaṃ yeva maṃ haavihī vippaāredi | sahi maaraṃdie! cukkā bhaavadī suvuddhī suvacchalā a, jaṃ tārhi ṇa kāvi tattha solahasahassamajjhe govī tāiṃ avbhatthidā jehiṃ kanhassa piattaṇaṃ pāvīadi | (ni śvamya) ahavā daivahadāe maha dīṇāttaṇamiṇaṃ | ṇahu bhaggāiṃ diṇṇāiṃ honti | tā edaṃ yeva abhālekkhaṃ avianhaṃ vihāvemi (iti tathā karoti) makarandikā -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) suṭṭhu uttammadi bhaṭṭidāriā | tā kahiṃ vilaṃvidā sā ṇiākkaruṇā bhaavado sucuddhiā suvacchalā a | (tata. praviśati subuddhiḥ suvatsalā ca) suvuddhiḥ -- (rukmiṇīṃ vibhāvya apavārya) api sucatsale! kṛpṇālekhpalīnamānasā runkmiṇī na paśyatyāvām | tadehi makarandikāṃ sanñjñayā nivārya nibhṛtamasyāḥ pṛṣṭe bhavāvaḥ | (iti tayā tiṣṭhata) (vibhāya sāścaryam) aho! abhiniveśaniviḍatā rukmiṇyāḥ| tathāhi muhurniḥśvāsānāṃ parimalataraṅgepu taralaṃ muhurlīlāmbhoje śravapākamale cārpitapadam | na lolākṣī vetti bhramaramavirāmadhvanibharaṃ murārerālekhye layamayamanā nirbharamiyam || 4 || rukmiṇī -- (ālekhyamavalophayantī sotkṇṭham) dhaṇṇāo tāo govīo jāo maaṇumhākaramvidāo eassa suhaassa imassiṃ lāaṇṇadīhiāammi viharanti | (nirūpya dīrghamuṣpṇa ca ni śvamya) kudo esa eāriso amhā risirhi (ityardhokttau ptāsraṃ sagadgadam) aha hiaa! pasia viramasu dullahapemmeṇa kiṃ nu vinaḍesi | caṇahariṇīe hasijjai maaṃkahariṇammi aṇurāo || 5 || sucuddhiḥ -- (sasambhramamutthāya rukmiṇyāścibukamunnamayya) vatse rukmiṇi! kimapayasaste gurujano yaditthamuttāmyasi | rukmiṇī -- (svagataṃ savailakṣyam)kathamihaivāsīdbhagavatī!| (prakāśam)bhaavadi! tumaṃ vancia guruaṇo yyeva me dujvaṇo | subuddhiḥ -- (sotsāham) bhavatu yaḥ kopi yathā tathā | gṛhītaigha ca tena śārṅgapāṇinā pāṇinā | vatse suvatsale! kinna nivedayasi vatsāyāḥ | suvatsalā -- (purato bhūtvā) vacche ruppiṇi! kiṃ kaāvi bhaavadī aliālāviṇī | māṇidaṃ sumuhuttaṃ | gahidāsi ālekkhagadā hariṇā pāṇinā | saṃpai ṇiapāṇigahidocidaṃ harī ṇivvāhaissadi | rukmiṇī -- (svagataṃ saharpam) hiaa! samassasa samassasa | saṃmuhaṃ va tuha dīsadvi dviṭṭavaṃ | 'subuddhiḥ -- (sohāsam) kiṃ na pratyeti vatsā, tadanenaivālekhyagatena gṛhītāsi pāṇinā śauriṇā | (iti kṛṣṇacitrapaṭakena yārṇi grāhayati) (nepatheye dundubhirudañcati) suvatsalāmakarandike -- (saddarpe) aho! suṇimittaṃ suṇimittam | subuddhiḥ -- na khalusunimittamātram| idānīṃ sa evānena saudhatalavartmanā purapraveśśaṃ govindaḥ karipyati | te'pi śiśupālādayaḥ | dṛṣṭo'smābhirabhyutthānāyopasarpanmahārājo bhīṣmako mahākumāraruvikmapramukhānvitaḥ|
(nepayye) ayi paurāḥ! 'paurakanyakāḥ! samādiśati vo mahārājaḥ majjībhaghata maṅgalakautukepu | praviśanti nagaraṃ garīyāṃso rājānaḥ | makarandikā -- (sautsukyam) `bhaavadi suvuddhi! iha tae imiṇā kanhassa ālekkheṇa pāṇiggahaṇaṃ kāridaṃ | tattha uṇa bhaṭṭidāriāe ālekkheṇa duvevi ede ekkaṭhāṇagade pekikhaduṃ me koūhallaṃ | tā ettha cittavaḍe kanhasamīvammi bhaṭṭidāriaṃ ālihisasaṃ | suvuddhiḥ -- (vihasya) kastava kutṛhalinastaralatvaṃ vārayati | manoratho 'yaṃpunaḥ sākṣātkāreṇāpi pratyāsanna eva | (makarandikā nāṭayenālikhya citrapaṭa kare karoti) (nepathye kalakala) suva -- 'bhaavadi! pañcāsannā purappavesasammuhā mahīṇāhā, jaṃ esa niaḍado duṃdubhijhuṇī suṇoadi | makara -- (sautsukyam) bhaṭṭidārie! tā edha uaritalaṃ sauhasiharaṃ āruhia gavakkhantare pecchāmo |) rukmiṇī -- (svagataṃ saharpam) sāhu maaraṃdie! sāhu | (prakāśaṃ sāvahityama) yahā bhaavadī bhaṇadi | subuddhiḥ -- kriyatāmidam | (ityutthāya sarvāstathā kurvanti) makara -- (gavākṣajālāntareṇa vilokya)pecchadha pecchadha pavisanti ṇaravaiṇo | (sarvā vilokayanti) makara -- (vilokya saharṣāścaryam)
piasahi! kassa sarīraṃ rehai gholantacāmaraṃ eaṃ | kaṃddodṛkāṇaṇaṃ piva marālamālāhiṃ saṃvaliñaṃ || 6 || suva -- (nirūpya) pecchagha pecchagha | eso so govīsahassamaṇamohaṇo mahumahaṇo rahārūḍho samedi | rukmiṇī -- (sautmukyamālokya) ayi loaṇā!jassa suhugassa guṇagaṇāmaaṃ ghoṭṭantesu saṃvaṇesu īsāluāṇamba tumhāṇaṃ daṃsaṇatanhā pavaṭṭidā taṃ avianhaṃ idaṇiṃ yahicchaṃ pecchaha | muhuttamettammi genhada dāva jammaphalaṃ | ko jāṇadi kīsa pharissadi aggado bhayavaṃ paāvaī | (tataḥ praviśati saudhatale rathārūdaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ priyaṃvadakṣca) makara -- (sautsukyam) diṭṭiā gavakkhaṃtarapalambidavalluapuvvaphāā pecchāmi | (sapratyabhijñam) eso so piaṃvado jo taiā ittha āgaduākaakajjo gado | suva -- (ruvimarṇī vibhānya svagatam)ṇa hu ṇa hu pahuṣpai igha saṃkaṃdṛmmi gavavamyantare kanhāloaṇatanhā | tā eyaṃ dāva | (prakāśam) ai maaraṃdie! iaragavakgvantare peccha tumaṃ | pecchadu idha vacchā jahicrcha ruppiṇī | makara -- evaṃ bhodu | (makarandiphāyā gapākṣādapakrāmandayāḥ karatalāñcitrapaṭaḥ patati | priya -- kanhaeva!genha edaṃ tuha pharakamale kamalasaṇāhekiṃpi ṇiyaḍidaṃ| kṛṣṇaḥ -- (gṛhītvā vimāvya) kathaṃ rukmiṇīrūpakasanāthaṃ madīyarūpakālekhyamidam | priyaṃvada | paśṭraya paśya | priyaṃ -- (citrapaṭaṃ naiirūpya) deva! tuha ālekkhasamīve ruppiṇī esā ālihidā | kiṃ viharasi harihatthe maha karakamalassa avasaro ettha | ia tua pārṇi pattā esā kanalaṃ vadhāḍeha || 7 || (saudhamālokya prayābhijñāya saharpellasam) kanhaeva! ruppiṇīe edaṃ sohaṃ | ṇūṇamiṇaṃ ruppirṇohatthādo pavbhaṭṭhaṃ | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sotkaṣṭhamūbbai saudhāgraprahitarlocano rukmiṇīṃ gavākṣalamvinamukhī vilokya pratyabhijñāya saharpotkaṣṭam) nūnaṃ skeimaṇīyaṃ, saṃvadatyālekhyam | (nirdarṇya) uparacitakalaṅkaṃ kuntalairlamvamānaiḥ kanakarucikapolaṃ kauṅkumībhiḥ prabhābhiḥ | udayagiridarīnaḥ prollasadvimvamindoranuharati sudatyāḥ pīnalāvaṇyamāsyam || 8 || (rukmiṇī sanīḍamāsyamākuñcayati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (ptānutāpaṃ dīrvamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥkṣvasya) upopitaḥ śāradacandraghimbe cakṣukṣcakoraḥ prajighāya tūrṇam | kapṭaṃ vidhirniṣkaruṇāsvabhāvaḥ pidhānamutpāṭayate ghanena || 9 || rukmiṇī -- (svagataṃ sānutāpam) haalajje amha guruaṇādo ahiaṃ tumaṃ ṇikkaruṇā, jaṃ tae daṃsaṇamettammi piñassa suhaassa vigghidaṃ | subuddhiḥ -- vatse skmiṇi! kiṃ punarapasṛtāsi | rukmiṇī -- (sanrīismimatam) maaraṃdiāhatthādo cittavaḍaṃ ṇivaḍidaṃ gahiūṇa (sagadgadam) keṇavi uddhamurha puloidaṃ | subuddhiḥ -- (sasmitaṃ gavākṣe vikṣya apasṛtya sāśaṅkam) samgrati sarvāsāmanavasaraḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | āyāto mahārājabhīpmakaḥ kṛppagapurataḥ | (tata praviśati rathārūḍho bhīpmakaḥ) bhīṣmakaḥ -- (kṛpṇaṃ nirūpya svagataṃ sānutāpam) idaṃ rūpamidaṃ śauryamidaṃ śīlamidaṃ vayaḥ | rukmīo kṛpṇamanukrāmatrukmiṇīṃ hatavānhaṭhāt || 10 || (nepathye sopaddāsam) vālaḥ kumāro'pamaho marālīṃ pārāvatāyārpayati prasahya | epā punarmanmathamantharāṅgī marālamevākṣrayate javena || 11 || bhīṣmakaḥ -- (svagatam) aye! kenāpi kumārakroḍāmupahasatā sadupaśrutiriyaṃ vyāhṛtā samvodhayati mām | ka punaretadathaisya sambhavaḥ | athavā durvijñeyā daivagatiḥ | (nepayye) ayi vandinaḥ! paṭhata paṭhata rājñāṃ kṛte maṅgalāśipaḥ | vandī -- (sagarvaharṣam) vibhraddostambhadaidhrya dviyadavanibhujāṃ kharvayangarvamudrāṃ hastanyastograśāṅgaiścaraṇakamalayoḥ kṣiptadṛptapravoraḥ | unmīlaccakadhāraḥ sanatavighaṭitāmartyakāntāścadhāro rājā vāṃ pātu yuṣpmāndaladalitamahādaityaghṛndo mukundaḥ || 12 || api ca jayati ghaṭitastairddambholerhariḥ paramāṇubhirvinayavimukhakṣoṇīnāthapramāthavidhitsayā | niviḍanidhiḍaṃ lāghaṇyaudhairbhṛto vidhinā'thavā sajalajaladaśyāmaḥ śyāmāmanoharaṇākṣamaḥ || 13 || subuddhiḥ -- (śruravāsvagatam)alaṃ manaḥśabdena | śyāmāharaṇakṣama eva bhavatu | bhīṣmakaḥ -- (svagataṃ tiāśaṅkam) aye!kimapi sābhiprāya iva vandī paṭhati | kiṃcidaḍuritakrodhā rājānaḥ | tadgragrata eva nītvā kṛpṇamāvāsayāmi tāvat | (prakāśam) ayi kṛpṇadeva! imāṃ rathyāṃ kṛnārthayatā bhavatā samalaṅkiyatāṃ śivirasanniveśaḥ | ayi sārathe! pravarttaya ratham | ahamanucaro bhavāmi | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) yathā rocate'trabhavate! dāruka! pravarttaya ratham | (iti niṣkrāmati) bhīṣmakaḥ -- (sthitvā) kathaṃ sumantharaḥ śiśupālarathaḥ| kathamayamāyātyeva śiśupālāgrato rukmī | tadahaṃ kṛṣṇamevānuyāmi | (iti niṣkrāntaḥ) (tataḥ praviśati śiśupālo rukmī ca) rukmī -- (sahapoṭṭhāptaṃ pārśvamavachekya) ayi vandin! kiṃ na paṭhasi mahīmahendraṃ cedīndram | vandī -- (sagarvamuccaiḥkāram) vicitrāmutpannāṃ vikṛtimiva tāṃ janmasamaye vihāyāste yadyapyaparanaratulyo'yamadhunā | virūpākṣo yuddhe tadapi vahuvāhuḥ smaraharo narendrairārādhyo jayati damaghopasya tanayaḥ || 14|| sucuddhiḥ -- (śrutvā sautsukyam) sarvāḥsametā dṛśyatāṃ gavākṣeṇa śiśupālaḥ | (iti tayā kurvanti) suvatsalā -- bhañavadi! kā uṇa edassa jammasamañammi viido āsi | subuddhiḥ -- eyamanuśrūyate | caturvāhustrinetro'yamutpannaḥ | kṛṣṇasyāsya kroḍe praveiṣṭo dvivāhurddhinetro vabhūva | kṛpṇaḥ kilāsyāntakaro bhavipyatīti tadā daivavidbhirādiṣṭam | rukmiṇī -- (sabhayam) bhaayadi! kiṃ esa rakkhaso kovi? | subuddhiḥ -- evameva | rukmiṇī -- bhaavadi!vevadi maha hiaaṃ, tā ṇa idha ciṭṭhissaṃ| (iti vepūmānā apasaratei) subuddhiḥ -- (savātsalyam) vatse rukmiṇī! kimevamudvigrāvepase?| kuto bhayaṃ madhukaiṭabhārivallabhāyāḥ? | rukmiṇī -- (sāsram) api bhaunavadi! suṭṭu bhodammi | ṇa jāṇe kiṃ kiṃ idha bhavissadi | kaha maha haāsāe ṇivvahaṇaṃ bhavissadi! subuddhiḥ -- (rukmiṇyāścibukamunnamayya) vatse! samāśvasihi samāśvasihi | nirvahaṇonmukhastava manorathaḥ | kimahaṃ dāmbhikā, kimassatyā? | śīghrā mantrasiddhiḥ | kiṃ tvayi mandānurāgo mukundo mandaśattirvā? | etāvatyapi kaṣṭasaṅkaṭe durvinotena bhrātrā rukmiṇā pātitāsi | śiśupālaḥ -- (svagata sotkaṇṭha sānutāpaṃ samantato'valokya) ahaha vṛthāgha vabhūyāsmākaṃ nagaravihārakutūhalena | tathāhi iha nagaramṛgākṣyo vīkṣitā eva vahnayaḥ kkacidapi na sa dṛpṭo rukmiṇovakracandraḥ | dhavalabhavanamālāminduśūnyāmiva dyāṃ pariharati cakorasyeva cakṣurmamārttam || 15 || ahaha! samaropamardamarditānekaripupravīraṃ māmapi kiṅkarīkaroti kusumā yudhaḥ | athavā saundaryasaraiva na rukmiṇī sā śaurye'pi tasyāḥ paramaḥ prakarpaḥ | valena yasyāḥ kusumāyudho māṃ cedīndramunmathya vaśīkaroti || 16 || (nepathye) bhavati suyuddhike! ādiṣṭo'smi devyā yathā kila bhavatā bhagavatīṃ suburddhi vijñappa veivāhapūrvakālācāraprāptendrāṇīpūjārthaṃ vatsā rukmiṇī tvaritaṃ devāyatanaṃ prāpayitavyā | tadatrabhagavatī rukmiṇīmādāya sametu | subuddhiḥ -- (śrutvā) vatse rukmiṇi! ehyehi sāghayāmaḥ | rukmiṇī -- (sāsram) bhaavadi! aṇumaṇṇasu mama maraṇahūsaṃvaṃ tuha pahāveṇā landdhasaggagaī tarhi yyevaṃ īdāṇiṃ añcaissaṃ | subuddhiḥ -- indrāvarajajāyā yuktameva | yātaramindrāṇīmiha sthitā nityamarcayipyati | rukmī -- (svagatam) kathamamvāyāḥ kañcukī rukmiṇīmindrāṇīpṛjārthabhāhṛyate | tadarha śiśupālaṃ tvaritapadameva śiviraṃ prāpayāmi | (prakāśam) cedīndra! tyaryatāṃ tvaryatāṃ punarvivāhavelā samāsannā bhavipyati | śiśupālaḥ -- (sahapaitmukyam) sārathe! tvaraya tyaraya ratham | (sārayi, tathā karoti) śiśupālaḥ -- (vāmākṣispandanaṃ sūcayitvā svagataṃ savipādam) āḥ! kimetat! (ākāśe lakṣyaṃ yadrvā) prāpse prasdādasamaye sa mato'gha kāmo vāmaṃ hahā! sphurati kinnu vilocanaṃ me | jāto'smi vā niviḍanallayavāsito'haṃ sā rukmiṇī bhavatuḥtatsunimittamenat || 17 || rukmī -- sāradhe! tvaryatāṃ tvaryatām | (iti niṣkāntaḥ) rukmiṇī -- (niḥkṣvasya) vāredu muhuttamettaṃ bhaavadī vacchaladā maha jīvaṃ ṇīharaṃtaṃ | subuddhiḥ -- vatse kṛṣṇavallabhe nivāritāsi kṛpṇājñayā mā punaramaṅgalaṃ vyāhara | pūrṇamanorathā ehi tāvat (iti nidhāntāḥ sarve) tṛrtīyo'ṅkaḥ | (tataḥ praviśati rathārūḍha. sātyaki' sārathiśca) sātyakiḥ (saharpākṣcaryam) ahaha! rukimanyāstadānīmavasdhāsaṅkaraḥ tathāhi sāsarabhasanamanāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ labdhvā cirādabhikāṅkṣitaṃ prasabhaharaṇavyāpāreṇa prasṛtvarasādhvasā | kakubhi kakubhi bhrāmyannetrā suvuddhisuvatsalāvyatikaranirātaṅkā bhūyaḥ suravaṃ rathamabhyagāt || 1 || mayā'pi sādhu kṛtaṃ, yatkṛpṇadevaḥ samarasaṃmardavaddhagrahaḥ sapraṇāmamabhyarthya purataḥ prasthāpitaḥ | kusumasukumāramanā hi rukmiṇī vandhuvargakadanakaṣṭasākṣiṇī na jāne kathaṃ bhavet | atra ca kanyāntaḥpuracāriṇo nṛpajanāste kharvakuvjādayo viprāste ca pulomajārcanavidhau sollāsamabhyāgatāḥ | mithyāsṛntritavikramāḥ parihatāḥ smereṇa dūraṃ mayā stokastokabhaṭapramāthavidhinā tṛptaḥ kṛpāṇo na me || 2|| tadahamidānīṃ rukmiśiśupālapramumvasaropadhāvitā'rivargavinivāraṇavyagrātvaladevādīnupasarpāmi | sārathe! tvaraya tvaraya radham | sārathiḥ -- (tathā kurvanpuro'valokya) āyupman yuyudhāna! kathamayaṃ yaladevaḥ savalo vyāvṛtta ito'bhimukha eva dṛśyate | sātyakiḥ -- (vibhāvya sāśaṅkam) āḥ! kimetat | kimayaṃ rukmiśiśupālādonvyāpādya puronmāthāya dhāvitastadupasṛtya nivārayāmi | (tata. praviśati baladeva) sātyakiḥ -- (sapraṇāmam) ayi vīrādhirāja rāma! kimetadārabhyate?
