| vyāpāditepu śiśupālādipu alamidānīmanaparādhino bhīpmakasya purapramāthena | valabhadraḥ -- sātyake! kena te vyāpāditāḥ kasya locanagocaratāṃ ganāḥ? | sātyakiḥ -- (ptavitarkam) valadeva! na te vīrābhimāninaḥ palāyante | nūnaṃ ddhakrodhāḥ kṛṣṇgamanudhāvitāḥ | tadalaṃ vilamvena | ehīmāṃ kṛṣṇāmugatāmāśāmupasarpāmaḥ | (iti tathā kurvanti) valadevaḥ -- (purovaśrṛṃgya saharpam) sātyake! phalitastava tarkaḥ | dṛṣṭāste duṣṭāḥ | sātyakiḥ -- (sasaṃrammam) ye baladevena dṛṣṭāḥ kālena te dṛṣṭāḥ | valadevaḥ -- (sānutāgm) ahaha! pratyāsannā eva kintu parāṅbhugvāḥ | kathabhimānssapatrākaromi! sātyakiḥ -- tiṣṭha! tiṣṭa! ahamimānsaṃmukhīkaromi | (sākṣapamuccai) re re rumkmitrathamayapadairlaṅghayate kiṃ kṛtāntaḥ kenākhyātaṃ tava raṇaparityāgato dīrdhamāyuḥ | taṃ sadvīraṃ smarassi na yadi klīvavaṃśaṃ svakīyaṃ kṣaghrārādhyaṃ karatalagataṃ vīkṣase kiṃ na khaṅgam || 3 || valabhadraḥ -- (saropākṣepam) re re śiśupāla vāliśa?! palāyanaparaḥ kimiti bhayavyākulo vimalakṣatrakulācāramatikrāmasi? | paśya re paśya śaurpe ddaḍhapadastiṣṭha dhikkātaratvaṃ jitvā śatrūnbhaja bhavasukhaṃ bhindhi vā bhānuvimvam | tiṣṭhannagre praṇamitaśirāḥ pāpacvāpastvadīyaḥ pāṇiṃ rundhanbhuvamiti mahāvaṃśajo yācati tvām || 4 || api ca re rukmiyāndhavanṛpāḥ paramaḥ kramo vaḥ samyandhino vapamamī bhavato'bhyupetāḥ | asmābhiraikyamadhigamya raṇotsave'sminnāsṛtryatāṃ viśādabāhumadopayogaḥ || 5 || sātyakiḥ -- (puro'valokya saharpollāptasam) ghaladeva! diṣṭayā vardhase | tvaddhacanapāśākṛpṭau vyāvṛttau rukmiśiśupālau | (tata' praviśato rukmiśiśupālau)) śiśupālaḥ -- (sagardopahāsam) ayi yaladeya! kisucyate bhavataḥ saubhrātraṃ, yatkṛpṇāya ghāvitamapamṛtyumāhūyātmani pātapasi | rukmīḥ -- (sagarvam) ayi cedīndra! maivam | asmākameva valamaraṇamanukṛṣṇamaraṇamityayaṃ kramamṛtyulakṣaṇaḥ saurājyadharmo pālayitavya eva | balabhadraḥ -- (sakrodham) ayi śiśupāla! kpha me saumrātram? | pratāpaprāvandyodayini raṇadurbhikṣasamaye bhavānbhakṣyaḥ prāpto madhumadhanakhaṅgasya paramaḥ| svavāṇānāṃbhoktuṃ tamapi vitarāmyāśu yadahaṃ phalaṃ vandhuprītestaducitamaho kinnu viditam || 6|| rukmī -- (balamadaṃ vibhāvya svagatam) aye halamasya mahāyudham | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśa sāvajñahāsam) ayi balabhadra! vāliśo'si | kimasmindāsañcare sahīrayarmani pravarttase| nadīṃ mṛdvīṃ kraṣṭuṃ prabhavasi paraṃ sūryatanayāṃ pralamvaṃ vicchettuṃ tvamasi tṛṇamucchṛṅkhalavalaḥ | samidbhūmiḥ seyaṃ vipamavipamā lohakaṭhinā kṛte'pyatrāyāse haladharahalaṃ niṣphalamidam ||7|| apica valabhadra! balīvarddo lāṅgalaṃ cālayanbhavān | yaśaḥ katamamasmābhirlabhyate tadipāṭanāt ||8|| śiśupāla -- rukmin! bhadraṃ bhadramāyātamasmāsu|ākarṇaya dundubhim | asmadīyasamaradundubhiśravaṇānantarameva vyāvṛttaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ | svamī -- (kṛṣṇadundubhivvanaṃ pratyabhijñāya saharṣam) priyaṃ priyaṃ naḥ| pūryatāṃ pūryatāmidānīṃ kiyatyapi saṅgarapratyāśāsmākam | valabhadraḥ -- sātyake! kiṃ kṛtamidaṃ kṛṣṇena | sātyakiḥ -- samaradundubhimākarṇya kathannu tiṣṭhetkṛṣṇaḥ? | nahi nahi kesarī kuñjarārāvamākarṇya vilambate | (tataḥ praviśati kṛṣṇo ramiṇī subuddhiḥ muvatsalā ca) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sākṣepam) ayi dāruka! atikātaro'si mithyāhito'si yattava kṛpaṇapāṇito'pi niṣṭhuramuṣṭigrahau rathāśvaraśmipu pāṇeḥ| sāṅkarparṇa mā glapayasva gātraṃ vipakṣavāṇaiaustvarayāsmadaśvān | kṛṣṇasya sāṃsiddhikakṛṣṇakāntermā duryaśaḥkāpṇyaimudetu ghṛṇyam || 9 || dārukaḥ -- (sabhayaṃ sapraśrayam) epa muñcāmi ratharaśmīnaṃ ' paśpatu devaḥ sāmpratam abhayeti samarabhūmiḥ pratyāsattiṃ śkṣaṇena devasya | sammukhamupasarpantyā vaddhasparddheva jayalakṣmyāḥ || 10 || rukmiṇīḥ -- (saviṣādamapavārya) bhaavadi! diṭṭā mae aṇuggahasiddhīe tuha maṃtasatto | tā saṃpai vigrahasiddhīe daṃsesu ' ucidaṃ khu maha baṃdhuvaggāvasāṇakāraṇeṇa maraṇeṇa ṇiggāhaṇaṃ|
suvṛddhiḥ -- vatse rukmiṇi! samāśvasihi samāśvasihi ' na me atra kāpi mantraśaktiḥ | tavaiva rūpasaubhāgyasampadepā vijṛmbhate | mā vipīdānayā bhāvi sarvaṃ nirvahaṇaṃ śubham || 11 || dārukaḥ -- deva! prāpto rathastava pratyarrathānthin | sajjaya śarṅgam! kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sārahūṃ gṛhṇan rukmiṇīmavalokya) priye! kimākulāsi? | bhavippasi vandhumatīo kalyāṇaparamparāpātrampuṃ epa śamayāmyanipṭam | (rukmaṇī samākṣvasya savrīḍamadhomukhī tiṣṭhati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (paro'valokma) kathamayaṃ śiśupālo baladevasyandanamanudhāvati? | (sākṣepam) āḥ tighṭha tiṣṭha | mā mūḍha! jhampāṃ kuru ghāḍavāgnau cedīndra! mā ropaya rauhiṇeyam | asminmanāgapyadhirūḍharope kālasya puryāṃ paramasti vāsaḥ || 12 || śiśupālaḥ -- (rathaṃ parāvarttya sakrodham) re re kṛpṇa! parataḥ parato bhava | na bhavānasmadvidhasadīrodyogayogyaḥ | tathāhi indrāṇīcaraṇārcanāparikaravyāpāritāṃ kanyakāṃ viśvāsopagataṃ hare! yadaharastvaṃ junpayātrāgataḥ | dharmaḥ kiṃ caritastadepa bhavatā kṣatravrataṃ kiṃnu vā kiṃ vā vandhujanocitā vpayahṛtirlokasthitiḥ kāpi vā || 13 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (savājña vihasya) yujyate yujyate | caitanpātprabhṛti pravṛttaparamapremodayāṃ sundarīṃ | saṃdhāṃ dehavisarjane kṛtavartīṃ maddhiprayo̱ge dṛḍhām | kanyāṃ svaṅgavalodayena kalayannarhāmi garhāmahaṃ kṣlāghyastvaṃ śiśupāla! nistrapamupālambhānimānvyāharan || 14 || śiśupālaḥ -- (sāvajpajñopahāsam) kṛpṇavīra! evamevaitat | upālabhbhadānamātrodyogā vayamaparyāptāḥ | tvamekaḥ śauryaśālipu dhuryaḥ | tathāhi vyālaṃ nirjitavānkharaṃ dalitavanukṣāṇamājaghnivānaśvaṃ khaṇḍitavāniti vyavasitikṣreṇyaiva dhanyo bhavān | etadvikramayugmatadbhumatamaṃ kaḥ stotumīśo'sti te yatkaṃsaḥ to yadapi ca vyāpāditā pūtanā || 15 || sātyakiḥ -- kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! vyāharatu vyāharatu cedīndraḥ | soḍhavyamasyāgaḥśatam | śiśupālaḥ -- (sakrodham) ūrere! āgaḥśatāvagherakṣito'ham || paśyata paśyata | āgāḥśattaṃ kimiva tadvidadhe'dya ghoramāgaḥsahasraśatajitvaramekamāgaḥ | yatkṛpṇamanyavanitākapaṭāpahāravīraṃ vipāṭaya vitarāmi raṇe śivābhyaḥ || 16 || valabhadraḥ -- (sakrodham) ayi śiśupāla! saṅgarakarmakuṇe paśyadandhadurakṣarodāharaṇacaturaṃ mukhameva tavāvayavepu pragalbham | yadvāhudvitayaṃ tadāvikalitaṃ cakṣuryadastaṃ gataṃ tepāmasti na duryaśaḥparicayaḥ stoko'pi puṇyātmanām | dopau te damaghopapāṃsanamahādopāvimau sāmprataṃ nennadvandvamidaṃ ca saṅgarajayāhlādo na yairlabhyate || 17 || tadlaṃ nimṛntritūāyātaniraparādhinaredravṛndū̱kadnakrauyaivāhulyena āgacchataṃ yuvāṃ śiśupālarukmiṇau samaropamaīkṣamāṃ medinīm | rukmī -- (apavārya) ayi cedīndra! prakaṭasamarakeliduḥśikṣitāvetau valadevagovindau | tadevaṃ tāvat | (karṇe evabheva prakāśaṃ sakrodham) āḥ! kimekena rāmeṇa | āgacchataṃ rāmakṛṣṇau | yāvaāvāṃ samarabhūmim | (iti tathā kurutaḥ) (nepathye) ākṣcaryatyahaha! kācidakartṛkaiva nārācavṛṣṭiriyammbarataḥ patantī | tāruṇya eva taraṇerayamapyudañcan kārttāntakāsaragalacchavirandhakāraḥ || 18 || (punarnepathye) paśyata syandanau śūnyau tau gatau mukharau kkacit | adhikaṃ yudhyate citraṃ sainyametadanāyakam || 19 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (śrutvā svagatam) nṛnamamgharagatau rukmiśiśupālau māyāyuddhavaidagdhyaṃ dāruṇaṃ vistārayatastadahaṃ pannagāśanasyandanamārūḍho viyatastau pātayāmi | (prakāśam) bhagavati sughuddhe! bhadre suvatsale! lālanīyā tāvadbhavatībhyāṃ rukmiṇī yāvadahamimamanarthaṃ nivārayāmi | (rukmiṇī sanvīḍaṃ savipādamadhomukhī teiṣṭāte) subuddhisuvatsale…vijayatāṃ vīraḥ | (kṛṣṇeo dhyānaṃ nāṭayati) akrūraḥ -- (ūrdhyamavalokya sāścaryam) kiṃ śātakumbhagirirepa gṛhītapakṣaḥ kiṃ pāvakaḥ prasaradugraśikhājaṭālaḥ | devaḥ sa eva kimayaṃ mahasāmadhīśaḥ saṃharttumeti timirāṇyatimedurāṇi || 20 ||
valabhadraḥ -- (sasambhramam) nṛnamayaṃ durvṛttavidvipāṃ prapañcastadenamantarikṣa eva nikṛntāmi niśitepuṇā | (iti cāpamāropayati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (.saHmdhapram) āryabaladeva!tiṣṭha tiṣṭha tiṣṭatārkṣyo'yaṃ mayā'nusmṛtaḥ samāyāti | enamāruhya vyomacarau nigṛhvāmi paripanthinau | (tataḥ praviśati tārkṣyaḥ) tārkṣya -- (sapragāmam) anugrahṇātu māmādeśadānena devakīnandanaḥ | pakṣānilaiḥ prasabhamamyunidhīndhunomi tvaṃ cedadhobhuvanajipṇutayotsuko'si | utkaṇṭhito'si yadi tepu tadānayāmi tāninduśekharaviriñcipurandarādīn || 21 || kṛpṇaḥ -- (saharpe sasmitam) ehi tāvattvayā **na tāvambarasamarāṅgaṇacāriṇau māyāmahārathau vicinomi tau pratyarthinau | tārkṣyaḥ -- ṃkuru yathākāmam | (iti kṛpṇaṃ ṣṭaṣvamāropya gaganārohaṇaṃ nāṭayati) (sarveptāścaryamālokayante) akrūraḥ -- ahaha! paśyata paśyata | epa pratīcchanniśiteyudhārāḥ sgharṇātapatrīyati pakṣirājaḥ | asyopariṣṭātsphuradindranīlakumbhāyate'sau madhukaiṭabhāriḥ || 22 || valabhadraḥ -- (vilokya saptambhramam) āḥ! kiṃ punarārūḍhavipṇurviṣṇuratho'yaṃ drāgāyatarati | kiṃ duṣpraveśamamvaraṃ śarāsaraiḥ? | (sāṭṭahāsaṃ vihasya) kimalasaṃ muśalaṃ yaladevasya gaganāgrārohaṇe? (iti muśalamāsphālayati) sātyakiḥ -- vraladeca! ākarṇaya ākarṇaya tāvat | kimapi śrūyata eva | (sarve ākarṇanābhinayaṃ nāṭayanti) (nepathye) mā muśca mā pīḍaya gāḍhabhaṅgayā tvaṃ tārkṣya! dākṣpātsutavadgṛhītyā | abhaṅgamevāṅgamimau vahuntau svavargavīreṣu samarpya gaccha || 23 || valabhadraḥ -- kathaṃ mukttau durvṛttau murāriṇā? | akrūraḥ -- rāma! samaravijapādepa samadhiko vijayaḥ | sātyakiḥ -- ākarṇayata punaḥ kimapi śrūpate| (saṃrve ārkṇanābhinaya kurvanti) (nepathye) ruphampasau rukmiṇībhrātā cedīndra tvaṃ ca māmakaḥ | api durṇayaduḥśīlau lālanīyau yuvāṃ mama || 24 || subuddhiḥ -- (śrusvā saharpam) vatse rukmiṇi! dviguṇamidānīṃ dipṭavā vaddhese, yattcayā hyadayadayito daityārirāsāditaḥ | yaca karuṇārasapūrāplāvanirvāṇaropānalena na tena lvadvātā dagdhaḥ | (rukmiṇī saharpamātte) balabhadraḥ -- (puro'palokya saharṣam) kathamayaṃ vairivisarjanāya vainateyaṃ samādiśya padātireva dāmodaro'bhyupaiti! | pramuditasuraghṛndonmuktamandāramālāmilitamadhupabandikṣreṇibhiḥ stūyamānaḥ | aghigatajayalakṣmīrapravṛtto'rināśe jayati jayati śauriḥ śairyakruṇyasūrttiḥ || 25 || (tata praviśati yathānirddiṣṭo vāsudeva) vāsudevaḥ -- (sāphūtasmitam) āryarāma! asahyasamaropamarddau tau vīrau sandhāya mayā prahitau | valabhadraḥ -- (sākṛtaṃ veihasya) evameya valīyasā saha yujyate | tadidānīṃ nirvyūḍhāni samīhitāni | samārohatu bhavāndvārakopagamanāpa syandanam | (kṛṣṇa upasṛtya rayāvarohaṇa nāṭayati) dārukaḥ -- (sapraṇāmam) vijayatāṃ vijapatāṃ devaḥ | subuddhiḥ -- ayi kṛṣṇavīra! na tāvadāśībhiḥ payapyate pāyattvayā nivryūḍham| tattvayi praṇāma evu śreyān | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) bhagavati! tvadanugraho'rya vijṛmbhate | suvatsalā -- jaadu jaadu devo | (rukmiṇīvinamramukhī tiṣṭhati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (ptotkaṣṭhaṃ ptānutāpam) āyupyamindumukhi! vairinareśvarāṇāmadyāpi kiṃ vahasi bhāmini! vaimanasyam | yatkātareṇa taralākṣi! mayā priyo'pi muctaḥ priye samarakelirasopabhogaḥ || 26 || (rukmiṇī saharyotkaṇṭhaṃ savrīḍamadhomukhī tiṣṭhati) subuddhiḥ (ptākṣcaryam) kṛṣṇadeva | paśya paśya mihiramahasāṃ na krūrāṇāmiyaṃ ramaṇīyatā nahi nahi taḍitpūro'pīddagbhavetkṣaṇabhaṅguraḥ | ati mṛ………………………………kathamīdṛśā nabhasi nikaṭe jyotiḥ kiṃcidvicitramudoyate || 27 || kṛpṇaḥ -- (vilokyasāścarye saveitarkam)ko'pi kimayaṃ māyā ………………… bhate | (nepathye) yatse sucuddhe! śīghrā'ddam | śīghraṃ saphalīkṛtā mayā tava śiṣyāyā nijārādhanā | tvaṃ ca kṛpṇa! matpriyasya nīlakaṇṭhasya……………………………………..miva paramaṃ premapātram | tatkiṃ tava mayopakarttavyam?| brūhi | tathāpi kiṃ te bhūyaḥ prīyataramastu| (sarve saharṣāścarye praṇamanti) kṛṣṇaḥ --
devyā eva prasādo'yaṃ sādhyaḥ sukṛtakoṭibhiḥ siddhena tena kiṃ sādhyaṃ tato'pyadhikamasti me || 28 || tathāpīdam astu varpantu vāri ruci (tābhyadhikaṃ payodāḥ) varpantu sūkttamamṛtābhyadhikaṃ kavīndrāḥ | varpantu havyabhuji sādhu havīṃpi viprā varpantu cārthipu dhanānyamitāni bhūpāḥ || 29 || iti śrīrukmiṇīoharaṇe cūturyo'ṅkaḥ | iti mahākaviśrīvatsarājaviracita iṃddāmṛgaḥ samāptaḥ || parikaritamindumaulerjayati śiraḥ svargavāhinīsalilaiḥ | yasminnuptaṃ sadyaḥ kusumaṃ kalpaṃrdumībhacati || 1 || piṅgaiḥ kuvainkujamayamiva vyoma tuṅgaiḥ sphuliṅgairvibhradhhūmānsurapatibhiyoṅḍīyamānānivādrīn | mandākinyāḥ kkathanamukharaṃ narttayanvāripūraṃ vāṇasyāgniḥ sa japati puralopakāraḥ purāreḥ || 2 || dhūmairdhyāmalayanmukhāni nayanānyāplāvayannaśrubhiḥ santāpārtiparābharva pṛthuśikhācakreṇa vistārayan | harpotkarpasamāgame'pi divipadvargaspa śokocitavyāpārastripuraṃ dahanvijayate bharmasya bāṇānalaḥ || 3 || (nāndyante) sūtra -- (samantādavalokya) pāripārśvakaḥ -- ……………………dyate bhavāna | sūtra -- mārpa! kiṃ māmupahasasi | sa eva devo'trāparādhyati|tathāhi anāratā dānaparamparābhirnivedamāyāti kadācidurvī | vibharti tatpūrcamiva praharpaṃ muhuḥpradānaiḥ paramarddirājaḥ || 4 || pāri -- labhatāṃ labhatām | nāhamoṣṭaryākāluṣyapātram | kintu vaibhavoccitaṃ yanna dānamārabhate bhaghāṃstadahamupatappe | tathāhi puṣṭāpi rakṣitāpi prapatnato dānavirahitā lakṣmīḥ | gauriya vandhyā bhūtā bhavati paraṃ kaṣṭadā gṛhiṇaḥ || 5 || sūtra -- (tagarvam) mārpa! pratīkṣasva sṛrpacandroparāgādiparva | bhūrkha! paśyasi me mahādānāni | pāri -- bhāva! ko vilamvaḥ śaṃsatyuparāgāṇāṃ tripuravalagarvite daityatathāhi daityāstai kaiṭabhīyāḥ krathanamabhilapantyabdhimadhye'pi gaurervāraṃvāraṃ hinasti ghumaṇiśaśaghurau vāhuhīnaḥ sa rāhuḥ | rugṇe gīrvāṇavarge tripuraparibhavaiḥ so'pi pātālasūlājjāne kairapyahobhirvaliriha valavāneṣyati dhvastavandhaḥ || 6 || (nepayye sopahāsam) yujyate yujyate tavaitat | cāraṇā hi durudāharaṇadohadairviroghavipavarllī varddhayanto durvalānvāliṣṭairghātayanti | pāri -- (ptabhayam) bhāva! ko'yamakāraṇaṃ kuppati? | sūtra -- (svarapratyabhijñāmaminayan) epa virañcinandano mahāmunirnāradaḥ | pāri -- (ptopahāptam) aho! munerupaśamaśīlatā | sūtra -- (vihatya) svabhāva evāyamasya | kinna jānāti bhavān? | tadhāhi na vīṇā prīṇāti śrutipuṭasukhagrāmaghaṭanā svarābhogaḥ sāmnāmapi ca na tathā puṣyati susvam | mithaḥkrūrakroghagradhitaparupālāpavahalaḥ kaliḥ prahṛradāya prabhavati yathā nāradamuneḥ || 7 || taduyaṃ kaladdāvalokanakutṛhalī svayaṃ ca kroghano dūrata eva namasyaḥ || ehyāvāṃ nijaniyogamanantarakaraṇīyaṃ sampādayāvaḥ | (iti niṣkāntau) prastāvanā (tataḥ praviśati nāradaḥ) nāradaḥ -- (samaṃrammaṃ samantādavalokya) kathaṃ na ko'pyatra? | aho dhāṣṭaryaṃ mithyokttivācāṭasya naṭaspa! | tathāhi triśūlalīlāyitamanghakāre dhyayatsu cakrānkramaṇaṃ murāreḥ | bhayajvarāṭopapacelimepu daityeṣu śauryasya lavaḥ kadāsīt || 8 || athavā naṭoyaṃ kimupālabhyate, yo rāhumapi vīragaṇanāyāṃ gaṇapati | (nepathye) ā! brāhmaṇo'si | kiṃ karomi | niraḍkuśarasano vyāhara pathā yathā rocate | kanakaśikharidurgaṃ vajrayāṇirna muñcatyudadhisalisaliladurgairjīvito dānavāriḥ | sa ca pitṛvanadurgaṃ candracūḍo'dhiśete subhaṭabhaṇitiśobhāṃ yujyate nirjarāṇām || 9 || nāradaḥ -- (svarānuptāreṇa ūrdhvamavalokya svagatam) kathamayaṃ rāhurvyaharati? | bhavatu | ko'yaṃ varākaḥ | (tataḥ praveiśati vyomayānena rāhuḥ | rāhu' kanakaśikharītyādi paṭati) nāradaḥ -- (ptopaddāptam) ayi rāhuvīra! upahasanīyaiva subhaṭabhaṇitirdevānām | tathāhi jambhastambhitavikramaḥ surapatirmando'hadṛno raviḥ so''pyāste gajakūttigusajaghano̱,devastriśūlāyudhaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ so'pi kadarthito madhumuraprāyairmuhurdānavaiḥ śauryāśauryaparisthitiṃ sahṛdayo jānāti rāhurbhavān || 10 || (rāhu. sāśaṅkamiva mūrddhakambhena vārayati) nāradaḥ -- (sahāsam) ayi rsaihikeya! hastasaṃjñayā vāraya | sahuḥ (……) vihastitāṃ nārada! bhāmakīyāṃ gatatrapaḥ kuiṃ husasi prahṛpṭaḥ | karānkharāṃśorhasituṃ sahastraṃ na te'sti vaktraṃ madupadrutasya || 11 || tadākarṇaya me hitaipiṇo vāṇīm | mandaṃ nārada! jalpa muñcasi na kiṃ viprocitaṃ cāpalaṃ mithyāhaṅkṛtijalpitaistava hahā! kupyantu mā dānavāḥ | deveṣvastamupāgatepu sahasā tatkroghalīlāyitairepā'nyonyavirodhinī kka nu mune! vighā prayojyā tvayā ||12|| nāradaḥ -- (sahāsam) saihikeya! ahamapyata eva na devānā''kopya dānavānnirmūlamunmūlayāmi | tathāhi nirmṛlamunmṛlitadānavepu deveyu nirvairasukhapriyepu | saṅgāmasam̐marddabharāvalokakutūhalaṃ syātka nu nāradasya || 13 || rāhuḥ -- (sopahāptam) aho! mahāhavakṛtūhalitvaṃ mahāmuneḥ! tadahaṃ pratigrahāntaranirīhasya pūrayāmi bhavataḥ samarāvalokanasamohām | varāko rākāyāṃ mama kavalatāmetya'śaraṇastathā darśepyarkāśrayamupagataḥ śītakiraṇaḥ | tadaghaiva krūraprasṛmarakaraṃ kevalamamuṃ karipyāmi grāsaṃ dinaparighṛḍhaṃ paśayatu bhavān || 14 || (iti sakrodha niṣkrāntaḥ) nāradaḥ -- (sāścaryam) aho caṇḍimā dānayakhaṇḍasya | tadahaṃ bhagavatīṃ bhāgīrathīmupāsya khapaḍaparaśumupavīṇayitumanusarāmi | tameva devaṃ dānavebhyaḥ krodhayipyāmi | (namo'valokya) surasamūho'pīdānīṃ śivaṃ sevamāno bhavipyati | (iti niṣkrāntaḥ) viṣkambhakaḥ (tataḥ praviśati suraptamūhopāsyamāno̱ maheśaḥ) maheśaḥ -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) āḥ kiṃ punaciṃdhvaṃsitānica paśyāmyamṛtāndhasaḥ? | bhavatu pṛcchāmi | (prakāśam) ayi suraguro | kimetat? | śākraṃ cakṣuḥsahastraṃ parivahati himaklīvarājīvamudrāṃ pāśaḥ prācetaso'paṃ piśunayati sukhadhvaṃsamālasyavaśpaḥ| suptotsāho hutāśaḥ kalayati sumanaḥkālimānaṃ dvitīyaṃ krūrāṃ kaṣṭasya kāpṭhāṃ sphuṭamabhidadhati vyākulā lokapālāḥ || 15 || vṛhaspatiḥ -- (solluṇṭham) kiṃ punarbhagavānsarvajño nāradavadasmānkandalāya mukharīkarttumicchati? | svayameva vettu devaḥ | nāradaḥnetre mīlaya candrasūryamayanasvarbhānurāyātyayaṃ pracchannaṃ kripatāṃ gajājinamidaṃ vairasya saṃstārakam | śūlaṃ nikṣipa dūrataḥ kkacididaṃ yuddhāparādhātmakam śambho! tāpasa eva jīvatu bhavān ghorā raṇe dānavāḥ ||16 || maheśaḥ -- (sodham) samiti pariccito'haṃ sarvadā sarvadaityaiḥ kathaya kathapa ko'yaṃ nārad! drāṅbhumūrpuḥ | viracayatu viśaṅkaṃ nākalokaṃ pinākaḥ pralayajaladanādasparddhimaurvīravarddhiḥ || 17 || indraḥ -- (svagataṃ saharpam) diṣṭayā raudrarasavāsitamānaso haraḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | sādhu nārada! sādhu |yana pāradosi vipatpārāvārasya | nāradaḥ -- (pārśvamavalokya) ayi kuṇṭhakulikṣa sahasrākṣa! kinna vijñapayati bhavān? | indraḥ -- (sakhedaṃ ni śvatya) ayi mahāmune! keimahamupahasanīyo vijñapayāmi? | tathāhi kāṭhinyaṃ kuliśādapetya hṛdaye satrāsamāvāsitaṃ sagho panna vidīryate vidhuritaṃ durdaityadarpodayaiḥ | ekopyasti na me vilocanalavaścakṣuḥsahasraṃ tanau nūnaṃ citrabhidaṃ hṛtaṃ mama yaśo yatpaśyataḥ śatrubhiḥ || 18 || maheśaḥ -- (ptotsāham) api jambhaśāsana! kimevamuttāmyasi? | kiyanmātrāṇi tava dambholidāvānalasya dānavakulatṛṇāni? | indraḥ -- (ptapraśrayam) kiṃ garvagarbhabhaṇitivyasanena śasto dambholirepa na tu deva | tava prabhāyaḥ | audātyasusthamanasi tvayi dānavānāṃ dordaṇḍakhaṇḍanavidhau katamo'sti 'śauṇḍaḥ || 19 || maheśaḥ -- (sakhedam) ahahaṃ puruhūta! kimidaṃ vyāhṛtam! | svame'pi divipatkāryepu na syādudāsona īśānaḥ | śūlaṃ śiraḥśūlakaraṃ na kasya vipākakṛtkasya na vā pinākam | mamendrasandeśaṃvadasya kaṃ vā na kuryātparaśuḥ parāsum || 20 || yamaḥ -- (sasarambham) āḥ! kiṃ mṛtamamarairyeddaityasamarasammarddakelirbhagavantamugraṃ vyagrīkaripyati? | ayi devadeva! tvadvarapradānavalamāśaṅkamānāstatra vayaṃ klīvāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ smaḥ | tadidānīm bhodantāṃ karapaṅkajepu giriśa! svasthāni śastrāṇi te saṅgāmaśramakātaro nahi nahi preṣyo'sti te kaścana | svairaṃ me samarāṅgaṇe viharatāṃ daṇḍo'yamatyutkaṭasruṭyatkīkasavāvadūkadanujapratyaṅgabhaṅgodyamaiḥ || 21 || hutāśaḥ -- (sakrodhamākāśe lakṣyaṃ babhudā) ayi jvālāḥ sarvāḥ pralayasamayāṭopaviṣpamāḥ pragalbhadhvaṃ yūrya mayi jhagiti saṅgāmarasike | mayā pruṣṭe tasminprathamamasurānīkavipine surāṇāmanyepāṃ `bhavatu kupitaṃ bhasmani hutam || 22 || nāradaḥ -- (saharpe vihasya) ayi ghāyo! paśya paśya nijamitrasya śauryotsāham | vāyuḥ -- sakhe nārada! tirmūlamunmūlayitāhameva prabhañjanaḥ prāgasuradumaughān | dahatyathaitānmṛtamārakārastanūnapāttāpayanāṃ ravivī || 23 || nāradaḥ -- (saharṣam) diṣṭayā varddhatāṃ varddhatāṃ dhamaiḥ | evamuddhatakttoghepu devepu dānavānāmambhasi magrānāmapi kka jīvitam | varuṇaḥ -- (samavai ptaprakṣrayam) kaṇṭhanyakaṭhorapāśavivaśāndevadruho durddamān (ātmānaṃ nirdiśya) neṣyatyepa niraṅkuśo jalapatiḥ pātālamūlaṃ valāt | tadvailakṣyajupo vinā raṇarasaṃ bhagnapratijñāḥ surā na krudhyanti yathā tathā kuru mune! tvāmitthamabhyarthaye || 24 || nāradaḥ -- sakhe kuvera! dhanado'si, tadidānīṃ nidhanado bhava vidvipām | kuveraḥ -- sakhe nārada! maddoḥstambhavijṛmbhitaistrinayanapremānurodhena vā sārddhaṃ naiva mayā milanti samaraśraddhālavo dānavāḥ | tanme bhūridināni saṅgaramahāduthtikṣadūnātmanaḥ sampratyepa raṇotsavaḥ prabhavinā haryāya śambhoḥ puraḥ || 25 || nāradaḥ -- (ptaharpam) ahaha! diṣṭayā kṛtakṛtyo'smi saṃvṛttastadidānīṃ nettarasya kasyāpyapekṣā | nairtkṣtrayaḥ -- (sakrodhaṃ svagatam) kathaṃ sāmānyagaṇanayāpi na māṃ gaṇayatyayaṃ baṭuḥ tadevaṃ tāvat -- (prakāśam) devadrohivipāṭanavyatikare cīro'hamekaḥ paraṃ tādṛḍane tvadanādareṇa garimā kiṃ nārada! kṣīyate | āste kautukamātrameva kalahakroḍāsu te cāpalaṃ bhīruḥ śara iti sthirti kathamahojānāti vipro bhavānm || 26 || nāradaḥ -- (svagataṃ taharyam) diṣṭavā asāvappasmatpakṣa eva tāvatsaṃvṛttaḥ | ktrudhyatu krudhyatu | sutarāṃ priyaṃ priyaṃ me | (prakāśaṃ sapraśrayam) dhurīṇo vīrāṇāṃ rajanicara! ko'nyo'sti bhavataḥ pradhānaṃ śastrāṇāṃ tava paramasiḥ kroḍati karaṃ | tvamabhyarthyo poddhuṃ kimiva divipatkāryaparayānvidhiḥ kenādiṣṭo ghaṭayati muhurvipṭapamidam || 27 || nandī -- (saspṛham) api surācārpa! suṣṭu māmevaṃvidhadānavaviśepaśuśrūpā muravarīkaroti | tathāhi astodapatpitiriyaṃ kimu laṅghanīyā kenāpi kinnu puruṣapravaraḥ sa ekaḥ | yatkātarā bahutarāḥ sahasā sametya taddhaiśasavyatikaraṃ muhurārabhante || 28 || tatkathaya ko'yaṃ vīraśiromaṇiḥ? | vṛhaspatiḥ -- ayi śilādsṛno! kathitaḥ kimepa vijñeyaḥ antarikṣacaragtripurābhidhāno dhūmaketuriya trailokyasya? | duṣprekṣāḥ prasaratprabhūtahutabhugjvālaughanīrājitavpomāno mukharasphuliṅgapaṭalapracchāditāśāmukhāḥ! gaṅgāmbhaḥkavace śiāghasya śirasi preṅkhanti tanmārgaṇāsthāṅkārānna punaḥ śṭraṇoti divipahurdaivatastatkṛtān || 29 || na cāyamantarikṣacaro'ntarikṣameva kṣiṇoti | kṣitirapi sutarāmanenaivottāpyate | so'pi rasātalanāyako bhujaṅgarājo bhagna evānena | (tataḥ praviśati pṛthivī) pṛthivī -- (ptodvegamākāśe lakṣyaṃ badhvā) bhaavaṃ kamalunbhava! kiṃ tumaṃ uālabhemi? aho de duvvilasidaṃ! sādhāraṇā aṭṭa kulāalā ṇaṃ te diggaā so a bhuaṃgarāo | maṃ dhāriūṇaṃ ia vitthareṇa bhajesi kiṃ dāruṇadaṇaverhi || 30 || tā ṇa tumaṃ uvasappissaṃ | taṃ ypeva caṃdaseharaṃ saraṇaṃ gamissaṃ, jī tumaṃ pi ṇinmedi | (parikrāmantī skhachanamabhinīya savaiṅkṣyam) ahaha! suṭṭhu avalamhi saṃjādā | tā ko maha ālaṃvaṇaṃ | dūre so bhuaṃgarāo | (praviśya purupavepaḥ śepaḥ) śepaḥ -- bhagavati bhūtadhātri! māmayalambasva | pṛthvī -- (vilokya) kaghaṃ ṇāparāo saṃpatto! | ai ṇāarāa! lajvāmi vajjamaiā idhavi tumaṃ ayalaṃryatī! kiṃ visumaridaṃ me duvyisahadāṇavasarāsāraghummarnita maṃ uvvahantassa tuha duvvahadupphaḍaṇimmoapaṭṭaṃ phaṇācakkaṃ | śepaḥ -- bhagavati | `bhāgyavānasmi yadevaṃ saryādhārabhūtā gharādevo sambhāvayati | tadavalamvasva | nikaṭa evāyaṃ bhagavānbhavānīpatiḥ purandarapramugvadivipatparipadupāsyamāna āste | tadejhupasarpāvaḥ | (umāyupaptarpataḥ) pṛthvī -- bhaavaṃ bhagga saalaloasaggasaṃhāraparittāṇakāraṇa! ṇamo de eṇāmo de | śepaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) aṣṭananusaṃvibhāgābhyupagatanikhilabhuvanakāryavṛpadhvaja! namaste namaste! | maheśaḥ -- (saptambhramam) āḥ kimetat! | vāppākulāsyā vikalaṃ calantī viśālaniḥkṣvāsavilolaveṇiḥ | upasthitā mūrttimatī tvamādhirasmanmano medini! sādayanlī || 31 || tatkathaya kimetat? | bhagavati mahi! sakalalokamahanīye mahadetadatyāhitam | kādamvimī kācidapūrvarūpā tvamuevare! bhūrirasopagṛḍhā | urdhvasthalokānapi havyakavyapravarpaṇaiḥ propāyase talasthā || 32 || pṛthvī -- (sapraśrayam) bhagavan! keyamātmavikatthanatā | nanu tvanmūrtirahabhamasmi | maheśaḥ -- (śepamālokya) calācaladharotkṛttaphaṇāvraṇagaṇāturaḥ | adaśannapi nāgendra! tvaṃ no daśāsi mānasam || 33 || śepaḥ -- (saptaṃrambham) api devadeva! tvadādeśavaśaṃvado'smi na punarahamaparyāptaḥ | sahastreṇātpānāṃ prasaraduruniḥkṣvāsamastā pṛthujcālājālaṃ kimu viyati yayīmi na vipam! padīpaplopena tripuradanujonmulanavidhau na manghrastantro vā prabhavati samādhānakaraṇe || 34|| nāradaḥ -- (saharpāścaryan.) sādhu sādhu na khalu kṣmābhāroddhahane eya samarabhāroṭahane'pi dhurīṇa eca bhujadgarājaḥ | (śiśirabādhāmabhinīya) āḥ! kiṃ punarecaṃvidhaduḥkhopmasaṃbādhe'pi śiāśiravaidhuryamujjṛmbhate | (puro'valokya) kadhamagraṃ parvanarājaḥ prāptaḥ! | (saddarpam) ehyehi śailarāja! haraśvaśura! śiśiraya tripuraparibhavottaptaṃ surasamūham | (praviśya) himavān -- (sapañcāttāpaṃ hamtaṃ vidhunvan) ayi munīndra! ahaha! kimiha kurmo nāyakaspāmarāṇāṃ kuliśādalitapakṣāḥ paṭgaco yatkṛtāḥ smaḥ | aptamacayabharāḍhayāḥ svairamukṣīyamānāḥ kimu na danujasārthaṃ khecaraṃ cūrṇayāmaḥ || 35 || tadidānīṃ sthāgharo'pi phāmasppo yimcpākṣāpekṣāṃ pūrayiṣye | nāradaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ayi durlakṣya tryakṣa!ka idāṇīṃ pratīdhyate | tripuropabhade deyayāne mṛpīnandramasī paramiha nāgatau | nandī -- (diśo'jhekya ptamamdhamam) āḥ! kimetat | rātrirganaiva viharanti na gharivāhāsnnāruṇya eva taraṇiḥ paripagāmameti | ā! ko'pamadbhunamayaḥ samayastanoni diphcakttamamilatimiraśparoham || 36 || (marpe maśmagbhāramāṭogntente) (nepadhye) daityāntakāricakttaparākttabhasya yo hīnatāṃ piśunayatyavinaṣṭamauliḥ | sotkarparopabharabhīṣaṇaniḥpidhānardaṣṭraḥ sa epa vinihanti vidhuntudo'rkamū || 37 || tatparitrāyatāṃ yaḥ kaścidiha śarataraḥ suro'sti | maheśaḥ -- (sasaṃrambham) nandinnupanaya me cāpam drāgastu niḥśokaḥsṛryalokaḥ | nandī -- āḥ!ko'yamasadraho vigatavigrahaṃ nigṛhītaṃ rāhugrahaṃ grahītum | tripuradāha evārabhyatām , yenoparuḍadevayānapitṛyānena gharmapathanirmūlamunmūlyate | (nepathye) (sakrodham) āḥ! ka epa dharmamunmūlayati? | dharmaḥ sadaica yalavānvijayaikahetuḥ dharmobhirakṣati paraṃ smaraṇamayatnāt | te jambhakaiṭabhmagājandhakanārakāghā dharmadruhaḥ kathaya ke'bhyudayaṃ prapeduḥ || 38 || nāradaḥ -- (saharṣam) kathamāgata eva mama jyeṣṭho bhrātā vrahmanandano dhamaiḥ! | dharmaḥ -- (praviśya)bhagāvannaśepa jagadādhāra! epa tvāṃ dharmaḥ praṇamati | maheśaḥ -- ayi dharma! kimevamucpate? | asmākamapi vṛpabharūpadhārassvamādhāraḥ | ihopasīdatu bhavān | dharmaḥ -- maheśā! tripuroparuddhe jagati ihaiva me sthānam (ityupaviśati) nāradaḥ -- (sahasopasṛtya sapraśrayam) bhagavan dharma! epa tvāṃ kaniṣṭo nārado'bhivādayate | (iti praṇamati) dharmaḥ -- (saharpam) vatsa kalipriya | sudhāndhasāṃ pakṣaparigraheṇa vinigraheṇonmadadānavānām | nippādayeipyāmi kaliṃ kaṭhoraṃ tvatprītaye cātmacivṛddhaye ca || 39 || nāradaḥ -- (saharpam) bhagavanam! tvayi sapakṣe devānāṃ bhaviṣyati bhagavānnārāyaṇaḥ senānīrataḥ ko vijayasaṃśayaḥ | yato gharmastataḥ kṛpṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastatoḥ jayaḥ | kārttikeyaḥ -- (ptakrodhaṃ tvagatam) kathaṃ māṃ senānyaṃ nirasya nārāyaṇaḥ surāṇāṃ senānīrbhaviṣyati? | (prakāśaṃ sasaṃrambham) ayi nārada! hitvā paurupavāsanāṃ na mahilābhāvaṃ gamiṣyāmyahaṃ pāñcotsāritagaurabo nahi mune! husvo bhavippāmi vā | kṛrmakroḍajhapādirūpavigatirnaivānubhāvyāṃ mayā senānoḥ purupottamo divipadāṃ yogyo na mādṛgjanaḥ || 40 || nāradaḥ -- (saharpam) diṣṭayā varddhate divipadrargaḥ | yadayaṃ saṃrabdhaḥ śambhunandanaḥ | (ptahasopamṛtya kārttikeyaṃ śirasyāghrāya) abālavikramo vālaḥ śūlino modatāmayam | asya prasādato devā nirjarā yāntu vṛddhatām || 41 || maheśaḥ -- ayi kārttikeya! kimanabhijñaḥ pralapasi?||maddhandhurmadhukaiṭabhāriḥ pitṛvyaste bhavati | kārttikeyaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) yadi pitṛvyastartki mayi sdhite pitā pitṛvyaḥ pitāmaho vā raṇāyāsamanubhavipyati? | maheśaḥ -- (sasmitam) ayi nārad! gaccha | samānaya pitāmahakṛṣṇau | mā kadācana tadvarapradānagarvitāstripurāsurā `bhavipyanti | tattadanumatenaiva tānnirdahāmi | nāradaḥ -- padhā''diśati devaḥ | (iti niṣkrāmati) maheśaḥ -- ayei mahaindrādayo devāḥ! sarve sajjībhavata neijanijadiṅvukheṣu | epa nippanna eva tripuradāhaḥ | rakṣaṇīyaḥ paramiha māyāprapañco durlakṣo dānavānām | indrādyāḥ -- (sapraśrayaṃ saharpam) yathā''ñjñāpayati devaḥ | (iti sarve niṣkāntāḥ) prathamo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśatyallīkaḥ) alīkaḥ -- (puro'valokya) kaghaṃ eso maha piavaasso vivarīdo gācchadi! | acchariaṃ acchariaṃ jai eso andho tā kadhaṃ turidapadaṃ parikkāmadi | jadi ṇa andho tā kaghaṃ ṇa maṃ peksvadi | bhodu saddāyemi | ayi vivarīda vivarīda! karhi patthidosi? | viparītaḥ -- (sahasā'valokya ptaharpam) piavaassa alia! diṭṭiā tae vāharidomhi | aṇṇahā tumaṃ apecchia gado tumaṃ annesaanto khijjantomhi | alīkaḥ -- kiṃ uṇa tumaṃ maṃ ṇa pekkhasi? | vipa -- vaassa! garuarajjakallabhāruvvahaṇavāvaḍahiaeṇa ṇa mae tumaṃ peyigvadosi | alīkaḥ -- (ptāśaṅkam) vaassa! kerisaṃ rajjakajjaṃ? | vipaḥ -- tiuraṇāhaparibhūdehiṃ daivehiṃ milia maṃtiūṇa hariviricipāsaṃ pesido nāradotti carehiṃ dāṇavaṇāhassa yinnattaṃ | alikaḥ -- (ptāvajñam) diggaadūsaṇatthaṃ sasāāṇaṃ esa bhelao, jaṃ tiuraṇāhaṇimmahaṇatthaṃ amarāṇaṃ melao | vipa -- (sakreodham) ayi alia! śaiśacādo pahudi rāaulapavaṭṭido khu tumaṃ ṇaasūaṇiuṇo kahaṃ evaṃ mantesi | ṇaṃ paramāṇumette vi vairie appamatteṇa bhodavvaṃ | alīkaḥ -- tā kadhesu kiṃ saṃdiṭaṃ tiuraṇāheṇa | (viparītaḥ karṇe evameva) alīkaḥ -- (saharyem) sādhu sādhu sṛmaṃtidaṃ erda | vipa -- (sagarvam) vaassa! edassi kamme tae mae vi bhaṇidavvaṃ viparīdo asurāṇaṃ vijao, aliāṃ decāṇaṃ khaoo | tā gaccha tumaṃ vippayārasu viricaṃ | nārao vinhusaāse ciṭṭadi | ahaṃpi haraṃ vippariāria puraṃdarapahudideve vippañāremi (iti niṣkā ntau) (viṣkambhakaḥ) (tataḥ praviśati nārāyaṇo nāradaśca) nārāyaṇaḥ -- (sāśaṅkam) kiṃ punaradya nāradaḥ śāradāmbuda iva nīraso vicchāyakāyaḥ sthitaḥ? iyamapi vīṇā skandhāvalamvino bhārāyate | nāradaḥ -- (sakhedaṃ ni.śvasya) api vaikuṇṭha! karuṇaruditanādavyaktimāsṛtrayantī prakaṭamabhidṛdhānā mūrcchanāṃ nirjjarāṇām | tanuripamasurāre! vāditā̱ duḥkhavīṇā nahi mama sukhayettvāṃ tena mūkaḥ sthito'smi || 1 || nārāyaṇaḥ -- ~ -- (saptambhramam) atyāhitamatyāhitam! | ayi nārada! sakalabhuvanavṛttāntaviśārado'si ||tadāvedaya kasyāyaṃ suciramastāya kṣaṇiko'bhyudayaḥ| nāradaḥ -- aho! śubhadaśā dānaghānāṃ yadviśvavyāpinā tvayā tadarthamanyaḥ paryanuyujyate | tadahaṃ kiṃ na vijñapayāmi? | bhuvanatrapamidamakhilaṃ tripuraprabhuparibhavānalajvalitamū | kṣaṇamapi na samaṃ labhate tribhuvanabhartuḥ yuro bhavataḥ || 2 || apica ākāśaḥ nāvakāśaḥ kṣaṇamapi bhavati svarvadhūnāṃ viharttuṃ yoge vā saṃyuge vā vighaṭitatanavo nārkasamparkabhājaḥ | saṃruddhe devayāne prasaradurumadatraipurānīkacakrairapyagniṣṭomapājī prabhavati na purīṃ pauruhūtīmupaitum || 3 || nārāyaṇaḥ -- ayi nārada! bhavānapyevamāha | kinna paśyati bhavān ugratapobhirugramārādhya dānavā ugrā bhavanti | kimahaṃ paravān karavai? | gadā sadā dānavadārayitrī saudarśarna darśanameva ghoram | na mandaśakttirmama nandako'yaṃ nideśamevaiśamahaṃ samīhe || 4 || nāradaḥ -- (sopahāsam) aho! prabhāvo'surasṛkṛtānāṃ, yaiḥ sarvajñā apyajñatāḥ | prāpitāḥ | śambhurevaṃ jānīte, janārdanadattavarāritrapurāsurāḥ | na ca bhavān haravarāśaṅkī pratikūleṣvapi teṣu prātikūlyamavalamvate | evamāha māṃ bhagavānbhargaḥ | dvitīyaḥ kila mamātmā murārirarddhāṅganharastattkadācittaddattavaramasuraṃ praharate 'mahyaṃ sa kupyet, tattvaṃ gatvā nirūpaya?! nārāyaṇaḥ -- (ptapraśrayam) api nārada! dehārddhasambanghavarapradānaiḥ svayaṃ sa māṃ lālayatu prasannaḥ | saṅgrāmasevāvasareṣu śambhormadagrataḥ syādadhiko na nandī || 5 || (tataḥ praviśati nandīṃ) nandī -- aho!devānāmabhāgyasampat , yaddevānāmiyamitaretarakalahavallī pallavitā | (samantādavalokya) kadhaṃ prāpta evāsmi viṣṇulokam! | tadiha ka nārāyaṇaḥ? | (puro'valokya) kathamayaṃ nārāyaṇonāradena saha viśravdhaṃmantrayamāṇo'sti |
(sāścaryam) āḥ | kimetadayaṃ hi ruditocchūnanayanaḥ kaiṭabhāriparibhavaṃ bhavāgrato'bhighāya soddhegamapakrāntaḥ | tatkathamaṃtrā ……… 'valokayate? | athavā duradhigamagatirnāradasya| bhavatūpasarpami | (upasṛtya) ayi purupottama | tathā maheśamupahasya kimevaṃ sthīyate? | api ca tyapārcito yo nayanāmcujena cakāra yaḥ sarvajagatprabhuṃ tvām | gaurīva yenārddhatanau ghṛtastvaṃ sthāṇuḥ sa śaure! hasanīya eva || 6 || nāradaḥ -- (sakrogham) āḥ mṛpāvādin! kimevamatininditamakasmāvghāharasi? | nandī -- (sakrodham) ayi nārada! satyaṃ kalahapriyo'si | kintvevaṃ hariharayoḥ kalahakāriṇā na tvayā bhavitavyam| bhavanaivetibhavo'bhihitaḥ | kaiṭabhāriḥ kila māṃ sādhikṣepamitthamāha | 'kimahaṃ sthāṇostasya nideśakāraḥ | svairamahaṃ dānavānunnamayāmi namayāmi vā? | nāradaḥ -- (sāścarye ptaptambhramam)āḥ! kadāhaṃ vyāvṛtya jagadīśasakāśaṃ gataḥ?| nārāyaṇaḥ -- (dhyānaṃ nāṭayitvā ptasmitam) ayi śilādassṛno! ayinārada! āstāmāstāṃ vākkalahaḥ | kenāpi māyāvinā dānavena nāradarūpacatureṇa nūne haro vipralabdhaḥ | tadacireṇa bhagavantaṃ candracūḍaṃ sambhāvayatu nandī, yāvanna kimapyatyāhitamāpatati | ahamapi bhagavantaṃ viriñcimādāyāgato'smi | nandī -- (sanīḍam) yathā''diśati hṛpīkeśaḥ | (iti niṣkāntaḥ) nārā -- gaccha nārada! samānaya bhagavantaṃ kamalāsanam | (tataḥ praviśāti kapaṭanāradenānugamyamāno viriñciḥ) viriñciḥ -- (sakrodham) tāta nārada! sa tvaṃ mama putro nārad eva na bhavasi yadevaṃvidhaṃ paribhavaṃ cakriṇaḥ soḍhavānasi? | kapaṭanāradaḥ -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) kiṃ suṇidomhi? | ādu kṛvido esa evaṃ vāharadi | taha vi eyaṃ dāva | (prakāśam) api tāta! bhagavati bharge govinde ca tvayovāhaṃ vinayena vartte | viriñciḥ -- sādhu sādhu | (sarvato vibhāvya) ape! samāgata evāsmi vipṇulokam | tatkathaṃ karomi!(svagatam) yuṃddhadurbhado murārirvaraṃ śāpodakenaiva taṃ śamayāmi | (prakāśam) ayi nārada! na sahe samaravistareṇa kālakṣepaṃ, tadahaṃ śāpemaiva keśavaṃ śavīkaromi | kapaṭanāradaḥ -- (tūpṇīṃ tiṣṭhansvagataṃ saharṣam) diṭṭiā kaakayyo bhavissaṃ | viriñciḥ -- (sanoghamuccai.) so'nyaḥ sindhupatiryugāntavilasaddhelāsamullaṅghane yasminkṛṣṇa! bhavānvaṭadumaśikhāśāsvāśrayeṇoddhṛtaḥ | śāpāmbhījaladhiḥ prakopavaḍavāvaiśvānarotsaṅgito vrāhmaḥ ko'pyayamadruto'bhyudayate yaste nivāpāñjaliḥ || 7 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (śrutvā sabhayam) āḥ! kimetat kimetat | (ityuttiṣṭhati) nāradaḥ -- (saptambhramaṃ vegādupetya) tāta! dhiktvāṃ dhiktvām | kimanucite pravarttase? | epa tvāṃ harirabhyudgacchati | (kapaṭanāradastirodhatte) viriñci -- (nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā) kathamayaṃ nāradaḥ? | (pārśvamavalokya kapaṭanāradumadṛṣṭvā sāścaryabhadhomukhastiṣṭhati) | nārāyaṇaḥ -- (sasmitaṃ sapraśrayam) āryapitāmaha! muñca muñca vailakṣyam | ṭhayakṣo'pi devastvamiva kenāpi dānavena nāradarūpadhāriṇā haristvāmupahasatīti sāṭopakopaḥ kṛto madadhikṣepāya prajighāyātra śilādasūnum | (tataḥ praviśāti nandinānuganyamāneo maheśa.) maheśaḥ -- (ptānutāpam) avimṛśpakāriteyaṃ krūrā kāloragī hahā | kāpi yaddaṣṭamaniśamantaḥ saśalyabhiva tapyate hṭadayam || 8 || ayi nandin | kathaya kathaya tvadudīritadurudāharaṇakandalitakopaḥ kathaṃ vabhūva, kimāha kṛṣṇaḥ | nandī -- (ptaprakṣrayam) ayi caturdaśajagannāyaka | kimevamnulapyate sarvajñaḥ | kṛṣṇo niścitdurdaityadurvilasito devadevasambodhanāya prāgeya māṃ kṛnasmitaḥ prajighāya | maheśaḥ -- (sautsukyam) ayi nandin! kadā me kṛpṇameghasaṃdarśanena manomayūraḥ parimukttaparitāpo bhaviṣyati | nandī -- (sasmitam) vimanā devo na jānote | nanu vayamāgatā eva viṣṇulokam | kinna paśpati devaḥ purato'bhyutthitau viriñcinārāyaṇau sanāradau? | maheśaḥ -- (saharpa sotkaṣṭhamupasyṛtya saparihāsam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! āvayoḥ samaradraṣṭā sraṣṭāpyayamupeta eva | tadehi yudhyate (iti samāliṅgati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ayi devadeva | kinnu praśrayeṇa mama bhaktimantarayasi | (iti graṇamati) maheśaḥ -- bhagavanpitāmaha! epa tvāṃ maheśo'bhivādayate | (pitāmahaḥ salajjaṃ tūṣyaṇīmāstte) nāradaḥ -- alaṅkiyantāmāsanānīmāni bhavadbhiḥ | maheśaḥ -- upaviśatu puro bhagavān viriñciḥ | viriñciḥ -- (saniḥśvāptaṃ sapraśrayam) ayi devadeva! dānavādhamavipralavgho nāhamervavighamādaramarhāmi | maheśaḥ -- ayi pitāmaha! samāna ecāyamāvayorapakarpastadupaviśyatām | (sarve yathāyathamupaviśanti) maheśaḥ -- (sasmitam) ayi pitāmaha! kathaṃ punarbhavāndānavāghamena vipralavdhaḥ| viriñciḥ -- (savailakṣyam) api jagannātha! kiṃ kathayāmi | kenāpibāppāmbupūrakāriṇā nāradarūpadhāriṇā sānkrandamuktto'smi adhikṣipto'smi kaiśāvenahaṃ tvatpiturcaradānena dṛpsāstripurāsurāḥ paribhavanti bhuvanatrayam | tattenaiva saha tānunmūlayāmi | tato'haṃ kruddho viṣṇulokaṃ samāgatavāna | (niḥśvasya) kimappanucitamāravdhavān | rakṣito'smi sarvajñena kṣamiṇāṃ vareṇa dāmodareṇa | maheśaḥ -- (sasmitam) ahamapyaparanāradena gatvā yodhito'smi 'kintena me svāṇuneti tvāṃ harirupahasati' | tato'haṃ keśavāntikamāgatenaḥ nandinā gatyā samvodhita'smi | śāmitakrodho'tra samāyāto'smi | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saparihāsam) aho! kalipriyasya kalahāvalokanakāraṇena kāyavyūhakāritā | nāradaḥ -- (sakrodhamiva ākāśe lakṣyaṃ vaddhva) sādhu dānavāḥ! sādhu! punaḥ punarviḍamghayata tātaṃ kamalāsanam | dāsyati carānyupmabhyam | viriściḥ -- ayi nārada! kimavijñāya kupyasi? | tapaḥ saptevante duraghigakāmāryamasurā snataḥ protātmāno dadati ca varaṃ yuktamamarāḥ | trilokīsaṃhārapraṇihitadhiyaḥ pāpanidhayo na vadhyante daityā gaditumiti kasyāsni rasanā || 9 || sopadhiśca varo maktastairgṛhīto yathā kila trayo'pi, vayamekaśaraviddhā eca yadhyāḥ | nāradaḥ -- ata eva te yojanaśatāntareṇa saścarante | taditthamavadhyā eva te saṃvṛttāḥ | kkaivaṃvidhaṃ ghanuḥ, kkaivaṃvighaḥ śaraḥ, kaivaṃvigho ghanvī, yenaikaśareṇa trayo'pi vidhyante | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sakrodham) api nārada! maivamsa kodaṇḍaścaṇḍaḥ kaṭhinakaṭhinaḥ kinna bhavitā pṛpatkaḥ sāyāmaḥ kimu na bhavitā yojanaśatam | avijñeyo ghanvī kimu na bhavinā ko'pi vipamo vighau kruddhe mṛtyuḥ kimu na nikaṭaḥ so'pi bhavitā || 10 || nāradaḥ -- (saharṣam) api kṛpṇa! tyayi kruddho kuddho vidhiḥ, kruddhaḥ paramekṣvaraḥ | nandī -- (saharpe ptārśvaryamūrvapavacheophayan) aho! kṛpṇavacanamanuvartante duṣṭadānavavināśapiśunāni durnimittāni | paśyata paśyata pucche'gne ca viśālabhīmaśirasaḥ sāyāmakāyakramāḥ paurasphoṭitabhāṇḍanādajanitadvaiguṇyaśabdormayaḥ | baddhotkālapṛthusphuliṅgapaṭalairāgneyadigvibhrama vibhrāṇāḥ sakalāsu dikṣu nipatantyulkāḥ pure khecare || 11 || nāradaḥ -- tadanusāreṇorddhamavalokya saharṣam) satyaṃ satyam | vyonni prakaṭayantyetā ulkāḥ dīptāśikhāḥ purīm | dīpikā iva kālasya duṣṭadaityānvicinvataḥ || 12|| (nepathye) ayi caṃcalā dāṇavā! ciṭṭhadha ciṭṭhadha | ko esa tumhāṇaṃ alioppābhaasaṃkhoho | ṇūṇaṃ edāo palāantassa pāvaassa karālāo jālāo ṇivaḍidāo| mae khu ṇāraaveseṇa mahesaṃ vaṃciavaṃcidā mahendapamuhā loavālā|paridevidaṃ khu tāṇaṃ purado mae | 'hā tāda kamalāsaṇa! hā mahesa! hā keśava! kaha tumhehiṃ tiurāsuraṇivvāsidehiṃ pāālamūle vasidavvaṃ | tumhevi mahendapamuhā savve surā tahiṃ gacchadha gacchadha kuṇaha paropparamuhāvaloeṇa tahiṃ kālakkhevaṃ | tado maheṃdapamuhehiṃ amarahiṃ aviāria jhatti ya vakkaṃtaṃ | lā sahaṃ jhatti saṃbhāvedu deo sujjatāo a jahicchaṃ suriṃdarāpahāṇi | (punarnepathye) sādhu viparīta sādhu | śiromaṇistvamasimadbhṭatyānām | saphalīkṛtaṃ bhavatā viparīteti nāma, yadasurāḥ svargasadaḥ kṛtāḥ, pātālamūlaṃ prāpitā amarāḥ | nāradaḥ -- (sāvegaṃ sabhayaṃ ca) api śrutaṃ bhavadbhiḥ | nandī -- kiṃ śrotavyam? | nāradaḥ paśyata paśyata | viparītavacanasamākarṇanānantarameva harpotkarṣaviśṛṅkhalāsuracamūsāndradhvajaśreṇibhiḥ kurvannambaraḍamvaraṃ hayamahāhepormivācālitam | tanvandigvalayaṃ navāmbudamayaṃ dānānyadantāklairepa prasthita eva dānavapatiḥ paurandaraṃ pattanam || 13 || (sakhedaṃ niśvasya) kodaṇḍe'jagave kadā guṇalatā ṭaṅkāramāpatsyate? mocyā hanta kadā gadā'dha bhavitā bāhyaṃ tadaratraṃ kadā? | yātā eva yatastato divipadaste te mahendrādayo ghigdhigvaśvirajīvitaṃ yadasuraiḥ svargo hahā! gṛhyate || 14 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (ptotsāham) api nārada! kimevamāphulo'si?| svarganāmasamākarṇanepi baghirā eva dānavāḥ | (iti cintāṃ nāsyati) nandī -- (urdhvamavalokayan sāścarye svagatam) āḥ! ko'yamākasmiko mahānghakāraḥ sahasā vijṛmbhate | nūnamiyaṃ kṛṣṇaprayuktendrajālarmāyā bhaviṣyati, yaddaityavaruthinīmevopasarpati | (prakāśam) āścaryamāścaryam | anyonyaṃ ghaṭanādupāttakalahāḥ kṣubhyantyaho kumbhino jāyante svayameva dantidaśanāghātasya lakṣya hayāḥ | dūre śakrapurī nijālayaparāvartto'pyabhūhurlabhaḥ sadyaḥ paśyata paśyatāsuravale dhvāntaiḥ kṛtāntāyitam || 15 || nāradaḥ -- (saharpam) ayi dānavāre | namaste namaste | nāmāpi na bhavipyati tvayi kuddhe dānavānām | naitasya dviradā bhadākulakadā nodagravegā hayā yodāro na niśātaśastranidhayo nogramamāyā rathāḥ | nāyaṃ valgati naīti praharati prasphoṭayatyutkaṭī mohenaiva nihanti dānavakulaṃ vīro'ndhakārodrutaḥ ||16|| (nepathye) ayi dānavavīrāḥ! kimevamākulībhavanti bhavantaḥ | nūnamayaṃ pātā
lopagatairamarairiha prahito'ndhakārastatke'pi daityabhuṭāḥ pātālamupetya de̱vānunmūlayantu rundhantu cānghakāram | apaṃ cānghakāraḥ kaumudīmāyayā mayā nigramyate | nāradaḥ -- (ptovegam) ayi tāta! api devadegha! api kṛpṇa! bhavantastāvadandivamānayāmi | brahmādyāḥ -- sādhu sādhu | (iti niṣkāntāḥ sarve) dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśati viśadāśayaḥ) viśadāśayaḥ -- (puro'valokya) kathamayaṃ sphuṭākṣara ivāvalokyate?| (nipuṇaṃ nirūpya) mayāpyudāsīna epaḥ | kiṃ punarasau sasaṃrambha iva drutapadairvibhāvyate | (tataḥ praviśati yathānirddiṣṭaḥ sphuṭākṣaraḥ) sphuṭākṣaraḥ -- kadhaṃ apyo visadāsao!|tā paṇamāmi ṇa |(sapraśrayamupasṛtya) ayya visadāsaya! savyasaṃdehavisovasamakāraṇe vatmaṇotti tumaṃ paṇāmāmi eā uṇā rāyasavivattaṇāṇuroheṇa | (iti praṇamati) viśadā -- (sasmitam) sphuṭākṣara! āyuṣmānbhava | kiṃ punarbhavānsaṃrabdha iva vibhāvyate? | sphuṭā -- ayya visadāsaya! ko saṃraṃbho? | dhutterhi mohidāṇaṃ agdhanti ṇa sañcavaghaṇarayaṇāo | aṇāhinnāṇa pahūṇaṃ aliyālāvesu rattāṇa || 1 || ahaṃ khu dāṇavanāheṇa savvatāvaṇeṇa pāālamūlamuvagadāṇaṃ devāṇaṃ vuttantaṃ ṇirūviduṃ pesidomhi | tado mae āgadua viṇṇattaṃ jahā kira nārayamahesiṇā vivarīdadāṇavaviraidamāyāpavaṃcaṃṇivedia pigavaṭṭidā savvevi devā kaantabhāvamuvagadavca kuddhā tumhāṇaṃ purāiṃ ahiddavanti | tā kijñnadu paḍivihāṇaṃ | tado pahudomhi | tā uvviggo jāmi ṇiāabhavaṇaṃ | ayyaṃ pi ajja uvviggaṃ piva pekkhāmi | tā kiṃ nedaṃ? | viśa -- (saptedaṃ niḥśvasya) api sphuṭākṣara! paravānasmi gurorbhagavato bhūgugandanasya | kiṃ karomi? | nāhamanyathaivaṃvidhaṃ kulaviruddhaṃ vidyāviruddhaṃ nāmaviruddhaṃ ca māyāmayaṃ puṇyamapupayaṃ karma kuryām | sphuṭā -- (saptambhramam.) kiṃ uṇa eñcahidaṃ ayayeṇā vavasidaṃ yeṇa evaṃ aṇutappadi ayyo | viśa -- ayi sphuṭākṣara! evamanyathārthito'smi sarvatāpanena | pathā kila bhagavanyiśādāśaya! durādhayoṃ maddhagyaṇāṃ bhargagovindaviriścisamadhiṣṭitā paurandarī purī | tattatra bhavatā patkimapi māpendrajālamāsūtryatāṃ yena te tridaśānāṃ samūlanāśamāśaṅkaya nirāśyaḥ svayameva tāṃ pariharanti | sphuṭā -- tadā kiṃ kaaṃ ayyeṇaṃ? | viśa -- kṛtamapi viparītaphalaneva tepu tādṛśepu māyendrajālādikam sphuṭā -- (samayam) bhaavaṃta | tāṇaṃ kae kiṃpi kīradu avaraṃ santikammādiaṃ | viśa -- (sodvegam) api sphuṭākṣara! kimalīkakarmalkeśena | upadravāḥ kṣudrassurāsurāṇāṃ śakyanta eva pratikarttumanye | kuddhe'ndhakadhvaṃsini śūlapāṇau kaḥ prakramaḥ śāntikapauṣṭikānām || 2 || jānāmi caikaṃ śāntikam | vyasanajvalane'muṣminnavinayapavanaprasāraṇotphulle | haracyaraṇayugalasevā surasindhuḥ sāparaṃ śaraṇam || 3 || niyeya nivartitā sarve'pi devāḥ kṛtāntabhāvamupagatāḥ kuddhā yuṣmākaṃ purāṇyabhidravanti | tatkiyatāṃ pratividhānam! tataḥ prabhuṇā sarvatāpanena garṇoṣmavilīnahitāhitajñānena sādhikṣepamavaistito'smi | tadudvigno yāmi nijamavanam | āryamapi udvimamiva prekṣe | tatkiṃkaṃnvidam? |
sphuṭa -- ṇauṇaedaṃaṇusarissadi aliyagavyuttasido savvatāo | viśa -- ayi sphuṭākṣara! dānavaguruṇāhamasya sācivye paurohitye ca niyukko'smi tanneha me samucitamaudāsyam | tyamapyasya kramāyāto hitaḥ | tadāstāmapamānalkeśaḥ | ehi yathā sambhavamasya hitamārabhyate | (ityumau parikrāmataḥ) sphuṭā -- (śaro'valokya) paravasomddi ayyassa|vihāvedu ayyo esadāṇavaṇāho goñuraparisare hatyipīdṛ samāslḍho ciṭṭhadi | esāvi dāṇayavīravāhiṇī suggahaṇā savyapāāraparisare samantado samantado vihāvīadi | viśa -- (puro'valokya sāvajñṃ viṃhatya) api sphuṭākṣara | sphuradurughanurvalliśyāmaṃ kaṭhoraśarotkaraṃ viyamasamaraphīḍāsiṃhīvijṛmbhitabhīṣaṇam | ditisulabhujāraṇyaṃ tāvaccakāstu niratyayaṃ harahutamujākrodhajvālā na ghāvadihāpatet || 4 || sphuṭā -- ayya visadāsaya!pañcāsanno dāṇavaṇāho|uasappīaṭu ptadāva| (tataḥ praviśati yathā nirddiṣṭaḥ sarvatāpaḥ) sarvatāpaḥ -- kathamāyāta eva viśadāśayaḥ? | ārya! abhivādaye''vrabhavantam | viśa -- viratavigrahaḥ paramānandabhājanaṃ bhūyāddānaveścaraḥ | sarva -- āsanamalaṅkarotu bhavān | viśa -- (pariranīpanītaprāptanamudiśya svagataṃ ptānutāpam) āḥ! keyaṃ madīyamuravamukharāhurudāhṛtiḥ kāloragī vinirmatā | bhavatyaviditaiya yātu kuto'pīpa m | (prakāśam) avi dānaveśa! sphuṭākṣaro'yaṃ sphuṭākṣaraḥ | paramahito dānaveśaspa prasādamevārhati | sarvatāpaḥ -- (saharpe vihasya) krodhanaḥ sphuṭākṣaraḥ | kiṃ kriyate?' (sphuṭākṣaraḥ praṇamyopaviśati) sarvatāpaḥ -- (sotkaṇṭham)ārya viśadāśaya! apyanuṣṭhitaṃ tadāryeṇa | viśa -- māhendrī tvaganekalocanapadaiḥ kīrṇā patākā kṛtā pāśenāmbupaterddaḍhaṃ nigaḍitā kārtāntadaṇḍāgrataḥ | kaumārasya śigvaṇḍinaḥ kṛtaruciryarheṇa guptātmanā nyastā kalpamahīrahe tava yaśāstotraṃ mayā kurvatā ||5|| prastāvitaśca tata ito dṛśyavipulabalajaladhikolāhalo māyāmayaḥ| tatastaistatrasthitairdevauparītanirmitamāyāvṛttāntaprasṛtitaḥ sujñairmahānupahāsaḥ kṛtaḥ | śambhunā ca kṛtasaṃrambheṇa tvadīyanagarodyogāya niyuktaḥ krauñcadāraṇaḥ | sarva -- (sakrodham) ayi viśadāśaya! kulācāra iti kāriteyaṃ mayā māyā sākṣādeva pitāmahādīnām | utkṛtya tānunmadalokapālāstaskṛttibhiḥ ketanavaijayantīḥ | nirmāya bhūyo valasaṃyuto'haṃ yāsyāmi vajrāyudharājadhānīm || 6|| viśa -- (svagataṃ savipādam) aho! durpānghatā dānavāghapamasya nigṛḍhavaiśasaṃ ca | ata eva nainaṃ bhṛgunandano'pi pratyavekṣate | (nepathye sagarvamuñcaiḥkāram) jvālāmālābhiragrerlayasamayamarutpreraṇollāsitābhirbhānostairbhānusāthaiḥ kkathitamaruṇitaṃ pattanaṃ lauhamenat | re re!gīrvāṇavīrā ipughiśaraśirobāṇaṭaṅkairayatnātsagho vandhūkapuppāvacayaracanayā svaṇḍaśaḥ pāṭayadhvam || 7 || sarva -- (śrutvā satrkodham) āḥ kathamapaṃ varākaḥ sūryaḥ sūryatāpapuraṃ pāvakasahāpaḥ plopati | tiṣṭha re tiṣṭha | anyaḥ sa sūrya! samaraḥ kṣaṇamātrameva yasmincipahya vipadaṃ ghunarabhyudeṣi | dhvāntāpanodamadhikṛtya nijaprabhābhiradyaiva lokamapasṛryamaddaṃ karipye || 8 || (ityutthātumīhate) viśa -- ayi daityarāja mahāvīra! tiṣṭha tiṣṭa | pāvakasahāyasya labghāvakāśasya msūryasya mithyāgarvoktiriyam | ko'yametāvāniha saṃrambhaḥ! (sarvatāpaḥ tathaiva tiṣṭati) viśa -- (stagataṃ sāśaṅkam) tāpyata eya tāvatssṛryatāpaḥ | candratāpaḥ kathaṃmāsta iti na jñāyate!|(prakāśam)ayi sphuṭākṣara! ganccha kriyatāmapramattaścandratāpaḥ | sphuṭā -- (sapraśrayam) yathā''jñāpayatyāryaḥ | (iti niṣkrāntaḥ) (punarnaipathye sakaruṇam) vraghne vahlau vikirati spā raśimamālāḥ śikhālīḥ lauhe'mupṭhimannasuranagare'bhrāṣṭravaddahyamāne | lāvā dāvānala iva hahā nirgamodvaddhajhampā bhūyo bhūyaḥ sphuradaratayo daityavīrāḥ patanti || 9 || sarva -- (ptakrodhaṃ saptaṃrambham) ā! kathaṃ dahyata eva me bhrātuḥ sṛrpatāpasya tādṛśaṃ durmadaṃ daityavalamta| tadalamanena sṛpā bhujabhāradhāraṇāyāsena | (iti saṃrambhenāṭayati) viśa -- ayi daityarāja! na yujyate nikaṭato bhavitum | dūrasthānāṃ bhavatāṃ dūrato mṛtyuḥ | (sarvatāpanaḥ tathaiva tiṣṭhati) viśa -- (ptīllaptam) ayi daityanātha! paśya paśya plopaprakārasamāsāditasindūrapūrāḍamvaraṃ tvaddhūturidaṃ lauhaṃ puraṃ viyadaṅgaṇamanudhāvati | sarva -- (vimānya ptollāptam) sūpaspadaṃ kimu jighṛkṣurarya dighakṣuḥ kiṃ cā parāṇiā mughanānyuparisthitāni | ākāśakoṭibhaghirohati daityanāthaḥ pāthodhimutthita ivaurvaśikhī viśopya || 10 || (punarnepadhye) krodhādhmātadinādhināthakiraṇaiḥ sphārīkṛtābhirvalādetallohapuraṃ tathā hutabhujo jvalabhiruttāpyate | paurāṇāṃ jvalatāṃ pathā caṭūcaṭākohalonmiśrito durgandho'yamudañcati kṣrutipathaghrāṇendriyadrohakṛt || 11 || sarva (kṣrutvā ptatrkodham) aye | labdhābakāśāḥ khecarā ime pragalbhante | (ptāvajñaṃ vihasya) ayi mūkhīḥ | ka epa vipādāvasare praharpaḥ |
tapanadahanadāhaiḥ ravādirāṅgārarūpaṃ puramidamabhavaghanmṛtyuśaṅkāvimukttam | idamabhimatamāsīghuddhakhedaṃ vinaiva jvalayatu tadidānīṃ sparśamātreṇa śatrūn || 12 || viśa -- (saharpam) ayi dānavanātha! diṣṭayā varddhase | vibhāvaya tāvadūrdhvam | dadhatkṛpṇāṃ chāyāṃ skhavaladaruṇakāntivyatikaraṃ sphuradbhikṣchāṅkārairmugvaritakakupcakramurubhiḥ | lasaddhūmastomairjanitayamunāsaṅgasubhagairviyadraṅgāpūre puramidamaho! majvatitarām || 13 || tadasya praśānta eva dāhuparibhavaḥ | dīryāyupo'mī dānavāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ | sarva -- (saharpam) aho! bhrātuḥ sūryatāpasya śaurye yadimāṃ dāhavipadaṃ ghipahya mandākinījalāvagāhena lohamayaṃ nagaramanapāyatāṃ nītam | tadidānīṃ candratāpāyaśaṅkā paraṃ māṃ vādhate | (nepayye) yasminnāsītprakampaḥ kusumaśarakṛto yatra mugdhāṅganānāmaṅge saṃkocabhaṅgiḥ surataparikare yatra sītkāraśañdaḥ | taupāraṃ varṣamugraṃ kirati himakare śailarāje ca ropāttasmistāstāḥ saceṣṭāḥ kathamahaha! pure cāndratāpe'pyamavan ||14|| sarva -- (śrutvā sakrodham)ayi pāpāḥ!kimevaṃ bhavadbhirudūghupyate | tathāhi so'yaṃ pataṅgāddahanasya bhaṅgo dāvānalādepa samudraśopaḥ | garutmato rājilataḥ kṣayo'yaṃ yaccandrataḥ sīdati candratāpaḥ || 15 || (punarneṭhaye sagarvam) nivasati vaḍavāgniryatra sāyāmadhāmā viharati ca mahopmā yatra hālāhalīyaḥ | mayi śaśini saroṣe madrurostasya vārddheḥ kuru śāraṇagatastvaṃ candratāpātmarakṣām || 16 || sarva -- viśadāśaya! mama jñātervidhuntudasya bhakṣyo'yaṃ, tadenaṃ bhakṣayato mama na dopo'sti | phavalayāmyenam | viśa -- (sapraśrayam) ayi dānaveśa! bhavānenaṃ kavalayatu | bhavannideśena rāhureva vā bāḍhamapunarbhavāya kavalayatu | kiṃtu candratāpasamīpaṃ prahitaḥ pratīkṣyatāṃ sphuṭākṣaraḥ | (tataḥ praviśati sphuṭākṣaraḥ) sphuṭā -- (sakhedam) ahaha! vihivivarīdadāe vaibhavaṃpi vigharīdaphalaṃ bhodi | taṃpyeva caṃdatāvanaarassa rupyamayaṃ pāāraṃ ruppamaāiṃ sohāiṃ edatsi tusāraarasamarammi aitusāradāe aṇatthahalaṃ saṃvuttaṃ | sarva -- (sphuṭākṣaraṃ dṛṣṭvā saptambhramam) ayi dauvārikāḥ! pretaḥ ko'pyayaṃ māmabhyupaiti | sphuṭā -- (ptāvegam) api ṇāha! ṇahu ṇahu ahaṃ pedo bhūo veālo vā | ahaṃ phuḍaksaro devassa caro caṃdatāvavuttantaṃ ṇirūvidaṃ gudomhi | taṃ uṇa maha avatthāe ypeva vinnattaṃ ………………… e sisireṇa samaro diṭṭo | ṇa kaāci mae eāriso tusārasaṃbhavo aṇubhūdo | tā kiṃpi parittāṇaṃ karedu dāṇavaṇāho | sarva -- (sakodham) epa nirddahāmi himadīdhitiṃ himācalaṃ ca | (iti saṃramrbha nāṭayati) viśa -- (sapraśrayam) api dānaveśvara! kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ saṃrambheṇa | kṣayī himāṃśurhimaparvato'pi viviṣṭapādhośvaralūnapakṣaḥ | yuddhāya sannahyasi yattayostvaṃ mandākṣabhāraḥ kathamepa salyaḥ? || 17 || sarva -- tadihastha eva dahanāstraṃ prayuñje | (iti tayā karoti) (nepathye) praśamitahimakhedaṃ pāvakāstreṇa yena kṣaṇamiva puramāsotsusthitaṃ cāndratāpam | ahaha! niviḍadādṛdbhadrāvitaddhārasīdhaṃ prabalarajatapaṅgaistaddahatyāśu daityān || 18 || sarva -- (kṣrutvā sakrodham) upasaṃharāmyepa āgneyāstram| (iti tayā karoti) viśa -- ahaha! sumahānayaṃ saṅkaṭaḥ | āgneyāstraprayoge viyogena śiśiārābhibhavaḥ | āgreneyāstraṃ ca rājataṃ vilālayati | tadgaccha sphuṭākṣara! brūhi candratāpaṃ rājatapuramanarthanimittaṃ parihṛtya bahiḥ sthīyatāṃ vahiryudhyatām | sphuṭā -- yadā''diśati āryaḥ | (iti niṣkramati) viśa -- (vāmākṣispandanaṃ sūcayitvā) ahaha! kimetadācaṣṭe spandamānaṃ me vāmaṃ valiocanamma | astu sarvābhyudyabhājanaṃ sarvatāpaḥ | astu cāpratihatatejā daityaguruḥ | (nepayye) tāvadvastripurāsurāḥ! prasūmaraṃ trailokyajidvaibhavaṃ syūtaḥ paṅkajasambhavena niviḍastāvadvaraḥ kaṅkaṭaḥ| tatkandarpamahendhanaṃ tribhuvanaplopapragalbhaṃ kṣaye yāvannoddhaṭate manāgapi rupā tryakṣasya bhālekṣaṇam || 19 || viśa -- (namo'valokya saptambhramam) kathamāro kumāro nandisanāthavipulaparīvāraḥ samāpatati! | tathāhi taḍiddhadbhirmedhairiva cilamattālarasanairciśālairvetālairviyati pṛthukolāhalamayaḥ | mudā kekāśabdairgurusubhaṭanāde'pyapihitairmayūraḥ kaubhāro mukharaghati dikcakramaniśam || 20 || ayi dānaveśa! epa kumārastvāṃ saṅgramayitumabhyupaiti | gṛhāṇa kārmukam | (tataḥ praviśati yayā nirddiṣṭaḥ kumāra) sarva -- (sāvajñam) āḥ! yālako viśākhaḥ sarvatāpaṃ yodhayiṣyati? (ākāśe lakṣya baddhvā) dhanyo dhanyā pinākaḥ kuṭupaṭugatayo hetayaḥ śulamukhyāśvaṇḍāste pāhudaṇḍāḥ pravaṇaśikhiśikhābhīpaṇaṃ bhālacakṣuḥ | vālaṃ dulīlanīyaṃ kimiti paśupate! prāhiṇoḥ saṅgarārthaṃ (sopahāsam) vīrāṇāṃ yuddhakelibyatikaramaraṇe kaḥ kramo'tikramo vā || 21 || kumāra -- (sopahāsam) aye tātena sārddha yuddhaśraddhālurdānavādhamaḥ | api vīra! kiṃ tvāṃ bhasmīkaromi smaramiva sahasā kiṃ nu te bāhudaṇḍastambhaṃ jambhasya śatroriva yudhi vivadhe śveḍayatkiṃ gilāmi | channābhaṃ śaktidaṇḍagrathitamatha karomyandhakasyeva te'ṅgaṃ kīhakte tāta! yuddhaṃ sukhayati danujaśreṣṭha! tāddagvidaddhyām || 22|| sarva -- ayi kumāra! vālako'si | tvāmanukampe| yadi satyaṃ saṅgare niṣkampo'si tadāviṣkuru kārmukakarmaṭhatvam | tvāṃ na kṣiṇomi śikhivāhanamandaśakti yuddhāmbudhau sugahane nahi tārako'ham | tasmistadā śaravaṇe jananistavāsīdasminyudhaḥ śaravaṇe maraṇaṃ bhajasva || 23 || kumāra -- (sasambhramam) śaktirgataiva tava dānava! śaktiyogaḥ śaktyā bhaviṣyati mayā hṛdi muktayā te| tvadvigrahagrahilatā na bhavipyatīyaṃ bāṇairmamāśu bhavitāsi parāsureva || 24 || (iti bāṇavarpe nāṭayati) sarva -- (ptāvajñaṃ vihasya) ayi viśākha!sukhayati māṃ kutūhalinaṃ tava yālasya dhāṣṭaryaṃ, tannāhaṃ tvayi dhanuḥ sajjaṃ karipye | khelatu bhavānyathākāmaṃ mama sainye | nandī -- (apavārya) kumāra! viriñcivaradānena kevalā amarā eva tripurāsurāstadalamanena sārddha mudhā yuddhāyāsena | balamevāsya vidalaya vāṇavarpaiḥ | (kumāraḥ tathā karoti) nandī -- (saharpe sollāsam) vijayatāṃ kumāraḥ | itastvayā vāṇagaṇairvetālaikṣca vidalitā eva dānavāḥ | kumāraḥ -- api śilādasūno! kathaṃ ya eva duānavā nihatāsta eva pratijīvitā udāyughāḥ samāyānti? | tatkimetat? | viśa -- ṃre re daityavīrāḥ! samaroparatānvīrānamṛtakuṇḍe majjayata yayā pratyujjīvitāḥ samadhikayalaṃ yudhyante | (nepathye) kriyata evaitat | kinna paśayatyamātyastathaiva valamakṣayam | kumāraḥ -- (sollāptam) ayi sarvatāpa! satatamamṛtakuṇḍaṃ yarddhatāṃ varddhatāṃ te samaranihatavīrā yena jīvanti bhūyaḥ | viratamaraṇaśaṅkaistvadbhaṭairyudhyamānairbhavati mama yato'yaṃ yuddhakāmaḥ kṛtārthaḥ || 25 || nandī -- (apavārya) ayi kumāra! āgreneyabāṇalṛnaiḥ svarṇaprākārakhaṇḍaiḥ pūrayāmṛtakuṇḍam | nānyathā kṣīyante dānavākṣohiṇyaḥ | (kumāraḥ tathā karaṃti) (nepathye) svarṇaprākārarakhaṇḍaiḥ śistriviśiravaśikhākhaṇṅayamānaiḥ sutasaiḥ pūrṇa pīyūpakuṇḍaṃ chamiti mukharitaiḥ pītapīyūpapūraiḥ | (nepathye) kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaiḥ kayamiva samare dānavaijīṃvitavyaṃ tatpūrvo'yaṃ praviṣṭaḥ prasabhamapacayaḥ sarvatāpasya sainye || 26 || viśa -- (samartham) ayi kātarāḥ! keyamākulatā! | nandati bhṛgunandane ka dānavānāmapacayaḥ? | api dānaveśa saryatāpa! cintaya bhārgavaṃ bhagavantam | ahamapi cintayāmi | (umau cintāṃ nāṭayataḥ) (tataḥ praviśati bhārgavaḥ) bhārgavaḥ -- (sagarvam) aśoṣyo'ddamapeyo'hamahāryo'hamanakṣcaraḥ | māyāmṛte ca daityānāṃ mṛtyorabhibhavaḥ kutaḥ || 27 || tāṃ pratijīvitā dānavāḥ kṣapayantu devavāhinīṃ, rakṣaṇīyaḥ paramayaṃ mama bhrātā kumāraḥ | ahaṃ hi bhagavatā bhargeṇa putraḥ parikalpito'smi | nandī -- (sakhedum) aye bhārgavaḥ samprāpsaḥ | anena hi devadevādeva bhṛtasaṃjīvanī vighā samāsāditā | tadidānīmāyāsaikaphalo danujaiḥ saha samarasaṃmaddaiḥ | na ca me maheśanideśamantareṇa yujyate samarādapāvartayituṃ kumāraḥ | (tataḥ praviśati nāradaḥ) nāradaḥ -- (saharyam) aho jagatprabhoḥ śambhormayi parihāso, yadahamayi kalipriya! yāraya kumārasarvatāpayoḥ samarasammarddamiti vihasya prepito'smi | mamāpi na tādṛgidānāṃ kalahāvalokanakutūhalitvam | yadahaṃ lohapurasamarasammardasaṃdarśanenārddhatṛpto rājatapurakadanāvalokanena sutarāṃ sṛtṛsaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | ahaha! kimucyate lohapuraploṣaṇena | pavanapāvakayoḥ śaurya himāṃśorhimavatakṣca nīhārabhāreṇa rājatapurapūraṇam | ubhayatrāpi nirgatyarāsurasārthavanghane pāśapāṇerlaghuhastatā | tāvatāmapi jīvināpaharaṇe kiṃ carṇayāmi samarasāmarthyam | tadidāṇnīṃ tvaritamapavartayāmi samarattaḥ kārttikeyam | (puro'valokya saharyāścaryam) kathamayaṃ kārttikeyo vithṇupadamabhivarpati śarāsāram | ahaha nāyaṃ mukhenaiva piturmaheśātparānkrameṇāpyadhikaḥ paḍāsyaḥ! yaḥ pṛjyate vismṛtaśambhuśauryairmandāradāmaprakareṇa siddhaiḥ || 28 || (tadupasṛtya vārayāmi | upaptṛtya) ayi kumāra! ayi śilādasūno! samādiśati vo bhagavānbhargaḥ | ayaṃ hi bhārgayo mayā putratvena sambhāvitastatkimetatparigṛhītaṃ sarvanāpaṃ dānavamabhitāpayanmāṃ jhepayasi | nandī -- (svagatam) asmadabhimanamevopakrāntametena) (prakāśam) yathā''diśati decadevaḥ | (kārttikeyaṃ prati) āyupmannanullaṅvayaḥ pitṛnideśastadāstāṃ tāvaghṛddham | kumāraḥ -- (svagataṃ sakheddam) aho me mandabhāgyatā, yadetasya cirādāsāditasyāhavamahotsavasya pratyūhaḥ samāpatitaḥ | (praphāśam) (niśvamya) yathā''diśanti tātapādāḥ | (iti saparivārā nipkramanti) śukraḥ -- (saharpe svagatam) aho! dānaveṣu kruddhasyāpi bhagavato vṛṣabhadhvajasya mayi navaṃ navaṃ sanmānam (prakāśam) ayei dānaveśa! sarvatāpa! api vatsa viśadāśaya! ita āgamyatāṃ sambhāvayāmaḥ samarapīḍitānasrurān | (iti niṣkrāntāḥ saṃrve) tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ (nepathye) prasmaramayūraviśikhaḥ sṛryaḥ saṃharati cairitimiraugham | nahi yasya stharayaddharyā dṛramadṛraṃ kimapyasti || 1 || viśa -- (śrutvā pratibudhya) kathamāyātaṃ prabhātam | āḥ! keneṃmāṃ prātareva durūpaśrutiṃ śrāvito'smi | athavā stavamukhaḥ kopi de……………………………………………….. tat | tadahaṃ gatvā gurormagavato bhārgavasya pādāravindavandanāṃ vidadhe | (parikramya puro'valokya) ayamasti bhagavānbhārgavaḥ ……………..renamantarapadravyadurābhākaramvitaṃ sphaṭikamiva kaśmalamavalokayāmi (sahasopasṛtya) bhagavanmārgava! epa tvāṃ…………… 'bhivādayate | śukraḥ -- saumya! cirāya jīva | viśa -- (ptapraśrayam) kiṃ punaragha bhagavantamanyāśamiva vibhāvayāmi | śukraḥ -- (sakhedam) ayi viśadāśaya! duḥsvapnadarśanopanītavaimanasyena malinīkṛto'smi | tadahamidānī kimapi śāntikamanuṣṭhātuṃ yatiṣye | (nepathye) asmatpuṇyaprakarṣeṇa pāṃḍaśāpyekanāṃ gatāḥ | adhunā sadya evāmī brayo yāsyanti pañcatām ||2|| viśa -- (ākarṇya) keyamākāśasarasvatyā prahelikecodāhṭatā| śukraḥ -- kṣaṇamiva dhyānaṃ nāṭayitvā) vatsa viśadāśaya! neyamākāśasarasvatī byāharati | citraśigvaṇḍino'mī tripurāsurottāpitāstadvināśāyolmahante | vivecitaṃ mayā maheśamamugyā digiśā hariviriñcikrauñcārinagendranāgendracandrasūryadharmāḥ poḍaśāpi tripurāsuravadhāya baddhakakṣāḥ saṃvṛttā aikyaṃ ganāḥ | viśa -- (sakhedam) ahaha! atyāhitamatyāhitam | śukraḥ -- vatsa viśadāśaya! akathanaṃ duḥsvapnānāṃ śreyasladidānī munivacanena mumbarīkṛto'smi | ākarṇayatu bhavān | sarvāmānyaṅgadhāraḥ śirasi vinihatottālabandhūkamālastiṣṭhannuṣṭre vasāno vasanamanukṛtaplakṣavālapravālam | vibhradvaivāhikaśrīparikaramakhilaṃ maṅgalottālatūrye dṛṣṭo gacchannavācīṃ rajanipariṇatau sarvatāpo mayāgha || 3 || tadyāyadahaṃ śāntikaṃ vairivañcanāprakāraṃ ca (karṇe evameva) samāpyāgacchāmi tāvadiha bhavatā'vahitena sthātavyam | utsāhabhaṅgaśaṅkayā sarvatāpasyāppanivedya yāsyāmi | nacaite dūrasthāḥ kālasya gocarāḥ | ato na tvayā bhetanyam | viśa -- (sakhedaṃ niḥśvasya) carantu dūrataḥ svairaṃ mṛtyorete na dūrataḥ | yepu pātakapakkepu saropo vṛpabhadhvajaḥ || 4|| śukraḥ api mā vipīda| yadyadbhavati vidheyaṃ yadā yadā ladvidhehi saduddhyā | bhagavānacintyacarito vatpta! viveyo vidhiḥ kasya ||5|| bhagavantamapi varadātāraṃ dhātāraṃ nāradenoddīghamānakrovānalaṃ paśyāmi dhyānamayena nayanena | tadgacchāvahito bhava | ahamapi samīhitaṃ sādhayāmi | (iti niṣkrāntau) viṣkambhakaḥ (tataḥ praviśati viriñciridaśca) viriñciḥ -- (sanirvedam) vatsa nārada! kiṃ māṃ kadarthayasi? | madvāṇīsāraṇī yā sphuradamṛtavarā daityavṛkṣānapuṣṇāt sadyaḥ saivogradāyānalalahaririva jvālayettānkathaṃ nu | aimnūreṃ yasya lokatritayakaruṇayā vidvamatryādvatājñaṃ devo raudraḥ sa raudrairdalayatu danujānnigrahaiḥ kālapakāna || 6 || nāradaḥ–tāta! alaṃ kampena | mānanīyatya tava śāsanasyaipa prabhāvaḥ, yadanī tripurāsurakīṭakā iyatīṃ koṭimāruḍhāstadhaṃ durvivepaṃ bhagavānbharga evāṅgīkurute | tadalamidānīmalīkaparāmarśamantharatayā | paśyantu tātapādāḥ | devasya pramathādhipasya rathinaḥ pṛthvī rathaḥ syātparaṃ tāta! tvāmapahāya tatra katamaḥ sārathyakarmakṣamaḥ |
kodaṇḍo girirāja eva bhujagaprapṭhastadīyo guṇaḥ ' syādaucityavatī trivikramatanostasyaiva tadvārāṇatā || 7|| (nepathye) bhrātarnārada! tcaraya tvaraya tātapādān | ārūḍha evā'yaṃ bhagavānghanvidhuryo dhūrjaṭiḥ pṛthvīratham | nāradaḥ -- (saharpautsukyam) ayi tāta! jyeṣṭhastavasuto gharmo'yaṃ vyāharati | paśyadevenānghakasūdanena rathinā sotsāhamadhpāsitaḥ prāpto'yaṃ pṛthivīratho'dbhutatamaḥ ptaptanilāśvaiścalan | cakrībhūtasudhākarārkakiraṇastomena vistāriṇā svargaṅgāsarasīruhepu yugapannidrāprayodhau dadhan || 8 || ete ca mahendraprabhṛtayo'ditijā anudhāvanti | brahmā -- (vilokya sautsukyam) tāta nārada! ehyehi | (umāvupamṛtya rathāghiroharṇa nāṭayataḥ) brahmā -- (maheśamālokya sapraśrayam) āyuṣmān -- (ityardhotau satrīḍasyitam) bhagavanbharga! epa tvāṃ tava sāradhiḥ praṇamati | maheśaḥ -- (sūta ityardhoktau salañjām) śāntaṃ pāpam | prapāmāmi pitāmaham | kuru sārathyam | (brajhā nāṭadhena sārathyamadhyāste) nāradaḥ -- (saptambhramam) dhanudhainurddharaṃ lakṣyaṃ yo mutto'pi na muñcati | so'yaṃ nivīṇakṛdvāṇastāta! vipṇuḥ praṇāmyatām || 9 || vrahmā -- (ptaptambhramaṃ praṇamya) vatsa nārada! anenāviddhamevāsti vipṇuvāṇena viṣṭapam | asyecchayā sapakṣasya jīvatti mriyate'thavā || 10 || vāsudevaḥ -- (ptaptamdhramam) abhivādayate'ghra bhagacantamācāryam! (ptarve yapocitamupaviśānti) maheśaḥ(puro'valokya sāścaryam) āḥ paśyata paśyata | sauvarṇaṃ puramabhyupaiti nikaṭaṃ yasyotkaṭairaṃśubhiḥ saṃvītaṃ viyadaṅgaṇaṃ tulayati syarṇācalopatyakāḥ | viṣṇuḥ -- (sākṣcaryam) gaṅgāḍambarakāri kāntipaṭalaṃ tatpṛṣṭato rājataṃ brahmā -- (sākṣcaryam) pratyagrāmbudavṛndavibhramakaraṃ lauhaṃ tadīyāntike || 11|| maheśaḥ -- aho dānavānāṃ śauryamadamohitānāṃ buddhiviparyayo yadamī svayamevaikaśaraśaravyatāṃ pratipadyante | viṣṇuḥ -- (savitarkam) kathaṃ nu te śukrasacivā evaṃ vimuhyanti | nṛnamanyaiva sā kkacidasti satyā puratrayī | iyaṃ punaranyaiva | (tataḥ praviśati sauvarṇena pureṇa viharansaparivāra ptarvatāpaḥ) sarvatāpaḥ -- (ptagarvaropam) ārya viśadāśaya! paśya paśya devānāṃ duvinayaṃ yadiyamasmatpratiyoginī aparā puratrayī nirmitā | gaccha re sphuṭākṣara | gaccha | ānaya sūryatāpacandratāpau sapurau | duhyatāmiyaṃ devanirmitā̱ purañnayī | sphuṭā -- (puro'valokya)kadhaṃ āgadyyevasujjatāvacaṃdatāvā | pekkhadu deyo | sarva -- (dṛpṭā saharṇam) sādhu sādhu etābhyāmapi dṛṣṭaiva māyāmayī tripurī | viśa -- (sākṛtaṃ vihasya) daityanātha! kimākulosi? | nivartaya puratrayam | sarva -- (sakrodham) aho bhavataḥ sācivyam | dvitīyā puratrayī yoddhumabhyeti | tvaṃ ca vihasasi | (viśadāśayaḥ sautsukyamutthāya karṇe evameveti) sarva -- (sakrodham) āḥ! kimanena mṛpā karṇajāpena | ko vimcasiti bhavatāṃ devatānugatamunikulotpannānāṃ dvijanmanām | yaghevaṃ kimiti māmasambhāṣyaiva śukro gataḥ | evaṃkṛte kimasmānsṛpakṛtaṃ, pratyutāpakṛtameva | tathāhi puratrayaṃ dāhayitā śivena nirmāya māyāmayi cetsa śukraḥ | kṛto hareṇa tripurasya dāhastadepa rūḍaḥ paramo'pavādaḥ || 12 || tadāyai! yathecchaṃ gamyatāṃ tāvat | padasmāsu bhāvi tadbhaviṣyati | viśa -- (ptarīṣaṃ svagatam) nūnaṃ pratyāmannamaśubhamasya |viparyastā vuddhistadevamevāstu | (prakāśam) epa yāmi guroḥ sakāśam | (iti niṣvāmati) maheśaḥ -- (ptatyapuratrayīmālokya sāścaryam) phalitaṃ trivikramavitarkeṇa | āgatā puratrayīyamaparā | brahmā -- kā punaranayoḥ satyā kā māyāmayīti na jñāyate | nāradaḥ -- (sautsukyam) kimanena parāmarśaprasāreṇā! vāṇagocaratāṃ gatā iyamapi vadhyatām | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saparihāsam) rocate kalipriyāya | kintu kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣyanām | sarva -- (sagarvaropam) api sūryatāpa! api candratāpa! tvaryatāṃ tvarpatāṃ hanyatāṃ hanyatāmiyaṃ devanirmitā puratrayī | (inei vāṇavarme nāṭayanti) maheśaḥ -- (sāścaryamālokya) ahaha! dṛśyatāṃ dṛśyatām | (savitarkam) ayamarajanijanmā kinnu ko'pyandhakāraḥ kimapamanalavāhyaḥ ko'pi dhūmyāvitānaḥ | apamaśubhasamutthaḥ śālabhaḥ kiṃ samūhaḥ kimapamasurasainyānnirgato bāṇapūraḥ || 13 || kṛpṇaḥ -- (ptāścaryama) kathamapagataiva prathamodgatā puratrayī | aho mahīyānayaṃ moho yadiyaṃ daityapakṣapātinī ddhitīyā tripurī | tatkimiti sarvatāpādibhirdrāvitā | nūnamepā sṛguptaṃ śukranirmitā bhaviṣyatyanabhijñairebhijñairebhirddaptairudyate | bhavatvabhimatameva naḥ | sarva -- (vibhāvya sagarvam) kathamapasṛtaiva devasṛṣṭā kapaṭatripurī | (sakrodhamākāśe lakṣyaṃ badhvā) re re! surāḥ samarakarmaṇi nirvikāre lkīvāḥ kimityahaha! kaitavamārabhadhvam | kinte vayaṃ ditisunāḥ kapaṭapradhānaistaistairbhavadvilasitaiḥ pralayaṃ payurye || 14 || nāradaḥ -- (ptautsukyam)kimidānīṃ pratīkṣpate | pratyāsannā eva hanyantāmamī | maheśaḥ -- ayi nārada! ko'yamavasaraḥ parākramasya | svenaivepupathe bhavanti yadamo darpajyaronmohitāḥ pārṇi kasya dhanurgrahīpyati hahā! hantuṃ tadetānapi | tucche karmaṇi bhūriḍambaragharaṃ dhigdhanghinaṃ dhigdhanurdhigvāṇaṃ dhigamuṃ raṇavyatikaraṃ dhikasārathiṃ dhigratham || 15 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sotprāptam) api kalimiya! sādhūkttaṃ parameśvareṇa | pratīkṣatāṃ, bhavantu tāyadarmo bhūyo'pi tathaiva durddharṣāḥ | durāgharpe hi vidvipi vikramaḥ prakarpamabhyupapadyate | sphuṭā -- (sapraśrayam) nāha savvatāva! ṇiddalido dāva esa vairīṇā vaṃcaṇāpavaṃco | tā saṃpai tahatahaccea ṇiaṭṭāṇesu saṃcarantu sujjatāvacaṃdātavo | ṇa eārisī ṇīdī bhodi, jaṃ ekkaṭhāṇe ciṭṭoadi | sarva -- (sotprāptam) sphuṭākṣara! krodhano'si | kaste vacanamullaṅghapituṃ paryāptaḥ? | kāraya yathocitam | sphuṭā -- jaṃ āṇavedi sāmī -- (iti nipphamya tathā tathā kārayati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (ptaptambhramamavalokya) ayi maheśā! dṛśyatāṃ dṛśyatām | idānīmamī suṣṭu samadhikāntarāle saṃvṛttā na jāne dhātagocare bhaviṣyanti na veti | maheśaḥ -- (saharpollaptaṃ sahasotthāya) hatā evāmo | ka idānīṃ sandehaḥ | vāhayatu bhagavānviriñcirvegena ratham (viriñcistathā karoti) nāradaḥ -- (vyākuchatābhabhinayansaptambhramam) āḥ! kathamātmānamapi nānena rathaśarayeṇa jānāmi | kka me darśanaśravaṇaśakttī | api parameśā! tadahaṃ kutūhalāyalokananaralamunimaṇḍalamadhye kailāsārūḍho drakṣpāmi | (ityantarikṣagatyā tathā karoti) nāradaḥ -- (puro'valokya sāścaryam) vāṇo harirvijayate'ndhakasṛdanasya vāggocarā bhavati yasya na vegalakṣmīḥ | lakṣyaṃ kimapyabhavadanyadivābhigamyaṃ mārgāyitaṃ punaramuṣya puratrayeṇa || 16 || ārya dharma! paśya paśya | kṛtāryaya cakṣuṣī | yugapadeva jvalatīyaṃ puratrayī śaṅkaraśarānalena | dharma -- (saparitoṣamālokya) sādhu sādhu | prāgyāgavighnaprathitoruvairastretānalo'yaṃ kalitāvakāśaḥ | balena śambhostritayaṃ purāṇāṃ jvālākarālaḥ kavalīkaroti || 17 || (nepathye) aspṛśyasparśakāraḥ prasabhamapanayanvarṇabhedavyavasthāṃ lokaṃ niḥsīmaśokaṃ ruditamayadṛśaṃ kalpayankāndiśīkam | kurvansanmārgarodhaṃ śiśuyuvatigurudhvaṃsakarmaṇyaśaṅkaḥ kusvāmīvaiṣa vahniḥ pralayamupanapatyāśu hā! dhikpurāṇi || 18 || api ca śayyāṃ śrānta ivābhyupaiti nṛpavadbhadrāsanaṃ sevate garbhāgāramupaiti kāmuka ica drohīva rundhe diśaḥ | svairaṃ vīra iyāśvahastinivahānmaynāti vahnayātmakaḥ ko'yaṃ ko'yamaho puratrayakṛte dhigdeva! sṛṣṭastvayā || 19 || munayaḥ -- (śrutvā saharpam) diṣṭyā śrutaṃ tāvadagha śrotavyam | nāradaḥ -- (namo'valokya sagatam) āryāḥ vyākulo'smi | na paśyāmi devān | munayaḥ -- (sāśaṅkam) tāta nārada! nirūpaya nirūpaya | nāradaḥ -- (hābādhāmabhinayan) āryāḥ! kiṃ nirūpayāmi | kavacitakakumo'mī imāmalā dhūmakṛṭāḥ kanakaśikhariśṛṅgaprāṃśurarciḥprapañcaḥ | taruṇataruṇāgukhāpukhapiṅgā sphuliṅgāḥ kimapi nabhasi nānyatturyamālokayāmi || 20 || munayaḥ -- (puro'valomya saharpam) ahaha! harthavyākulo'si | kinna paśyasi nisvilasṛraparivāraṃ rathārūḍhamāyāntaṃ tripurāntakam? | (tataḥ praviśa te yathāneirdiṣṭo maddeśaḥ) maheśaḥ -- bhagavansurajyeṣṭha! sthāpaya ratham | sthīyatāmihaiva kkapi munināradasanāthe kailāsaikadeśe | (bradmā tathā karotei | nāradādyāḥ sapraśrayamupasṛtya praṇamanti) maheśaḥ -- ayi devāḥ! sarve radhādvatīrya yathāpathamupaviśata | upaviśantu cātrabhavanto munayaḥ | (sarve tayā kurvanti kṣtrayayaḥ | ptaharpe maheśaḥ ptatrīḍamāstte) nāradaḥ -- (saddarpam) ayi jagannātha! kiṃ te devā ucitaṃ pāritodhikamihādbhute karmaṇi kurvantu? utkṛtya maulikamalairnavacandracūḍa! tvaṃ pūjyase yadi kimapyucittaṃ tathā syāt | tubhyaṃ tadapyahaha! na svadate śivāya trailokyarakṣaṇāparāya kimatra kurmaḥ || 21 || maheśaḥ -- (sabrīḍasmitam) ayi nārada! vaikuṇṭhaḥ padmajanmā tridaśaparivṛdaḥ pāyakaḥ pretanātho rakṣo vārāmadhīśaḥ pavanadhanapatīo sūryacandrau kumāraḥ | dharmaḥ śepādrirājāyahamapi taralaḥ poḍaśaḥ kautukārthī māmevaikaṃ kimitthaṃ tripuravaghavidhau kṣlāghase nārada! tvam ||22|| indraḥ -- (sapraśrayam) vyāpriyante tvayā svairaṃ nijā avayavāḥ surāḥ | tvamekaḥ pūrupaḥ stutyaḥ pṛthaggaṇanayātra kim || 23 || maheśaḥ -- (svagatam) aye saṅkocayati māmiyaṃ vrīḍā | tadvisarjayāmi nirjarān | (prakāśam) ayi bhagavanto gīrvāṇāḥ! sthīyatāṃ yathāyathaṃ yathāsusvaṃ, samādiśāta ca kimidānīṃ karomi | indraḥ -- (saprakṣrayama) mrayo'pyete tvayā daityā dopā iva nirākṛtāḥ | akṣayāṇi jagantpāsanprārthyate kimivādhunā || 24 || tathāpīdamastu cūḍācandrāvadātena sphuradbhālākṣirocipā | nirastamohatimiraṃ tvayā'stu hṛdayaṃ satām || 25 || (iti niṣkāntā sarve) caturtho'ṅkaḥ iti mahākavrivatsarājaviracitastripuradāhābhidhānī himaḥ samāptaḥ | hāsyacūḍāmaṇiḥ prahasanam kalyāṇaṃ vitarantu vaḥ pṛthujaṭājūṭāgravistāriṇaste cūḍāśaśinaḥ śiraḥsuradhunīghārānukārāḥ karāḥ | yānutprekṣya madopmabhāravidhure śuṇḍāradaṇḍaṃ mṛpā heramve ghaṭayatyanāratamabhūdullāsihāso haraḥ || 1 || api ca bhūyiṣṭhāḥ parirambhakelipu bhujāḥ sotkaṇṭhamālokane netrāṇi pracurāṇi cumbanavidhau bhūyāṃsi ghaktrāṇi te | itthaṃ bhūnūrivadhūvilāsaghaṭanāsajcasya kā'haṃ tava prokttaṃ makoghaviruddhayeti śivayā smero haraḥ pātu vaḥ || 2 || (nāndyante) sūtradhāraḥ -- (nabho'valokya) aye vibhātaiva śarvarī | (pratīcīmavalokya) ahaha | samaya eva sarva śobhate | tathāhi navavicakilamālāmāṃsalairyaistadānīṃ madanamayamaśepaṃ viśvametavdyaghāpi | caramaśikhariśīrye sanniviṣṭāst ete dadhati palitabharṅgi bhānavaḥ kṣvetabhānoḥ || 3 || aye!tanmamāpi jarāparādhonasya hāsyakara evāyaṃ nāṭyābhiyogaḥ | (praviśya) pāripārśvakaḥ -- bhāva! hāsoyyeva ajca ramaṇijjo jaṃ esa nīlakaṃṭhajattāmahūsavasamāgāderhi viaḍrasāmājiehiṃ pariarido rāā paramaṅḍievo actaṇo amacceṇa kaviṇā vaccharāeṇa viraidaṃ hāsacūḍāmarṇiā ṇāma pahasaṇaṃ ahiṇedumādisadi bhavaṃtaṃ | sūtra -- (saddaryam) āḥ! sanyaganugṛhīto'smi | ayameva devo rūpakanirūpaṇānaipuṇaikapātram | (sāścaryamādhūya śiraḥ) gehepu prasabhaṃ sadaiva vidupāṃ sāpatnyavairagrahāddāsīkartumanārataṃ vitaraṇakrīḍābhirabgheḥ sutām | epa kṣrīparamarddidevannṛpatirnissīmavidyānidhirnūnaṃ vāgadhidevatā bhagavatī pumbhāvamṛbhyāgatā ||4 || mārpa! tadgaccha sajjīkriyantāṃ kuśīlavāḥ || pūrṇoḥ samprati me manorathāḥ | yataḥ paripadiyamudārajñānasaujanyaghanyā rasaparacaśavāṇīcatsalo vatsarājaḥ | ayamapi naṭacargo nāṭyamudrāpaṭipṭhaḥ phalati sukṛtarāśiḥ prākttanaḥ ko'pyayaṃ me || 5 || (nepathye gīyate) pattuṃ ṇiasaṃpartti parimusiaṃ visamatimiracoreṇa | eptā aṃvaralacchī bhaavantaṃ sūramaṇusaradi || 6 || sūtra -- (ścutvā saharṣam) mārpa! sancā eva kuśīlavāḥ, yadiyaṃ kapaṭakelikuṭṭanyāḥ prāveśiko ghruvā gīyate | tadehyāvāmanantarakaraṇīoyaṃ sampādayāvaḥ | (iti nipkāntau) (prastāvanā) (tanaḥ praviśati suptosyitā kapaṭakeli) kapaṭakeliḥ -- (vibhāvya) aho paccūho saṃvutto | saṃcaridā dāva gāvakkhajālantaraṃ purāpagasīdhughārāsoarā sṛrassa bālakarā | kaghai maha mairāpāṇabharālasāe ekkaṇiddāpayyeva raaṇo volīṇā | (smṛtimabhinīya saharpotkaṇṭham) ae paosasamaamairāe mahurattaṇaṃ | tā saṃpaijjeva taṃ āṇaissaṃ | ṇa hu amihīdamuvvaradi ramaṇīyaṃ vatyu | bhuaṃge aṇurajladi | edāe coriāe esamhṛghare kalaho vipatthāvido | (prakāśam) kusṛmie! tā kassa vi nāṇiṇo muheṇa edaṃ payāsaissaṃ | atthi ittha jiṇṇujjāṇamaḍhammi kevalīnāṇaniuṇo nāṇarāsī nāma bhaavo | tā pucchiṭuṃ gamissaṃ | jaggayesu muggaraaṃ jahā esovi aṇuaro bhodi | kusu -- muggaraa! muggaraa! jaggesu jaggesu | (ceṭastathaipa śete) vāḍhaṃ khu daṭṭo esa ṇiddoraīe | nīlakaṃṭho jai imaṃ jaggāvedi | kapaṭa -- ahaṃ jāṇemi edassa kae kaṇṇajāvaṃ | moggaraa! moggaraa! jaggesu jaggesṛ | āṇesṛ taṃ sucakikhadaṃ kaḍuya mairaṃ! ceṭaḥ -- kṛsṛmie! genha genha bhāaṇāī | kapaṭa -- vaccha muggaraa! ahaṃ tumaṃ pi dāva gacchamha yāva kusṛmiā bhāaṇāiṃ pakkhālia āṇedi | (iti parikātaḥ) ceṭaḥ -- attā kiṃ uṇa aṇṇado kudovi calidāsi | kapaṭa -- (savipādam) muggaraa! ṇa sudaṃ tae ajca attaṇo gharaghuttantaṃ | taṃ khu ciraālasaṃcidasatrvassaṃ ajja corehiṃ musidaṃ | tā ujjāṇamaḍhavāsiṇaṃ kevalīnāṇaṇiāuṇaṃ bhaavantaṃ nāṇarāsiṃ pucchiduṃ gamissaṃ | ceṭaḥ -- (svagataṃ saddarpam) jīvadha re coraā! jīvagha! | suhapariṇāmo bhodu tumhāṇaṃ esa vāvāro | ṇa hu esā haāsā muṭṭattamettaṃpi ucaramadi amhārisabhujaṅge anurajyūte! etayā cairikayā epo'smadrṭadde kalaho viprasatāvitaḥ | kusumike! tatkasyāpi jñānino mukhainaitat prakāśayiṣye! asti atra `jīrṇodyānamaṭhe kevalījñānanipuṇo jñānarāśirnāma bhagavān | tatpraṣṭuṃ gamiṣṭyāmi | jāgaraya mudrarakaṃ yathā so'pi anucaro bhavati | ssa gharaaṇassa aṇatthaparaṃparāo patthāvaantī |(prakāśaṃ sakhedamiva) haddho haddhī attā kiṃ edaṃ saṃvuttaṃ | ṇa tahā maṃ bādhedi atthaṇāso jahā ajjuā vi musidatti parāhavo | pā hu aggī keṇavi daddho suṇīadi | ahacā divvāhīṇā ghaṇahāṇī | ṇatthi parāhaco | tahā a jāṇaṃtāṇa samakkhaṃ ṇāaraloāṇa musai savvassaṃ | helāe amha attā kaha coro attiāsariso || 8 || kapaṭa -- moggaraa! savvassa paṇāse ko esa vakkakkharakālo padiāro dāca kīradu | mudgarakaḥ -- padiāraṃ karemi | (ākāśe lakṣyaṃ yaddhā) haṃhoḥ loavālā ṇa bhavissadha ṇa bhavissadha jaṃ attāe dhammaparāe parimusidaṃ catyu upekkhagha ? | kapaṭa -- ceḍā ceḍā! kiṃ asaṃyaddhaṃ mantesi? | ceṭaḥ -- saṃvaddhaṃ mantemi | diṭṭiā esā māāvaṃcidasaalabhuaṇā attā corehiṃ parimusidā | kapaṭa -- (sakrodham) moggaraa! ṇa saṃvarasi attaṇo miñcuduāraṃ muha | (iti capeṭena tāḍayati) ceṭaḥ -- (savailakṣyamapasṛtya) attā saṃbaddhe asaṃvaddhe vi kuppasi | ṇa tae saha gamissaṃ | hatāśā muhūrtamātramapi uparamati asmādṛśaḥ gṛhananaraya anarthaparamparāḥ, prastāvayantī | hā dhikū hā ghik amba! kimetat sṛṃ ttam | na tathā māṃ yādhate arthanāśo yayā āryā'pi mupitā iti parābhavaḥ | na khalu agniḥ phenāpi dugdhaḥ śrūyate | ayavā daivādhīnā dhanahāniḥ | nāsti parābhava | tathā ca 'tātatāṃ mamakṣaṃ nārāralokānāṃ mupṇāti sarvasvam | helayā asmākamamvā kathaya cauraḥ ambāsadṛśaḥ || kapaṭha -- (sānukampamiva) mogggaraa! moggaraa! ehi ehi dāva pāvide satrvasse mṛyiṭvaṃ mairāmahasavo māṇaidacvo | (iti haste grahītvā parikrāmati) ceṭaḥ -- '(samantādavalokya) aho vasantāvaāramaṃḍidassa sasirīattaṇaṃ ujjāṇassa attā thecchagha pecchadha | matto bhuaṃgovva samakasvameso jaṃ chappao cuvai ekkrameṅkaṃ | teṇavva e㌝āo hasanti vallīvilāsiṇīo kusumukkahiṃ || 9 || avi a mattāo rolaṃvṛvilāsiṇīo geaṃ maaraddhaassa | taṃ caia cittāṇilacālidāo ṇaccanti vallīo laalkameṇa |
kapaṭa -- (niścasya) muggaraa! ṇa me dukkhattahiaāe paḍihādda vasanto | ceṭaḥ -- pā kevalaṃ tujjha , (aṅgulyā nirdiśan) edāe vi || tahā a esā rolaṃvasuṇṇadāe tunhikā kusumabhūsaṇummukkā | lavikhajvai kuṃdalāā musiñavva vasantacoreṇa || 10 || kapaṭa -- muggaraa! gaccha dāva ṇiārūvehi imammi maḍhammi kiṃ kuṇanto so bhaao ciṭṭadi | ahaṃ uṇa ihayyeva ciṭṭissaṃ | (ceṭastathā kṛtvopagamya) ceṭaḥ -- attā duve kevi igha muṃḍidamuṃḍā vāākalaiṃ kuṇanti | ja ekko bhaṇadi taṃ avarovi tassa kae paḍibhaṇādi | kapaṭa -- muggaraa! so bhayavo sissa ajjhāvaanto ciṭṭhadi | tā ihayayeva ciṭṭhamha yāva se ajjhaaṇaṃ samappadi | (iti tayā kurutaḥ) (tataḥ praviśati śiṣyamadhyāpayanbhagavānkauṇḍinyaḥ) jñānarāśiḥ -- ayi! kaṃṭhagatau kṣlokau tavemau savṛttau? | śiṣyaḥ -- nāṇarāse! uaragadāvime saṃvuttāṃ | jñānarāśiḥ -- (sakrodham.) mūrkha! nāmagrahaṇena māṃ vyāharasi | śiṣyaḥ -- kiṃ tuha nāmaggahaṇeṇa pāvaṃ bhodi ? | jñāna -- dhiṅbhūrkha! na gṛhyate gurūṇāṃ nāma | śiṣyaḥ -- tā kadhaṃ selāṇaṃ ṇāma genhai | jñāna -- vighādānādinā guravo natu prathīyāsaḥ | upāghyāyapādā ityecāhaṃ tvayā vyāhāryaḥ | śiṣyaḥ -- uañjhāa! uaragadāvime saṃvuttā te duvevi siloā | suṣṇādu bhavaṃ | ālokya sarvagātrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | idamekaṃ tu nippannaṃ dhyeyo nārījanaḥ sadā || 11 || jñāna -- (sakrodham) dhiṅyūrarva! vaṇavipayayeṇa viplāvitavānasi | śipyaḥ -- uañjhāa! kosa kuppasi | jāriso tae paṃḍurayaṇṇo siloo lihido tāriso mae padido | (vṛpītalaṃ darśayati) jñāna -- (vihasya) mūrkha! akṣarānpathātvaṃ kṛnaṃ tattāyadvitīyaṃ paṭha | śiṣyaḥ -- namaste pāṇḍuraikākṣa! bemaste viśvatāpana! | namaste'stu mṛpākośa mahāpuruyakṛñcaika! || 12 || jñāna -- (sakobam) āḥ kṣudra! puppapāṇḍurākṣaṃ māmupahasasi! | (iti hantumupanmate) śiṣyaḥ -- (sasambhramamapasṛtya) kīsa maṃ tāḍesi? | ede rakhu haāsā uajjhāā ṇa sahanti attaṇo samahiamehāvisesaṃ sīsaṃ | tā gamissaṃ dāva! jñāna -- (svagatam) marmajño'yam | saṅgaha evāsya śreyān | (prakāśam) bats kauṇḍinya! ehyehi | śipyaḥ -- (sodvegam } pā āganissaṃ | caṃḍasīlo khu tumaṃ | jñāna -- kataiṇḍinya! alamuddhegenāsmccaṇḍaśīlatāyāḥ | paśpa nṛpatirakhilalokānpālayatyāttadaṇḍaḥ sukhayati jagadarkaḥ svīkṛtoṣṇāsvarūpaḥ | gururapi kaṭucepṭaḥ śāsni śāstrāṇi śipyaṃ pariṇatihittabhājāṃ bhaṅgirevaṃvidhaiva || 13 || tadehi punastvāṃ śuddhamadhyāpayāmi | (iti samāśvāsya pāṭhayati) ālokya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | idamekaṃ tu nippannaṃ dhyeyo mārāyaṇaḥ sadā || 14 || namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa! namaste viśvabhāvana! | namaste'stu hṛpokeśa! mahāpuruyapūrvaja! || 15 || (śiṣyagtathaiva paṭhasi) jñāna -- (sakrodham) mūrkha! evaṃ paṭha | śiṣyaḥ -- (punaśuddhaṃ paṭhati sanirvedm) uajjhāa! suṭṭhu' kaṭuakkharaṃ tuha edaṃ abhajjhāṇaṃ | ṇa a ediṇā kiṃpi pācīadi | tā maṃ kevalīvijjaṃ ajjhārvesṛ; jahā me jaṇassa ghaṇāiṃ sāhīṇāiṃ honrti | jñāna -- (sajuguṣsam) mūrkha! dhik tvāṃ dhik tvām | bhogākāṅkṣayā vādhyase | aho mohaḥ! bhṛgaḥ pāśānprāyaḥ pariharati yatnena mṛgāyoḥ pramādāvghānaddho bhavati sahasā śokavikalaḥ | ape suggho lokaḥ prakṛtivipamānhanta vipayānsvayaṃ kaṇṭhe pāśānghaṭayatitarāṃ hṛpyatitarām || 16 || śipyaḥ -- alahanto evaṃ mantesi | ṇa a tumaṃ jāṇāsi kevalīovijjāṃ | jñāna -- sūkha! ahameva kevalīṃ jāne kintu na śubhāvahetyavadhīritā | tathāhi divye śuddhikṛtā vyalophakathanāccaureṇa tāto hato bhrātā me vinanāṭr kālaphaṇinā daṣṭhau nighānaṃ khanana | yuddhajñānaviparyayānnṛpatinā hantuṃ samākāṅkṣito jāto'haṃ bhagavāniyaṃ kularipurvighā hi naḥ kecalī || 17 || śeṣyaḥ -- (vihasya) jāṇidaṃ dāva tipaurusaṃ tumhāṇaṃ nāṇamāhappaṃ | tā jāṇāyesu maṃ taṃ attaṇo saṃvalabhūdaṃ rahassaṃ | jñāna -- (sasmitam) mūrkha | mukharo'si | nārhasi kevalīśipyatvam | śiṣyaḥ -- (sākūtaṃ vihasya) uajjhāa! kiṃ kiṃ muharattaṇeṇa mae tuha paoāsidaṃ | jñāna -- kauṇḍinya! tyamasmākamātmaivāsi | tadākarṇaya kevalīvidāṃ prathamācāram | kiṃ ghāgbhirnikapo hi naḥ phalamiti syādgūḍhagarvagrahaḥ praśneṣyūvilaḍchuktṛraṃ viracayenna vyāharennirṇayamūr | siddhaṃ kāryamavekṣya niścitamidaṃ pūrvaṃ mayāsīditi̱ sphāraṃ sphāramudīrayedupacaretkañcinsṛpā sākṣiṇam || 18 || api ca cintāñcumyitacetasā na racitaḥ praśnaḥ praśastastyapā nṛnaṃ samyagupakṣrutirna bhavatā jñātā grahonuṃ tadā | tvaddīpeṇa phale bhramo'yamabhavadvidyā hi naḥ kevalī kalpānte'pi na kampate janamiti pratyāyayeddhañcitam || 19 || śiṣyaḥ -- uajjhāa! phuḍaṃ kiṃpi bhodi | jñāna -- (nepathyābhimussamaklokya sāśaṅkam) mūrkha! tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ekapurupānucarā mahilā kācidito'bhivarttate | (tataḥ praviśati kapaṭakelirmudrarakaśca) mudgarakaḥ -- attā! sṛṭṭhu khu pāṇagoṭṭhījoggaṃ ṭhoṇaṃ | kapaṭa -- (sakrodham) ehi dāva tunhikko| bhavatu pragalbhāmahe tāyat | (prakrāśam) kauṇḍinya! vrahmevāhaṃ maraṇamathavā jīvitaṃ vedmi jantoḥ syāmīvāhaṃ parahṭataghanaṃ kṣmātalāduddharāmi | lokasyāhaṃ sakalacaritānghantarātmeva jāne caurairluptaṃ syayamiva ghṛtaṃ vastcahaṃ prāpayāmi || 20 || kapaṭa -- (thutvā saharpem) muggaraa! āaṇṇaa āaṇṇaa bhaavado vaaṇāmayaṃ | ehi turidam | (ityupasarpataḥ) kapaṭa -- bhaavaṃ! paṇamāmi | mudgarakaḥ -- ahaṃpi paṇamāmi | jñāna -- ubhayorbhadramastu | āsyatām | (ubhācupaviśataḥ) kapaṭa -- (sapraśrayam) bhaavaṃ! ajja me raaṇīe musidaṃ savvassaṃ appāvedu bhavaṃ | śipyaḥ -- (sasambhramam) āḥ! kiṃ mantīadi | ajja rayaṇīpa madaṃ mottūṇa ṇa karhipi gado uajjhāo | kapaṭa -- (karṇau pidhāya sasambhramam) santaṃ pāvaṃ | ṇāṇasattīe coraṃ muṇiūṇa appāvedutti mae maṃtidaṃ | jñāna -- (sasmitam) kauṇḍinya! tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | (kapaṭakeliṃ prati) bhadre! anuciteyamasmākamecaṃvighā vidyā | kapaṭa -- (sapraśrayam.) `bhaavaṃ karuṇārasasāare tumhe mottūṇa ko anno amhārisassa atthīaṇassa saraṇaṃ | patto a so atthasaṃcao tumhāṇaṃ yayeva sāhīṇo bhavissadi | jñānagāśiḥ -- (svagataṃ̱ saddayaim) svīkṛtastāvadasmākamanayā manorathaḥ | tathāpi nirīhatāmevābhinayāmi na jānāmi na gṛhṇāmi mama kiṃ cintayā'nayā | anaṅgīkāra evā'yaṃ dābhbhikānāṃ mahāphalaḥ || 21 || (prakāśam) kalyāṇi! tvadabhīṣṭanaiva kṛnakṛtyā vapam | kauṇiḍanya | arpaya kevalīpustakaṃ, karomi lābhālābhaviniścayam | śiṣyaḥ -- (pustakamupanīya) kīradu dāva kevalīputthaapūā | muṭūrakaḥ -- (sahasotthāya) āṇemi kusumāiṃ | śiṣyaḥ -- bhadda! suvaṇṇehiṃ rañaṇehiṃ vā kevalīputthaapūā bhodi | (kapaṭakeliḥ jñānarāśermukhamīkṣate) jñāna -- (svagataṃ saparitopam) arhati kevalīrahasyaśiṣyatyaṃ kauṇḍinyaḥ | (prakāśam) bhadre! evamevaitat | kṣraddhālurātmanaḥ kuryāllābhāllābhāllābhanirupaṇam | abhyarcya svarṇaratnābhāṃ kevalīṃ manuravravīt || 22 || abhāve kusumāni bhavantu | kapaṭa -- ayya! mukkhrapakkho yyeva kīradu | (ityaṅgulīyakena pustakaṃ pūjñayati) jñānaḥ -- kauṇḍinya! gṛhāṇa| dāsyasi vibhajya bhikṣubhyaḥ | śiṣyaḥ -- (svagatam) haāsa! jāṇemitumaṃ | aharehiṃ bhaṇasi, ṇa hiaeṇa | (praphāśam) jaṃ uajjhāo āṇavedi | (ityaṅgulīyakaṃ gṛhvāti) jñāna -- (pustakamuddhāṭya)aye!grahakuṇḍalīṃtāvadālikhāmi | (likhanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā) yadi paśyati ravisṛnurviśasthānasthitaṃ vyatīpātam | yadi rāhuḥ śakaṭabhedī sa bhavati ketuśca mepasthaḥ || 23 || raviraṅgārakalagne bhavati yadā pāpakṣyamāṇaśca | arthaśarīrābhāvaṃ praśne brūyāttadā niyatam || 24 || na cāyamiha yogaḥ | tadasti tāvallābho naṣṭasya vastumaḥ | kapaṭa -- (saharpam) ayyassa pasāeṇa | śiṣyaḥ -- (sacamatkāram) aho | uajjhāaṃssa vijjñāmāhappaṃ | saalāo vi sālihottagāhāo kaiṭhe kidāo | jñāna -- kauṇḍinya! itaśceto gatvā tvamupaśśrutimānaya | śiṣyaḥ -- (niṣkamya punaḥ praviśya) khaaṃ jāhi re ceḍā khayaṃ jāhi | muhūrakaḥ -- (sasaṃrambhamutthāya) āḥ! kīsa re khamaṇaā! maṃ akkosasi? | ciṭṭa ciṭṭa tuhayyeva muṃḍeṇa kevalīputthaapūaṃ karemi | śiṣyaḥ -- (sabhayam) avvahmaṇrṇa avvahmaṇrṇa | uvassudī khu mapa esā āṇīdā | ṇa hu ṇa hu tumaṃ akkosemi | kapaṭa -- muggarañā!
