ṇa saṃvarasi attaṇo micḍaduāraṃ muhaṃ | jñāna -- saumya! tiṣṭha tiṣṭha nāpamākrośaḥ | upaśṭhutiriyam | tattvamevedānīmupaśśrurti gṛhītvā samāgaccha | mudgarakaḥ -- vaṃcesi re vaṃcesiṃ | jñāna -- (sāśaṅkamiva) āḥ kiṃ pralapasi? | mudrarakaḥ -- ayya! ethaṃ mae āaṇṇidaṃ | jñāna -- (lisvanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā) kauṇḍinya! yakavargīyo'yaṃ ghakāraḥ | śiṣyaḥ -- ahaṃ uṇa savaggīyaṃ jāṇemi | jñāna -- tadasya kati mātrāḥ? | śiṣyaḥ -- pañca | jñāna -- anukhārasya kati bhavantu | śiṣya -- jettīo lihiduṃ pāresi | jñāna -- trayodaśa tāvat | atha trayodaśabhiḥ pañcabhiśca dvārviśatiḥ | śiṣyaḥ -- ṇahi ṇahi rvisadī bhodi | kṛpaṭa -- ṇaṃ aṭṭārah honti | vihāvedu ayyo | jñānaḥ -- (svagataṃ vimāvya) aye gaṇitadurvidaggheyaṃ, tadyathā tathā tāvatsamāpayuāmi | (prakāśam) bhadre! anya evāpamasmadīyo gaṇanāsampradāyaḥ,tadāvedaya tāvadgṛhajananāmāni | (mudgarakaḥ kapaṭakelimadanasundarīmudbharakakreokichaparrāvatkusumikā ityādi nāmāni lepayati) jñāna -- (likhitvā svagatam) kapaṭakeliḥ suṣṭu cauryeṇa śaṅkanīyeti prathamameyaredāhṛtā | tadenāmevra krathayami | (gaṇitābhinayaṃ kṛtvā prakrāśam) kapaṭakelistāvatkṛtaccauryā pratibhāsate | mudgarakaḥ -- (uvaiviṃhasya saharpam) sāhu ayyeṇa jāṇidaṃ | saiṃ yyeva esāṃ musadi amha gharaṃ | (kapaṭakeliḥ sasmitaṃ kākṣeṇa vārayati) jñāna -- (vibhāvya svagataṃ savaichakṣyam) anenānyonyahāsānubhāvena iyameva kapaṭakeliriti nikṣcīyate | tanna bhadramāpatitam | (vimṛśva ramṛtimabhinīya) eptasyāḥ kila sutā gaṇikā madanasṛndarī kalākaraṇḍakaikāgrahṛdayā | tāvimau tadbhṭatyau cauryaghūtakāriṇau kokilapārāpatau | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśaṃ kapaṭakelipāhūyāpavārga) bhadre! niścitaścaurastvannāmagheyaṃ ca saṃvaraṇārthamudāhṛtam | prayātu bhavanaṃ bhavato | sunibhṛtameva yācanīyau kokilapārāvatau | kapaṭa -- (prakāśaṃ saddarpam) aṇumaṇṇadu maṃ ayyo | jñāna -- bhadre! sādhayatu bhavatī | yataśca vastu lavdhavyaṃ, na tasmai ropāyitavyaṃ | (kapaṭakelirmudrarakeṇa saha nipkrāntā) śiṣyaḥ -- (aṅgulīyakamupanīya) alaṃkaredu ajlo ediṇā attāṇayaṃ | jñāna -- (sodvegamiva) kauṇḍinya! kasnavāyaṃ mohaḥ | paśyaṃ re paśya jarāsṛtyuvyādhivyasanaghaṭanaikāgrahṛdayo viparyāsaṃ yasyāḥ praguṇayati kālaḥ pratikalam | tanau tasyāmasyāmalamalamalaṅkāraghaṭanaṃ jghaladdhahvau gehe racayati catupkāni kanamaḥ || 25|| śipyaḥ -- (vihasya) uajjhāa! tuhayyeva ahaṃ sisso | kiṃ maṃ paccāesi | genha dāva | (jñarāśiraṅgulīyakaṃ paridadhāti) śiṣyaḥ -- (sākūtaṃ vihasya añjaliṃ vaṃdvīṃ) bhaavaṃ agulīya! ṇamo de | yiro hohi ihayyeva uajjhāahatthammi | jñānaḥ -- (satrkodhamiva) āḥ pāpa! asatpralāpavācāla! vismṛtānyeva me vyasanāni (smṛtimabhinīya sacamatkāram) kauṇiḍanya! smārito'smi tvaddhacyanena kalākaraṇḍakaghūtakāraprārthanām | sahi ghūte vidhvastasarvasvo madīyamantraprabhāvādvijapamākāṅkati |asti tasyāsmāsu yahuṭṭadhā pratyayaḥ | tadehi mantrajapayogyaṃ vijanaṃ pradeśamāśrayāvaḥ | durvāragaṇikādvipracyāramidamudyānam | śipyaḥ -- tā ido ido edu uajjhāo | (iti niṣpāntau) pradhamo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśati mantrajapaparāyaṇo jñanarāśiḥ śipyaśca) śipyaḥ -- uajjhāa! vahulo tapṭ kado maṃnajāo | jāṇe jidaṃpyeva kalāpharaṃḍaabhaṃjūdaareṇa ṇa ṣṭu de vilaṃvidapahāo manto | tā ehi ujjhāṇaṃ ghyeva gacchamha | ḍajjhanti me majjhanhacaḍaṇa ddeṇa caḍasuteeṇa aṃgāiṃ | jñāna -- (japaṃ vihāya) eyamevaitat | maihiro'yaṃ mahaḥpūraḥ krūraḥ khalu ivotkaṭaḥ | pratikarttuṃ paraṃ śakyaḥ susnigdhaiḥ śāstrisajjñanaiḥ || 1 || tadehi gacchāvaḥ | (iti niṣkrāmataḥ) ; śiṣyaḥ -- edaṃ ujjaṇaṃ | pavisadu bhavaṃ | (pravennaṃ nāṭayatḥ) śiṣyaḥ -- (katicitpadāni datvā'prapto'valokya) uñajjhāa! peccha peccha | idha mādhavomaṃḍave avbhudā kāvi itthiā uajjhāñuvva jhāṇaparāaṇā ciṭṭadi | avarāvi edāe pāsammi devañāpūatthaṃ candaṇakusumāiṃ uvvahantī ciṭṭadi | jñāna -- kauṇḍinya! tadihaiva rakttaśokanale upaviśāvaḥ | kiṃ mādhavīmaṇḍapena | (ityupaviśata śiṣyaḥ -- (vibhāvya svagataṃ sāścaryopahāsam)aho! uajjhāo aho! uajjhāo | suṭṭu khu esā ihaṭṭideṇa puloīadi ) (tataḥ praveiśāti yathānirddiṣṭar madnasundarī ceṭī ca) jñāna -- (vilokya svagatam) aho! rūpasampadasyāḥ | tathāhi lāvaṇyavīcayaistaralāyatākṣī prakṣālya niṣṭhuravivekadurakṣarāṇi | kandarpadaivatamiyaṃ sahasopadeśamāviṣkaroti hṛdi saṃyamino mabhāpi || 2 || ceṭī -- bhaṭṭiṇi! e daṃ khu tuha aṃgapasaṃgamalahantaṃ piva paccāai sippiāsamappidaṃ hariaṃdaṇaṃ | esā uṇa cirasamāgaaci tae asaṃbhāvijjamāṇā uālaṃbhadivva tumaṃ | parimalamilantarolaṃvaṇiuruṃvamuhalidā ṇomāliā | edaṃ pi karakamalakalidaṃ yaaṇapariuṃvaṇāvilaṃ va ṇīsahaṃ piva kilammadi taṃvolaṃ | tā ko esa pasaṃtāvaārapaharisāvasarammi de hiaakkheo | madanasundarī -- (anākarṇitaphaina dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasya saṃskṛvamāśritya) bhuñjanāḥ sahakārakorakavipaṃ prāṇanti puṣpandhayāḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kokilayopitāṃ nabhakuhaśabdāgninā dahyate| śrīkhaṇḍānilakālakūṭapavanairmūrcchanti naitā latā dhiḍabhṛtyorasamarthatāṃ smaraśarairviddhāpi jīvāmyaham || 3 || jñāna -- kauṇḍinya! kimasmākamiha nissadgānām? | tadehi gacchāvaḥ | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- uajjhāa! ciṭṭa ciṭṭha | tuha durajjhaaṇadūmidā sīalāanti kaṇṇā edāṇaṃ mahurālāvehi | jñāna -- (svagatam) mamāpi | (prakāśam) kauṇḍinya! citrakaraveśyālāpalālaso yadhyayanādudvijase | (ceṭī maṭṭinītyādi punaḥ paṭhati | madanasundarī tathaiva cintāṃ nāṭayati) ceṭī -- (haste gṛhītvā) bhaṭṭiṇi maaṇasuṃdari! kiṃ uṇa tumaṃ amaṃgalaṃ vāharasi ṇa paḍicchasi ṇevacchalacchiṃ? | kiṃ eārisayyeva kalākaraṃaṃ pecchihisi| madana -- (camatkṛtya saharṣam) sahi! kahiṃ so jūdaaro| ceṭī -- bhaṭṭiṇi! so khu ṇijjidasamalajūdaaraviṇo mayaṇujjāṇe tae saha pāṇagoṭṭhīmahūsavaṃ māṇaissadi | sovi tae pesido ādaraṇakaraṃḍao vārisopyeva attāe kabaḍakelīe pāsaṃ pesidotti maha maaṇujāṇavāleṇa sāhidaṃ | tā navamalikā | etadapi karakamalakalitaṃ vadanaparicummanāvilamiva miḥsahamiva kṭhāmyati tāmbūlam| tatka era vasantāvatārapraharyāvasare te hṛdayakṣomaḥ? madana -- (sotkaṇṭhamutthāya) piasahi! ehi ehi āliṃgasu maṃ | (iti ceṭī samāliṅgati) śiṣyaḥ -- umajjhāa! ḍajjhaḍa esa anhāṇaṃ tao| peccha peccha edāe dhaṇṇattaṇaṃ jā maaṇasuṃdarīe samāliṃgijjadi | jñāna -- (svagataṃ sotkaṇṭham) samyagāha kauṇḍinyaḥ| (prakāśaṃ sakrodhamiva) rere kiṃ pralapasi | āḥ pāpa! śāpodakena nirvāpayāmi tvaddurvinayapāvakam | (iti kamaṇḍalūdakamādātumicchati) śiṣyaḥ -- kiṃ aāraṇaṃ kamaṃḍalujalaṃ pavāhesi| kilammihasi majjhaṇhataṇhāe | jāṇemi tuha pahāvaṃ| jñāna -- mūrkha! kapaṭakelighanapralyāvṛttiṃ vuddhāpi na pratyepi| śiṣyaḥ -- kavaḍakelīe coridatti tae paḍhamaṃyyeva paccāidomhi | madana -- (sautsumyam) tā ehi tahiṃ yyeva gaṭua paḍivālemha jūdaaraṃ| (ityutyāya ceṭīṃ haste gṛhītvā parikrāmati) śiṣyaḥ -- muṃca dāvavāākalahaṃ | peccha peccha gacchadi esā | jñāna -- (vilokya svagataṃ sotkaṇṭhaṃ sānutāpam) kathamapakrāmatyeva!| unmucya dūramapayāti yathā yadheyaṃ chāyeva manmathatarostaralāpatākṣī| aṅgāni me prasabhamepa tathā tathaiva kroḍīpharotyahaha! durvipahaḥ pratāpaḥ || 4 ||
śiṣyaḥ -- uajjhāa! tumaṃ va duvvisahativvateऒ diṇaṇāho! tā ehi edaṃ yyeva māhavīmuṃḍavaṃ pavisamha | ihuyyeva jhāṇaghāraṇādiaṃ bhūvissadi | jñāna -- (svagataṃ saharṣotkaṇṭham) ciraṃ jīvatu me vatsaḥ | kauṇḍinyena hṛdgatamabhihitam | (prakāśam) yathā rocate vatsāya | (ubhau praveśaṃ nāṭayataḥ) | (syagataṃ sotphaṇṭhaṃ vibhāvya) aye iyaṃ sā vedikā madanasundarīparirambhasambhāvitā | tadetāmadhiśaye tāvat | (iti vigrāmaṃ nāṭayati) śiṣyaḥ -- iha jahicchaṃ kuṇadu uajjhāoo jhāṇadhāraṇādiaṃ | jñāna -- (sāntastāpaḥ svagatam) kutomimaitadidānīm | tathāhi sameghante kṣvāsāḥ kka nu pavanasaṃrodhanavighervacastannāmaiva spṛśati satataṃ kkasti sa japaḥ | tayā grastaṃ cittaṃ kkacidapi yayau kaiṭabharipurdadau dīkṣāmanyāṃ mama kusumacāpo'dya bhagavān || 5 || pragalbhate ca mamāyaṃ sarvāṅgīṇaḥ santāpastademāmeva śītalāṃ vedikāṃ viluṇṭhanaiḥ sambhāvayāmi (iti tayā karoti) śiṣyaḥ -- (sasambhramamiva) kiṃ uṇa uajjhāo evaṃ paloṭṭadi | jñāna -- (sasaṃvaraṇam) vatsa! kauṇḍinya! vādhante mamāṅgāni ghoreṇa jvareṇa | śiṣyaḥ -- (sparśamabhinīya) aho de dāruṇo jaro | ṇaṃ jāṇasiyyeva jaraviāraṇamantaṃ | tā kīsa kilimmasi? jñāna -- (svagataṃ vimṛśya) aye madanasundarīvirahajvarāturasya tadvaśīkaraṇamantraprayoga eva me śaraṇam | mukharaśipyarākṣasāghrātasya kka me dūtyaaderabhyupāyastadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) vatsa kauṇḍinya! | sampaganusmārito'smi | tadānapa likhanopakaraṇāni, pathā jyarajitvaraṃ mantravījaṃ viracayāmi | śiṣyaḥ -- (nipkamya punaḥ praviśya) edāḍaṃ uvaaraṇāiṃ | ālihadu uajjhāo | jñān -- (bhūrjatvacamādāya vaśīkaraṇumantramālikhya su̍vṛtya) catsa kauṇḍinya! candanapaṅkagolena vījavatkṛtvainamānaya yathā paridhāya vijvaro bhavāmi | śiṣyaḥ -- (likhitatamādāya parikramya) aye pecchāmi dāva kiṃ 'idha ālihidatti | (unmonya,vācayitvā sasmitam) aye mantāṇantaraṃ madanasuṃdarī me vaśībhavatviti lihidaṃ | tā ṇa idaṃ sahissaṃ | ahaṃpi māṇasuṃdarīsamāgamāsāe jīvidaṃ dhāremi| tā evaṃ dāva | (unmṛnya kapaṭakelirme vaśībhavatviti samālikhya tathaiva saṃvṛtya candanapaṅkena vījavatkṛtvā punaḥ praviśya) ghāredu edaṃ uajjhāo | (jñānarāśi vījamādāya nāṭayena paridadhāti) śiṣyaḥ -- (saharpākṣcaryamitra) kadhaṃ muhuttametteyyeva jaravimuko vya uajjhāo lakkhīadi | jñāna -- (svagatam) bahudhānubhūtasadyaskaphalo'yaṃ mantraḥ || pratyāsannaścāyaṃ vipavipamaśīlaḥ śipyaḥ | taderva tāvat | (prakāśam) catsa kauṇḍinya! kṛto mantraprayogaḥ (tadidānīṃ jvaravijayinīṃ bhagayato'bhyarcanāṃ cikīpami | tadānīoyantāṃ vividhavarṇasaurabhyayaibhavāni kusumāni śiṣyaḥ -- ñjtaṃ uajjhāoo āṇavedi | (iti niṣkmya svagatam) jāṇido pryeca maye uajjhāoo tā kiṃ me kusumerhi (edaṃ yyeva caladalatarusiharaṃ āruhia ṇiārūpami savvaṃ | (iti tathā karoti) jñāna -- (puro'valokya sahapaim) ahaha! phalitaṃ mantraprabhāyena yadiyaṃ gṛhotakusumatāmbūlādiprābhṛtakā kapaṭakelirmadanasundarīdūtye'tra samāgacchati | (tataḥ praviśati yathānirdiṣṭā kapaṭakeliḥ | kapaṭakeliḥ jñānarāśeragrataḥ prāmṛtakamupanīya sāphūtaṃ vihasya satrīḍamupaviśati) jñāna -- (sagarvaharpam) ayi bhadre! adhigataṃ tadrastu? | kapaṭa -- (sotkaṇṭham) suhaa! taṃ laddha gadaṃ catyu | hiaaṃ uṇa maha tae haridaṃ tā tumaṃ yyeva maha saraṇaṃ| jñāna -- (svagatam) āḥ kimetat! | kimiyaṃ madirārasonnidritasmaravikārātiśayā?| tatkimatrottaraṃ bhavati? abhimatena tāvadriniyojayāmi | (prakāśam) bhadre! api kalyāṇinī tava sutā madanasundarī | kapaṭa -- (serpyam) ṇa hu ṇa hu sudā me, vahiṇiā khu sā| ahaṃ uṇa tumhārisavilāsijaṇapasāeṇa suhidā pihulattaṇaṃ pattā kaṇiṭṭhā vi aṇṇārisī muṇijjāmi | jñāna -- (svagataṃ sopahāsam) aho! dhāṣṭaryaṃ vṛddhāyāḥ | athavā yujyata evaitat vātotphullanayā nayanti samatāṃ nimnau kapolau muhustuṅgatvābhinayaṃ vahanti kucayorvakṣaḥsthalollāsanaiḥ | putrībhyo'pi kaniṣṭhatāṃ prakaṭayantyācchādya keśān sitāṃstāruṇyābhinayagrahaḥ pariṇatau kopyepa duryoṃpitām || 6 || kapaṭa -- (sotkaṇṭham) suhaa! muścasu kasāaṃvraraṃ | alaṃkaremi hariaṃdaṇeṇa aṅgāiṃ| jñāna -- (svagatam) aho! vikārātiśayo vṛddhāyāḥ | athavā sotkaṇṭhaṃ sevito'tyartha tāruṇyasamaye purā | jahāti jaratīḥ kāmo na dākṣiṇyavaśādiva ||7|| (prakāśam) virama virama| vividharasavilāsollāsiniḥsīmapaṅkaḥpracayaniyatapātaṃ dūratastaṃ namāmi | ahamiha sukhamamba! tyakttavibhraṃśaśaṅkaḥ pathi niyabhaparāṇāṃ nīrase sañcarāmi || 8 || kapaṭa -- (sopahāsay) suhaa! ṇāarosi jāṇasi parihasiduṃ, jaṃ maṃ amvetti vāharasi | ṇa uṇa jāṇasi bhāavadāṇaṃ rahassaṃ | ṇa sudo tae sa ssiloo bhagavān kurute nityaṃ yaḥ kandarpanipevaṇam | sutarāṃ prīyate tasya kandarpajanako hariḥ || 9 || ṇa uṇa ahaṃ jāpo kettīāo bhāavadāṇaṃ visīo ṇiasuraasattharosīsaammi maye diṇṇāo | jñāna -- (sakrodham) āḥ pāpe! patipyasi bhāgavatadarśanadūpaṇapaṅkena | kapaṭa -- (vihasya) suhaa! ṇa ṇivaḍissaṃ | eso me ālamyaṇamatthi tuha daṃḍo| (iti daṇḍaṃ spṛśati) jñāna -- āḥpātakini | mā sṣṭaśa mā spṛśa | lvayi yamadaṇḍo'yaṃ daṇḍaḥ| (iti duṇḍamācchidya hantumupakramate) kapaṭa -- (satvaramapasṛtya) rere paṇaṭṭhabhaava! ṇa me ettha kokilapārāvadā teṇa maṃ aṇāhaṃ ca tāḍesi | (tata. praviśataḥ saṃravdhau kokilapārāyatau) pāravataḥ -- kokilāā! karhipi idha ujjāṇe so ṇaṭṭabhaavao puloīadi, jo amha coriākalahamuppādedi | jñāna -- (puro'valokya sabhayam) amva! tvamevātra śaraṇaṃ me | kapaṭa -- (sakrodham) ajjavi maṃ aṃvitti vāharasi? | jñāna -- (sapraśrayam) sundari! kariṣyasi me prāṇarakṣāṃ, tvadāyatto'ham | kapaṭa -- tā samāhidaṃbheṇa ciṭṭadu bhaavaṃ | (jñānarāśiḥ tathā ka roti) kokilaḥ -- (puro nirūpya saddarpam)pārāvañjā!peccha peccha eso so bhavao pāsaṭṭidāe attāe uāsijjamāṇo ciṭṭadi | tā ehi uasappamha | ubhau -- (upasṛtya sasaṃrambhamuñcaiḥkāram) atte! kiṃ idha tumaṃ? | kapaṭa -- (sanimṛtasvaraṃ hastasaṃjñayā vārayantī) kokilaā! ṇihuaṃ ciṭṭhagha | mā bhodu samāhibhaṃgo bhaavado | kokilaḥ -- atte! eso khu me tivvamaharāveavihalovva paḍihāadi jaṃ ṇimīliaccho ghummadi | (pārāvataṃ kākṣeṇe vīkṣya) tumaṃ vā kaghaṃ mannesi | pārāvataḥ -- kokilaā! evaṃ ṇṇedaṃ | tā ehi eso dīhiājalammi majjīadi (iti tathopakramete) kapaṭa -- (sasambhramam) āḥ kiṃ edaṃ! ciṭṭhagha ciṭṭhadha re ciṭṭhagha | mā jalaṇāmmi jhapadha | kokilaḥ -- atte! jaha eso jalaṇo tā kinna edaṃ ṇiñcaṃ cia ucchaṃgaantī ḍajjhasi tumaṃ | (iti prasrabhaṃ dhārayataḥ) | (jñānarāśiḥ sahuṅkāraṃ śiro valayati) pārāvataḥ -- koṃkilaā! picchilavālo ṇa esa ghariḍhuṃ pārīadi | kokeilaḥ -- pārāvaā! tumaṃ hatthesu ahaṃ pāesu ghāremi | (iti tapā kurutaḥ) pārāvataḥ -- (vāhuto vījaṃ chitvā iste gṛddannaṅgalīyakaṃ pratyabhijñāya) kokilaā | paccabhijāṇesu aṃgulīaaṃ edaṃ attāe maaṇasatyasivikhaṇāe eassa viiṇṇaṃ | kokilaḥ -- (sopahāsam) sāhu atte! sāhu | savvassaṃ eassa samappedi coriākalaṃkaṃ uṇa amha matye arovedi | (ubhau cālayataḥ) jñāna -- (sākrandam) kauṇḍinya! kauṇḍinya! kkāsi? kkāsi? | epa tvāmapahāya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamabhipadye | kokilaḥ -- pāālamūlatti bhaṇa | pārāvataḥ -- kokilaā! eso bhāvao edassiṃ yyeva payāsanne vinchudaivade caladalatarummi avalaṃvīadi | aṇubhavadu muhuttaṃ khearasiddhi | (kokila; ūrpve śākhāmavalokate) kauṇḍinyaḥ -- (svagataṃ sabhayam) eso so palijvamāṇo ḍaranto avaraṃpi pañcāledi! tā evaṃ dāva (prakāśam) jīovadha jīvadha | ghāredha dhāredha edaṃ rdebhatāpasaṃ yāca ahaṃ aghadarāmi | paso khu me sālujlaṇe kusṛmāiṃ ṇiccaṃcia genhai | ahaṃ ihaṭṭido ṇiāslvemiṇā uṇa pekkhāmi (ityavataraṇaṃ nāṭathitvā intumupakramate) jñāna -- aho gurau bhattapatiśayaḥ | bhavratu | jīyatu tāvaddharākaḥ | (kapaṭakeliḥ vihasya jñānarāśemurravamīkṣate) pārāvataḥ -- arere tumaṃ ujjhāṇavālo? | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- agha iṃ'? | kokilaḥ -- pārāvaā! jaṃ attā ṇihuaṃhasiūṇabhaayado muhaṃ peksvadi, tāṃ esoyyeva so edassa dudīo koṃḍiṇṇo | (iti sahasopasṛtya tamapi dhārayati) pārāvataḥ -- eso vi edassa bhaavao | igha tā samaaṃ cia donhavi bhodu siddhī | (iti yogapaṭṭābhyāṃ dvayorapi kaṇṭho saṃdānayattaḥ) kauṇḍinyaḥ -- (sākandaṃ dīrghe niḥśvarsya) ṇiaṇiaṭṭāṇesṛ ciṭṭantu ṇihāṇāiṃ | kilimmadu dāliddadūmio loo | ucaramadi nāṇārāsī | kokilaḥ -- (saspṛdam) rere jāṇādi tuha ucaramadi ṇihāṇāiṃ? | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- ko na ettha ediṇā kaatdhīkado? | kokilaḥ -- (saddasaupamṛtya) bhaavaṃ nāṇarāse! anugenhasu amhe | jñāna -- (svagatam) sāghu kauṇḍinya! sādhu! tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) vatsa! ārtto'yaṃ pralapati kriyanāmasmāsu samīhitam | (kokilapārāvatau yogapaṭṭau vihāya padayoḥ praṇipatya) ubhau -- pasīddu pasīdadu ayyo | pharesṛ amdde adalidde | jñāna -- vatsau! kṣāntaṃ mayā | kṣamāghanā hi mādṛśāḥ | paropakāra e yāsmākaṃ paramakāruṇikānāṃ paramo gharmaḥ | avaśyamanugrahītavyau vatsī | tadutiṣṭatām! ubhau -- (utyāya)jīvadu jīvadu ajjo | jñāna -- (sagarvam) madkṣūbhaṅgisamādiṣṭā kumbhadāsīca bhūriyam | nighānakṛmbhasambhāraṃ gehe kasya na daukayet || 10 || kauṇḍinya |'samānaya lāṅgalīrasam | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- kiṃ teṇa?! jñāna -- kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā? rasena lāṅgalīoyena samantreṇāñjitekṣaṇaḥ | nighanaṃ vā nidhānaṃ yā dhīraḥ samadhigacchati || 11 || kokilaḥ -- bhaavaṃ! ṇihāṇado kiṃ ṇihaṇaṃ garuaṃ? | jñāna -- mātrāhīnamapi sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ nighānānnidharna śreyaḥ | kokilaḥ -- tā amhāṇaṃ taṃyyeva bhodu | jñāna -- adha kiṃ? | tvaraya kauṇḍinya! tvaraya | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- jñaṃāṇavedi bhavaṃ | (iti nipkamya punaḥ praviśya) edaṃ taṃ genddadu uajjhāo | jñāna -- (ādāya) kaspākṣṇoḥ prathamaṃ dīpatāmañjanam? | kokliḥ -- maha dāva | pārāvataḥ -- (upasṛtya) maha dāva | kapaṭa -- bhaavaṃ! esovi tae aṇuaṃpaṇijjo itthoaṇo | jñāna -- āḥ! kiṃmautsukyena? | sarvepāmevāsannaṃ nidhanam | pārā -- tatkokilasya tāvatkuru | jñāna -- (tathā kṛtvā) vatsa! etasminvṛkṣamṛle dṛśāṃ nighehi | (kokilaḥ tathā karoti) pārā -- kokilaā! pecchasi kiṃpi? | kokilaḥ -- ṇa kimpi | jñāna -- (apavārya) vatsa pārāvata! satyeyaṃ janokttiḥ "arthāturāṇāṃ na suhṭanna vandhuḥ " yadayaṃ paśyannāyi na kathayati | sarvatra pade pade nighānānīti kimunmattajalpitam? | tattavānyadeva darśayāmi | (iti pārāvatākṣiṇī tathā pharoti) kapaṭa -- bhaavaṃ! mamāvi | (itānarāśistayā pharoni) kokilaḥ -- (apapārya) pārāvaā! pecchasi phimpi? | pārā -- ṇa kimpi | kokilaḥ -- atte! tumaṃ pecchasi kiṃpi | kapaṭa -- ṇahi ṇahi puṣṭṭanti ṇapari loaṇā | kokilaḥ -- (apavārya)pārāvaā! attā ṇa pecchadi | tumaṃ ṇa pecchasi| ahaṃ ṇa pecchāmi | tā kiṃ etthaphāavvaṃ | (apadāyai manghayityā) tā eyaṃ dāya (prakāśaṃ) | uajjhāa! thoaṃ khu aṃjaṇaṃ | tā avaraṃṇa raseṇā tumaṃ maha kaṇiṭṭo uṇa pārāvaassa aṃjadu loaṇe jahā samaaṃcia ṇihāṇe pecchamha | (ubhau tathā kuruḥ| kaukilapārāvatau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍayobhayorapyakṣiṇī nijñākṣibhyāṃ sāndraṃ vimarddayataḥ) jñānarāśikauṇḍinyau -- (pīḍāmabhinīya) kṛpṇa kṛpṇa!sphuṭato vilocane | kokilapārāvatau -- haāsā! genhadha genhagha ṇihaṇaṃ | jñāna -- āḥ kauṇḍinya! upavipaṃkimapyetadānītaṃ tvayā!| anya eva sa netrāñjanaḥ | kauṇḍinyaḥ -- uajjhāa! kiṃ maṃ māredumicchasi | erva yyeva phuṭṭaloaṇo mudohaṃ | pārā -- (pīḍātiśayamabhinīya) harddhī haddhī aṭṭāṇe mudomhi | kokilaḥ -- pārāvaā! kiṃ soesi! tahā a apīapudhvaṃ kimu kiṃpi majtaṃ viṭṭālidā kiṃ mahilā ṇa kāvi | jūaṇe suṇṇo diaho gado kiṃ ko amha soāvasaro jaammi || 12 || jñāna -- (sragataṃ sopadāsam) satyamenat | kṛnakṛtyāḥ pratīkṣante mṛtyuṃ priyamivātithim | (prakāśam) vatsau kokilapārāyatau! asti kkāpīoha pratyāsanno jalāśapaḥ | nayanaprakṣālanamātreṇeva praśāmyatyepo'pamṛtyuḥ | kokilaḥ -- atthi ettha paccāsannaṃ maaṇujjāṇaṃ, jarhi sāmī kalākaraṃḍao pāṇagoṭṭhīvilāsaṃ karedi | pārā -- tā kaghaṃ maggaṃ puloamha| kokilaḥ -- egha dāva riṃgantā vi gacchamrha | (sarve śanaiḥ parikrāmanti | kauṇḍinyaḥ kokilopari patanaṃ nāṭayati) kokilaḥ -- (sakrodhraṃ caraṇena prerya) haāsa! kiṃ igha ṇihāṇaṃ? koilo khu ahaṃ | tā parado gāccha | kapaṭa -- (patanaṃ nāṭayantī) vaccha kokilaā!avalaṃvasu avalaṃbasu maṃ | kokilaḥ -- atte! ṇivaḍidayyeva ciṭṭa | ko tumaṃ uddhariduṃ pāredi | htthipaṭuṇaṃ tuha saṃvuttaṃ | (kapaṭakeliḥ kathabhvidutyāya punaḥ punaḥ patanaṃ nāṭayati) pārā -- (sopaddāsam) pāvedu dāva ajjaā pae pae ṇihāṇāiṃ | kokilaḥ -- (pīḍātiśayaṃ nāṭayan) haddhī haddhī eso ṇayari aṇusao jaṃ ṇa pāvido maraṇasamaammi pāaphaṃso pahuṇo kalākaraṃṭaassa | kapaṭa -- (mānandaṃ sorastādṛmākrāśe lakṣyaṃ yadavā) putti maaṇasuṃdari!kārhisi kahiṃsi?| dehi me paḍivāṇaṃ l esākhu aṇāhā addaṭṭatuhamuhaaṃdā viyanvāmi | (tataḥ praviśati saparivārā sambhrāntā maddanamundarī kalākaraṇḍakadrā) madanasundarī -- atte! kiṃ nedaṃ? | (kapaṭaphailiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ gṛhītvā roditi) kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- (vilokya sasambhramamupasṛtya) bhagavan jñānarāśe! kimetat? | jñāna -- (svareṇa jñātvā) vatsa kalākaraṇḍaka! dudaivehato'haṃ, kiṃ kathayāmi| kokilapārāvatau -- (sakrogham) ṇāha kalākaraṃkhaa! | edaṃ māāvaṃcidasaalabhuaṇaṃ saṃbhāvesu ṇaṭṭha | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ (sakogham) āḥ pāpau! alamalaṃ cāpalena | (jñānarāśiṃ prati) bhagavan! kathaya kimetat | sajjo'yaṃ tvatpreṣyo janaḥ | jñāna -- vatsa | tāvadambhaḥ samānīya prakṣālyantāṃ sarvepāmakṣīṇi | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- kusumike! mudgaraka! nanu pratyāsannaiva dīrghikā, tadānīyatāṃ pānīyam | ubhau -- jaṃ sāmī samādisadi|(iti nipkamya punaḥ praviśya) uvaṇīdaṃjalaṃ | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- prakṣālyantāṃ sarvepāmakṣīṇi | (iti tathā kurutaḥ) jñāna -- (mukhaṃ grakṣālya unmīlya cakṣupī) vatsa kalākaraṇḍaka! diṣṭyā dṛṣṭo'si diṣṭayā praśāntamāpadā | kapaṭa -- (saharpam) diṭṭiā diṭṭo mae tuha muhasasī | (iti madanamundarīṃ cumpati) | kokilapārāvatau -- (kalāṃkaraṇḍakaṃ paduyorgṛhītvā) diṣṭyā jīvatonau nātithirjāto'si | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- vatsau! praṇamyatāṃ tāvadayaṃ jagadgururbhagavān | (ubhā tathā kuruta.) jñāna -- saha kalākaraṇḍakena pramodantāṃ pramodantāṃ bhavantaḥ sarve'pi | vatsa kalākaraṇḍaka! na kaścidihāparādhyati | anayornidhānadarśanotsukayorarthe yannayanāñjanaṃ samānītaṃ taddhameṇānyadeva tīvraṃ kimapi saṃvṛttam | kalakaraṇḍakaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) kimucyate? | na gvalu pramādato'pi paṃribhavanti vipado jagadgurum | jñāna -- vatsa kalākaraṇḍaka | api nirjitā dhūtakphārāḥ| pūrṇāste manoradhāḥ | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- (saharpe sapraśrayam) bhagavan! kimucyate? | nāstyasādhyaṃ kimapi me bhuvane bhavadanukampāsanāthasya | mudrarakaḥ -- (saddarpautmukyam) ṇāha kalākaraṇṭaa! esā ,de attā esa de guru esa de pariaṇo jaṃ ṇirāvadoṃ jāo ttā edha mahasavaṃ māṇemha | jñāna -- vatsa! kalāpharaṇṭaka! brūhi kiṃ te bhūyaḥ priyamupakaromi? | kalākaraṇḍakaḥ -- (saddapai sapraśrayam) ajayyāste ghūte saphalakinavāḥ kinna vijitāḥ priyā prāṇaprāpā kimu na ghaṭitā candrayadanā | vipavdāddhaiḥ pāraṃ kimu mama na yātaḥ parijanaḥ kṛtārdhaṃ kṛtvā māṃ kimasi bhagayan! ditsuraparam || 13 || tathāpīdamastu avanimavanipālāḥ pālayantu praphāmaṃ vidadhatu śubhavṛṣṭiṃ dattamodāḥ payodāḥ | bhavatu bhavatu lophaḥ śophayaideśiphātmā rajaniramaṇalegvāśegvarayānaghanyaḥ || 14 || kṛniripaṃ mahārājakṣrīpararmhidevasyāmātyamya mahākaveḥ kṣrīvammarājasya | hāsyacṛddhāmaṇinamakaṃ prahamanaṃ samāptam | gaṅgagharo ruciraśītakarābhirāmo bhālākṣivahinibhasambhṛtavaḍavāgniḥ | vibhradvipaṃ suvipamaṃ guṇaratnaramyo bhargaḥ samudra iva varddhayatu śriyaṃ vaḥ || 1 || api ca | tāḥ pāntu vaḥ śikharadanturamandarādrivyāloḍanvyatikarādvamayo'mvurāśeḥ | yadvegavilkavanayā galitāpavādaṃ śrīrnirtaraṃ madhuripoḥ parirambhamāpa || 2 || (nāndyante sūtraghāraḥ) sūtradhāraḥ -- (prācīmavalokya saddarpam) aye prāgalbhyamāsasādpratyūpasamayaḥ | tathāhi abhyutthitā parilasatkamalākarābdherlakṣmīḥ sahastrakaramaṇḍalamabhyupaiti | tanmadhyavarttinuravairimukhāravindasandarśanotsavasamutsukatāṃ gateva || 3 || brāhma eva muhattai cāhaṃ vivuddhaḥ | na ca mayā kiñcidātmahitaṃ vicintitam | kṣrūyate hi smārttebhyo "brāho muhartte utthāya cintayedātmano hitam " iti | tadidānīmapi cintayāmi | (nepadhyāmimurapramavalokya) ka ihāsmadīyaḥ? | (praviśya) sthāpakaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ahamasmi | samādiśatu māṃ bhāvaḥ | sūtra -- (sahapam) diṣṭyā samprāpto'si | tvameva naḥ paramo hitastadvimṛśyatāṃ, dvādaśāpi bhrānaraḥ kathamiva yayaṃ yugapatkṛnakṛtyā bhavāmaḥ | sthāpakaḥ -- (saharṣa śiro'vadhūya) aho bhāvasya saubhrātram | dupprāpakṣcaipa manoratho bhāghasya bhāgyasampadaiva samāsādyate | ādityā api dvādśā paryā grata eva dvāduśamṛāsepu paramaiśvaryabhājanaṃ bhavanti | tadvisṛśṭya vijñapayāmi (kṣaṇaṃ vicintya saharṣam) yupmābhiryaugapadyena sarvakāmārdhasiddhaye | paramarddinarendro yā samudro vā nipevyatām || 4 || sūtra -- (saharpam) sādhu dṛṣṭaṃ sādhu smāritam | kavivatsarājaviracitasamudramathanasamavakārābhinayena naḥ paramarddideva eva pūritāśepamanorathaḥ samudro bhavipyati | (nepathye) evannedaṃ | samuddādo ghyeya savve maṇorahā ṇivvahanti | sūtra -- (svarapratyabhijñānamabhinīya) aye! padmako'yaṃ devyāḥ samudraduhiturviśrambhabhṛmirvyāharati | tadehādyāvāmanantarakaraṇīyaṃ sampādayāvaḥ (iti niṣkāntau) (prastāvanā) (tataḥ praviśati padmaphaḥ) pajhakaḥ -- evaṃ nedaṃ | sa muddādoyyeya savve maṇorahā ṇivvahanti | kathidaṃ khu bhe gaṃgādethīe jahā kira sañve surā asurā a vithihalāhasamūsuā mahumahapamahaṇāhavambhehiṃ saha maṃtiūṇa maṃdaramaṃdhāṇeṇa jalahimahaṇaphāṇicchaā saṃyuktā | tā tattha phalissadi lacchīe mahumahammi pemmaphappalaā gae vi vinṭupadīe daṃsidā vinhuṇo ālihia lacchī | suṭṭhu ughāṃṭhido caiuṃṭho | tā mahaṇāṇatthevi atthi eso attho jaṃ lacchīe phalissadi maṇoraho | esā khu bhaavadī gaṃgādevī samuddavallahā pāvaṇāṇaṃ śiromaṇī saṃbhusīsammi vinṣnupaammi māhappeṇa thihiharūvā savyatta npiṭṭadi | (makhedam) kaha uṇa lacchīe tā jīvadhāraṇaṃ | ahaha ṇa kaaṃ siṃdhuṇāhamahādevīe gaṃgāe sohaṇaṃ jaṃ lacchīe aggado vaṇṇidā tahā tahā vinhuguṇā, caṅḍhāvido a tarssi pemmāṇuvaṃdho | ahavā alaṃ me kheeṇa | ko eassa kajjasiddhīe saṃsao, jarhi gaṃgādeghīe maṇaṃ pattiāadi | tā iha velāvaṇammi khaṇa vīsamiajāmni |(kṣaṇa piśramya smaraṇamabhinīya) aye gaṃgādevīsamappida vinhucittavaḍaṃpi dāva gaḍua daṃsemi lacchīe,jāva ṇa sā celāvalī samedi | sā khu maha pesaṇasamae pidaraṃ samuiṃ velāvaṇāgamaṇatthaṃ pucchantī āsi | ahaṃpi ṇiacīsāmasuhalālaso ṇiṭṭurovva rṇidido yyeva saṃcutto | (nepathye saropam) āḥ! ka epa mūrkhe vyāharati niṣṭhura iva nindita eveti | nirūpayare pāpa! nirūpaya asti tavaivaṃ vyāharato rasanā na veti | paikaḥ -- (sabhayam),āḥ! ko esa akāraṇaṃ kuprpadi? (iti tata ito'valaukate) (tata praviśati kuddho bhagavāniṣṭhuraka) (niṣṭuraka sakrodha punarnirūpayetyādi paṭhati) pajhakaḥ -- (svagatam) aye bhaavaṃ eso kuppadi | ṇūṇaṃ ṇiṭṭaretti edassa ṇāmasamāṇadāe eso kuppadi | (prakāśa sapraśrayam) bhaavaṃ! paṇamāmi tumaṃ | karhi me ṇiāracarāhā jīhā gammissadi | ahaṃ khu karuṇāvirahidaṃ ṇiṭṭhuretti attāṇaṃ ṇiṃdemi | niṣṭhurakaḥ -- (svagata savailakṣyam) aye ātmānaṃ naiṣṭuryādasāvupālabhate | (prakāśam) bhadra | kiṃ punarbhavānevamātmānamumālabhate | ahaha! na kṛta sindhunātha mahādevyā gaṅgayā śobhana yallakṣmyā agrata varṇitā tathā, tathā viṣṇu guṇā vardhārpitaśca tasmin premāmupandha | athavā ala me khedena | ka etasya kāryasiddhayā saśaya yanra gaṅgādevyā api mana pratyāyati | tadiha velāvane kṣaṇa viśramya yāmi | aye | gaṅgādevīsamarpita viṣṇucitra paṭamapi tadratvā darśayāmi lakṣmyai yāvanna sā velāvalī sameti | sā khalu mama prepaṇa samaye pitara samudra velāvanāgamanārtha pṛcchantī āsīt | ahamapi vijaviśrāmasukhalālaso niṣṭhura ina nindit eva savṛtta | nipṭhurakaḥ -- ka punastava bharttṛdārikā? | padmakaḥ -- bhaavaṃ! suṭṭu me tāveṇa uttammadi bhaṭṭidāriā | pajha -- ciṭṭadi samuddamajjhammi | niṣṭhu -- (sopahāsam) yā samudramadhye tapyate sā yadi maṇḍale vigatasanttāpā bhaveipyati | padma -- (saropam |) bhaavaṃ! ṇāmocidaṃ mantesi ṇa daṃsaṇocitaṃ| bhaavanto khu karuṇāparavvasā manterhi tanterhi dūattaṇerhi pi kāmuāṇaṃ pi kāmāiṃ saṃghaḍāyenti | niṣṭhu -- (santodham) āḥ pāpa! kimālapasi! | kadhamahaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaprasādamantramapahāya tvadbhartṛdārikāyāḥ smarasinddhimantramārādhayipye | paddā -- (sapraśrayam) ayya! mā kupya | jammantare khu tuha maṃtehi bhaavaṃ kamalaṇaaṇo pasanno bhodi | devīe uṇa samuddasuāe dūattarṇa viraantassa sahasaccia samīhiyaṃ daissadi | nipṭu -- (sopaddāsam) re re mūrkha! na tavaivaṃ vyāharato vrīḍā na ca me kṣṛṇvataḥ | kathaṃ nu jūlamānupīsamāgame sakalajagadīśo bhagayānyaikuṇṭha eya samutkaṇṭhate | tvaddhartṛdārikāyā api mahānayamupahāmo yattatra niviheyamāsaktiḥ | nahi vāpomarālikāyāḥ pitāmahamarālaḥ premapātraṃ bhavitumarhati | pajha -- (sagarpam) ayya! mā evaṃ hatthīṇa savvadasaṇaṃ mohaṇamaṃnaṃ ya jayai sohaggaṃ | vuhihai ṇaṃ samuhe lacchīpemmeṇa goviṃdo niṣṭhu -- (sopaddāsam) yayevaṃ tadā gataprāyaṃ nārāyaṇasya pāṇigrahaṇam | kimevamuttaṣyase? | aho adbhuttamadbhutaṃ cakṣuḥpathameva yo nāyatarati kastena saha pramavandhaḥ | re re mūrkha! asmadādīnāmapi gurava evamupadiśānti durddarśo nirguṇaḥ sṛkṣmaḥ kevalo'ṅguṣṭamātrakaḥ | vīnarāgo mahāmāyaḥ kṛpṇasrailokyamohanaḥ || 5 || padma -- (sakodham) ye evaṃ mannaṃti ṇa te tumhāṇaṃ gurū jāṇanti, ṇa a tumhārisā suṇenti | aṃdhāṇaṃ aghesu esa rūvaviśeso va eso | peccha re! peccha! bhaavado kanhassa slrva | (iti citrapaṭaṃ darśayati) niṣṭu -- (vilokya savitmayam) re re! kka punarayaṃ bhavatā samāsāditaḥ?| mayā kileha dhyānāya madhusūdanarūpamālikhitam | atrāhaṃ velāvanāśrame vasannaharahaḥ kṛpṇarūpamidaṃ dhyāyāmi | ekadā varddhiṣṇusinghoḥ kallalenāpahṛtaḥ | pajha -- bhaavaṃ! eso khu samuddadaiāe gaṃgāe samuddasuāe mahumahavirahavihalāe lacchīe kae mahumahālekkhasaṇāho cittavaḍo pesido atthi | nipṭu -- (santodham) arpaya madoyam | paddā -- (saropopahāsam) appido vi ṇa tuha hatthe ciṭṭadi! atthi kiṃpi tuha pācaṃ jñeṇa ālekkhevi ṇa tuhu daṃsaṇaṃ devo kanho | ado yyeva kallolapellaṇavavadeseṇa tuha hatthādo pavbhaṭṭho cittayaḍo | nipṭu -- (sakodham) āḥ pāpa! pāpaleśo'pi na me vidyate | idānīṃ bhavataḥ kaluyaśīlasya saṃlāpena bhavipyati | tadapasarpatu bhayānanpataḥ kuto'pi | pajh -- (sagarvam) re re bhagavaṃ! nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāe dukkaraṃ tavantīe lacchīe sannihaṇammi kṛdo me pāpaṃ, kṛdo a lacchīe maṇorahāṇaṃ asiddhī? | tahā a majjhammi ghasai ṇicaṃ surasarijalapūrapuṇṇajalaṇihiṇo | sevāe ahiramanto dūsahavaḍaghāhuāsassa || 6 || pujjai hiaaṃmmi hariṃ ghacchatthalaṇihidakamalamālāe | jhāṇovahāṇalaggā avahīriapariaṇālāvā || 7 || ia ghammakammakalaṇa haripaapaṃkaapasāakāmāe | kaha ṇa phalaha lacchīe āhāraviradāe || 8 || saṃpai uṇa ihayyeva jalahinīrammi velāvaṇakusumalakkheṇa bhaavadiṃ ruhāṇiṃ aṃcahatsadi bhaṭṭidāriā | niṣṭu -- ihāgamipyati tvadbhartṛdārikā? | pajha -- adha iṃ? | niṣṭhu -- tadidānīmanucitaṃ samavasthānamiha rāgijanapratyāsattau | pajha -- (sakrodham) tae paricattaṃ edaṃ pāvaṇaṃ bhavissadi vaṇaṃ | niṣṭhu -- (saropam) āḥ pāpa! kimālapati? | (iti vṛpīmudyamya tāḍayitutumicchati) pajha -- (sakrodham) ciṭṭha re jāva jalajaṃtuṃ kaṃpi duṭṭaaraṃ tuha kae kaantaṃ vāharemi | taśthaṃ' ca -- niṣṭhu -- (puro'yalokya sabhayam) ā pāpa! tvadanusmṛta eva jalakuñjaro'yaṃ duṣṭaḥ kaścidunmajvati | tadyāmi yatastlataḥ |(iti palāyate) padma -- (nirūpya) ṇūṇaṃ esā kuṃjaraṃ āruhia lacchī samedi | jissā uhayapāsammi dīsadi sahī lajja dhidī a | tā ihayyeva paḍivālemi | (tattaḥ praviśati yathanirdiṣṭā lakṣmīḥ) lakṣmīḥ -- sahīo! aiṣṭṭapuvvaṃ maha edaṃ surahi̱kusumapavbhāranivbharabharidaṃ | tā iddayyeva sahatthāvaciderhi kusumehiṃ aṃcaissaṃ bhaavardi ruddāṇiṃ| dhṛtiḥ -- jahā suhaṃ bhaṣṭṭidāriāe | lajā -- api kuṃjaresara! iha thiro bhodu bhavaṃ | (kuñjarastadhā tiṣṭhati) padmā -- (svagatam) iha kahiṃpi pacchanne pecchāmidāva|(iti tathā kraroti) (lakṣmī atrataraṇaṃ nāṭayati) dhūtiḥ -- piasahi! lajje! yeccha taṇuattaṇaṃ bhaṭṭidāriāe | lajā -- suṭṭu khu duvvalā, ṇa uṇa lakkhīadi lāaṇṇapuṇṇadāe | tahā a caṃgattaṇamedāe caṃdassaggasahoorassa sāricchaṃ | raṇaraṇaaduvyalāe ahiaṃ aha hoi acchariaṃ || 9 || lakṣmīḥ -- egha vaaṃsiāo edha | ucciṇīanti kusumāiṃ| (sarvā puṣpāvacayaṃ nāṭayanti) lakṣrmīḥ -- (saharpāścaryam) mālāhiṃ chammāsiamottiāṇaṃ keṇāvi vallīo vihṛsidāo | etārisaṃ kiṃ igha vihumāṇaṃ dīhattaṇaṃ dīsadi pāavesu || 10 || (dhṛtilajje itaretaramukhāvalophanasmitaṃ nāṭayataḥ) lakṣmīḥ -- (sāśaṅkam) sahoo! kiṃ idha hasīadi | lajā -- piasahi! aṇahiṇṇā khu tumaṃ hasīasi | ṇa edāo motiamāliāo, viaillaphullāeiṃ |edāiṃ kaṃkellikuṃsṭhamāiṃ ṇa vihumadalāiṃ | lakṣmīḥ -- (savilakṣaṃ vihasya) tā edāiṃyyeva ucciṇomha | (tayā kurvanti) lakṣmīḥ -- (bhramaravādhaṃ rūpayantī sasambhramam) sahoo! ke ede laṭualahuā pakkhisāvā jantā uḍḍenti? | dhṛtiḥ -- (vihasya) piasahi lacchi! tuha muhaparimalarasiā bhasalā ṇa ramanti peccha kusumesu | uṇhoṇhasāsalaharīsaṃtāvakaraṃvidā bhanti || 11 || raṇaraṇakadurvalāyā avikamaya bhavati ākṣcaryam || lakṣmīḥ -- (salanaṃ sasmidam) sahi! ṇa turma pucchissaṃ | piasahi lajje! phadhehi ede de bhasalā je maaraṃdajīvā suṇīanti? | lajā -- agha iṃ? | dhṛtiḥ piasahi! avacidāiṃ pahadāhaṃ kusumāhaṃ | aṃcīadu saṃpai bhaavadī bhavāṇī| lakṣmīḥ -- āṇīantu pariaṇādo pūovaraṇāiṃ | (dhṛtistayā karoti) (lakṣmīḥ pārvatīpūjāṃ nāṭayati) lajjā -- (saprārthanam) taha aṃcidāsi pavvai! lacchīe vivihakusumamālārhi | aṃcedu tuha pasāe jaha kaṇhaṃ ṇaaṇakamalehiṃ || 12 || dhṛtiḥ -- (saddarpam) piasahi! lacchi! diṭṭiāvaḍaṭhasi | pecchāmi tuha vāhulaaṃ vāmaṃ papphurantaṃ | paccāsannaṃ piadaṃsaṇaṃ pisuṇedi | lakṣmīḥ -- (salañjarimatam.) avehi avehi | (iti kusumena tāḍayati) padma -- (svagatam) daṃsemi edariṃsa avasare kaṇhacittavaḍaṃ imīe | (sahusotthāya) devi! pujjīadu edaṃ kaṇhassa rūvaṃ ṇaaṇakusumehiṃ kusumerhipi | (iti citrapaṭamarpayati) lajjā -- (vilokya saharyam) sāhu sāhu kiṃ bhaṇṇai pomañassa | jahā pomao davvāṇaṃ ṇihī tahā suhāṇaṃ tumaṃ ṇihī | lakṣmīḥ -- (saprasādasmitaṃ padmakamavalokya saharpecinapaṭamavalokayantī svāgavaṃ sāścaryam) aho rūvaṃ aho rūvaṃ! ṭhāṇe mahāmuṇiṇo edaṃ purisottamaṃ aṇimmidaṃ vāharanti ṇahu ṇahu eārisaṃ rūcaṃ keṇāvi ṇimmījmadi | (sotkapṭham) hibhaa! diṭṭiā vaḍatusi | kusumido dāva devīe kaccāaṇīe pasāapāavo saṃpai uṇa ālekkhadaṃśaṇapuṇṇādohadeṇaṃ yyeva phalisssadi | pajha -- devi lacchi! kiṃ vilaṃvīadi? | eso khuyu cittavaḍo gagādevīe pesido pujjīadu | jaṇaddaṇapūāeyyeya jaṇaddaṇo pāvīadi | kiṃ sunnahiaā tumaṃ? | ahaṃ khuṭu taeyyeya gaṃgādevīe pādavaṃdaṇaṃ kāuṃ pesido | lūjjā -- piasahi! sohaṇaṃ mantedi pomao ' pujjīadu cittalihio mahumaho| lakṣamīḥ -- (salanvaṃ dhṛtimukhamavalokmya sagadradam) appehi pūovaaraṇāiṃ | (dhṛtistayā karoti lakṣmīḥ| pṛjāṃ nāṭayati) lajjñā -- (saparihāsasmitam) kusumaṃjalisaṃghaḍaṇā vevirahatthāe kaha ṇu saṃpaḍai | gaggiragirā a manto samaggavapaṇo karha hoi || 13 || diṭṭhī ghāhāulioā tumammi jhāṇaṃ suṇivbharaṃ ṇavari tā | kamalaṇaaṇa! kamalaṃ aṇuaṃpasu vimalasavbhāvaṃ || 14 || (lakṣmīḥ satrīḍasmitaṃ pūjāṃ parihartumicchati) dhṛtiḥ -- (sasambhramaṃ saprārthanam) mā evam | piasahi! tujjha pavaḍṭau kāmamao mahumahammi savbhāvo | nikkāmalaasulaā mā murtti jhattiṃ pāvesu || 15 || (lakṣmīḥ sasmitaṃ kusumāśñjalimāropayati) lajjā -- (sahapaṃ saprārthanaṃ ciprapaṭe lakṣyaṃ vaddhā) suhaa purisottama!peccha peccha bhaṭṭidāriābhartti | bhaktigejjho khu tumaṃ itti pañcāsanno hohi | (nepathye) āḥ kimetat! ucchidya svayamutpatiṣpṇutanavaḥ sābhogavegormibhirghaddhavyūhamaraṇyayanti gaganaṃ vṛkṣāḥ sapakṣā ica | etena kriyate yugāntapavanaprāvandhamākasmiphaṃ duvītena vinanvatā'tirayataḥ sarve jagajvaṅgamam || 16 || pajha -- (svagatam) nṛnamāyāti surāsuraparivāro murāriḥ | nṛnamanveti taṃ mandarādriḥ, yadepa bhīpaṇaḥ pavanotpātaḥ | lakṣmīḥ -- (papanaveganādhāṃ nāṭayantī) dṛddhī haddhī sahīo ṇaedha maṃ piduṇo mahoahiṇo ucchaṃgaṃ | mae khu bhaavadīe kaccāaṇīe cāraṃcāraṃ kaaviviharaaṇapūāe velāvaṇyakusumapūāṇimittaṃ tādaṃ avbhatthia idha āgadaṃ | idha a eaṃ phalaṃ saṃvuttaṃ | lajjā -- (sasambhramam) ṇāarāa! ehi ehi |(hastī saddasīpasarpati) (sarvāḥ samāruhā samudrapraveśaṃ nāṭayanti) pajha -- (svagatam) aye! mahoahimahaṇavuttantaṃ gaṃgādevīkadhidaṃ ṇa dāva ṇivedaissaṃ | suṭṭhu vihalā bhavissadi bhaṭṭidāriā | varaṃ ighadhyeva edaṃ parūvaanto ciṭṭāmi | (iti tathā tipṭhati) (nepathye) madhuripurepa sphuradurukāmaḥ saha suradaitpairjaladhimupetaḥ! tuṅgakṣṛṅgasamūhairmīlitāmbaramupaiti mathanodyamahetormandaro mirirājaḥ ||17|| pajha -- (saharpam) aniṣṭamadhpe'pyadya sambhavipyati govindasandarśanaṃ bhartṛdarikāyāḥ | tadahaṃ tyaritayupasarpāmi jaladhimadhyay | (iti jaladhipraveśāmabhinīya nipkrāntaḥ) (tataḥ praviśati vyomayānena mahendrādisurāsuraparivāro vāmudevaḥ) vāsudevaḥ -- (saharyakaututrkam) ayi surapate! paśya vyomāṅgaṇādavataratrnidaśāsuraughacchāyājighṛkṣumakarotkaghūrṇitāmbuḥ | apyatra dūrataravarttini mandarādrāvunmathyamāna iva rājati sindhurājaḥ || 18 || taddhadrayamavatorya velāvane pratīkṣāmahe yāyadāyānti vrahmamaheśādayaḥsarve'pi devāḥ sarve'pi cāsurāḥ sa ca girirmandaraḥ | (iti velāvanamadhyāste) vṛdṛspatiḥ -- (samantādavalokya sākṣcarya sabhayam) aho vṛddhirvārddhettadiha hṛdayaṃ kṣubhyati paraṃ duranto'yaṃ manthaḥ prasabhamupahāsāya bhavitā | vighāyā̱tra snānaṃ sapadi sadūnaṃ yāta vibughāḥ pramodo yādobhyaḥ prabhavati na cetkopi vipamaḥ || 19 ||
indraḥ -- (svagatam) aho! vṛhaspatermantraparāmarśaikanānajadṛmatebhīṃrutvam | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśaṃ sagarvam) kiyānpārāvāraḥ kamalabhavabhṛṅgārakuharakṣaraddhārārabdhannidivasaridaupādhikasaraḥ | tadetanmanthāya vyavasitamidaṃ daityadivipatsamūhasyaitāvadbhavati hasanīyaṃ nahi katham || 20 || (solṇuṇṭham) dambholipāṇervalasṛdanasya vācaspateḥ! tvaṃ sacivottamo'si | tadatra dugdhāmyudhidorghikāyāmutsāhabhaṅgaḥ kanamastavāyam? || 21 || vṛhaspatiḥ -- (sāvajñaṃ vihasya) deva prabho purandara! trailokyadāhaprabhuraurvavahniḥ kinnāsya kiṃ nāsya sa kālakūṭaḥ || krodhoddhure'mutra na vṛtraśatro rakṣāprakāraḥ kavacādikaḥ syāt || 22 || dhanadaḥ -- (sagarvaṃ sāvajñam) jīva payodhermathanaṃ kāraya kiṃ vā nivāraya svairam | śauryaṃ kimatra pātuṃ dugdhaṃ vaḍavānalakathitam || 23 || vṛha -- (sāvajñopaddāsam) dūre'stu śauryam || amunā mahimnaiyāsya caktruvāka iva cīcivilolo mandaro'ntra bhavatu bhramaniṣṭhaḥ | pāśvaito'sya parivarttanabhaṅgayā kīṭakā iva bhavantu bhavantaḥ || 24 || vāsu -- (svagatam) aye! garvāyate gīrvāṇavargaḥ samudronmathanāya | tatputrīpremapāśaparavaśaścāsmi | tartika suramantrimantrānusāreṇa samudrothanodyogaṃ visṛjya prakārāntareṇa tatpāṇigrahaṇamārabhe, athavā surāsurasarvaiḥ samabhyarthyānītaḥ kathamivaitānatisanghāpa bhagramanorathānkaripye! | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) ayi vācaspate! nālasaṃ kuliśaṃ śārvrataṃ na yuddhirvidhurāsti te | sarvaṃ bhāvi śubhodarkaṃ harau sahacare mayi || 25 || vṛha -- (svagataṃ saddarpam) aye! anadhyavasāyottayaica me sudṛḍhaṃ saṃvṛttaṃ surakārye, yadevamayaṃ bhagavānmukundaḥ pratijñātavān | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) pāthonidhirmadhita eya samīhitāni siddhāni tāni madhusūdananirjarāṇām | dupprāpametadadhigamya vacastvadoyaṃ pīyūpamapyatanu samprati pītameva || 26 || indraḥ -- (sapraśrayam) pādodakaṃ tava janārddana! jāhnavī yā tattoyapūrṇajaladhermathanaṃ kiyatte | ājñākaraistridaśadānaghamandarādyairāḍamcaravyatikaro'pamaho vinodaḥ || 27 || vāsu -- (ūcaṃmavalomya) ayi sahasrekṣaya! dṛśyatāmayamāyātyeva kamalāsanaḥ | tadhāhi dugghāmvutherdugdhamadaḥ pipāsuḥ paitāmaho'yaṃ taralo marālaḥ | apreyaimāṇo'pi pitāmahena vihaṅgarājādhikamabhyupaiti || 28 || indraḥ -- (saphautuphamūrdhvamavaonya) kathamayaṃ bhagavānmaheśo'pi samāyāti vegena! | adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ mahadetatkutūhalam! devadevo'pi taralāyana eva | kṛṣṇaḥ -- mahendra! maivam krīḍantu komalaparākramasanniveśaiḥ svargesadaḥ suṭhurapateḥ prathukāmacārāḥ | atyāhite paripatatyatha daiyayogāddevo'yameva śaraṇaṃ karikṛttivāsāḥ || 29 || (tataḥ praviśati maheśo mahmā ca) brahmā -- (sarabhasamupasṛtya) udyamaṃ kuru govinda! pṛrṇakāmo bhavācirāt! phalitodyamakhedānāṃ viśrāmo maṇḍanāyate || 30 || maheśaḥ -- (saharpasmitam) kṛpṇa! anupṭhīyatāṃ surajyeṣṭhaśāsanam| vāsu -- (sapraśrayam) ugra! tvadagrato gāḍhaṃ sarva evotsahāmahe | ujjṛmbhate hi bhṛṭatyānāṃ kāpi śaktiḥ prabhoḥ puraḥ || 31 || tadāyātu mandarādriḥ | indraḥ -- (nabho'valokya) kṛpṇadeva! paśya paśya || amparāduttīrya pratpātanno babhṛva mahodaghermandarādriḥ|| abhyutthita ivātithyānmaināko gauraveṇa yam | samudramadhyasaṅkrantaprativimghasya kaitavāt || 32 || vāsu -- (saddarṣasmitaṃ harakaṇṭhe śepamālokya) nirmokavadyaḥ pṛthivīṃ veibhartti payaiṅkatāṃ yāti jagatpateryaḥ tasyaiva te mandaraśaila! manthanentrādhikāraḥ phaṇirājayobhyaḥ || 33 || śepaḥ -- (sapraśrayam) dandaśūkasya kīṭasya śattirevaṃvidhā ka me | prabhuḥ karotuṃ yatkiśvinmayi nyasya svavaibhavam || 34 || maheśaḥ -- (satmitam) nāgarāja! avilanvitaṃ vighehi mukundasandeśam) (śepaḥ sahasā śivaphaṇṭhāduttīrya nāṭyenoṅḍīya dugdhāīidhamadhyagatamandaramabhiveṣṭayati) mahendraḥ -- (sahapeoṃḍāsam) aye devā aye devā! pūrvavadeva avalambata nāgendranetramubhayapāśrvayoḥ | (sarve tathā kṛnvā viloḍanābhinayaṃ kurventi!| mandarastathaipa tiṣṭati) maheśaḥ -- (viddasya) sarve'pi kuṇayaḥ kṛpṇa! tvāṃ vināmo surāsurāḥ | tvamepāmaddhuto vāhurnippratyūhaścaturbhujaḥ || 35 || taddhayavasyatu bhavān | mā bhavatu viḍambranā surāsurāṇām | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sahasopasṛtya mandaramāvarttayansvagataṃ sotkṇṭham) tāmamvudhāvatra vicintya mkṣmīmutphampitaṃ niḥkṣvasitaṃ ca dīrgham | ujjṛmbhate gaṅgadaśavdatā me manthakṣamaḥ kintu susaṃghṛṇoti || 36 || tatsāvahitthamāvarttayāmi tāvat | (iti mandaramāvarttayati) brahmā -- (vrilophya saophautukam) maheśa! dṛśyatām | krīḍati bhramarakairiva nṛtyanmandaraḥ saha surāsurasārthaiḥ | śeṣapucchamukhavāhuyugaspa drāggatāgatamanojñavinodaiḥ || 37 || maheśaḥ -- (saharpākṣcaryam) aho mahatkautukaṃ varttate! | tadhāhi sāṭopasampātarayaprakarpādullāsinastuṅgataraṅgaphūṭāḥ | hastā iva ktroghanadugghavārddheḥ patantpamīṃ mandaraśailamaulau || 38 || vāsu -- (ākarṇanābhinayaṃ kṛtvā) tiṣṭhata tiṣṭata kṣaṇam | nirgacchadiva keimapi vibhāvyate | (sarve niścalā bhavanti) vāsu -- (saharyakautupham) kathitakuliśapātaduniṃmittasphuradurumeghavikhkṣagarjitānte | dhvaniriva madhuraḥ kalāpiyūnaḥ sukhayati mantharavātpayaścaro'yam || 39 || (tataḥ praviśanti vedāḥ) vāsu -- (jñānena pratyabhijñāya svagataṃ saharṣam) diṣṭyā nūnamamī vedāḥ samāgatāḥ| valiḥ -- (saprakṣrayam) bhagavan jagadīśa! sāghāraṇaḥ prabhrurasi surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca | samānabhaktivyavasāyepu ca parijanepu samānaprasādāḥ prabhavo bhavantīti vicintyam | maheśaḥ -- (svagatam) aye vibhāgalālasā dānayā!| apriyaṃ ca taddānavārestadeyaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) ayi dānaveśa! alamuṣṭhutsukanayā | kimaucityamacyutātpracyayate?| tadayameva pramāṇam | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saddapa syagatam) sādhu sarvajña! sādhu, yatkimapi na viśiṣṭaṃ sandiṣṭavānasi | tadevaṃ tāvat | (praphāśam) ayei dānaveśā! yadyadviniḥsarati sāgarāttattaddyāpi sāgaragarbha eva tiṣṭatīti sampradhāryatām | vastujātaṃ ca velāvane pālayantu dikpālā agnipamanirtrkṣatayaḥ | siddhe samudramathanodyame rbhagājñapā vibhāgo'stu | valiḥ -- pathā rocate'cyutāya | kṛṣṇaḥ -- ayi bhagavanto vedāḥ! samucite'tra velāvane vyapanīpatāṃ tāvadayaṃ mathanāyāso dikpālaśukṣrūpayā | agnyādidikpālāḥ -- (sapraśrayam) ita ito'tra bhavanto vedā| (pariktramya sarve tathā tiṣṭanti) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sollāsam) aye devāsurāḥ! punarviloḍayata gāḍham | (sarve tayā kurvanti) kṛṣṇaḥ -- tiṣṭhata tiṣṭata tāvat | (sarve tiṣṭanti) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (nirūpaṇāmabhinīya sāśvaryamūṃ) garīpānkaścididānīmāyāti | āyātyarvāgvīcīmālāsphūrjatphenāvegābhogāt | garjābhaṅgirvalgatyepā pratyagrāvdadhyānodārā || 40 || (tataḥ praviśatyairāvataḥ) indraḥ -- (vilokya savismayam) dambholighātacakitaḥ prasabhaṃ purā yaḥ pāthodhikoṇakuhare nibhṛtaṃ nilīnaḥ uttuṅgakṣṛṅgasavalaḥ pṛthumandhakhedānmaināka epa sa punarvahirabhyupaiti || 41 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagatam) diṣṭyā nūnamapamairāvataḥ karī | (prakāśam) ayi parameśāna! nirgato'yaṃ gajendrastadvilokyatām | maheśaḥ -- (saharṣasmitam) rājatvamarhati kuñjaraviśepo'pam | 'adhitiṣṭhatu śiśiraśiśirāṃ velāvanatarucchāyām | (airāvatastathā karoti) vāsu -- api cālayata punarmanthācalam | (sarve tathā kurvanti) vāsu -- sthīyatāṃ sthīyatām punaḥ kiñcidāyāti | (sarve sthirā bhavanti) vali -- (vilokya) ayi vāsudeva! vyarthamidānīṃ saṃvṛttaṃ mandarāvarttanaṃ, yadidamavastubhūtamiva kiñcinniḥsarati | vāsu -- (svagatam.) vyarthameva bhavanāṃ mandarāvarttanam | avastubhūtaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhayatāṃ bhavipyati | indraḥ -- sādhūkttaṃ dānavarājena | tathāhi prāṇamārunahatollasadūrghvakṣīrasīkarakṛtotkaravṛṣṭiḥ | vārddhimadhyagataparvatakṣṛṅgādvayākulaḥ sphudamupaiti hayāsyaḥ || 42 || tadaghastubhūta evāyam | vāsu -- nirgacchatu niḥśepastāvat | (tataḥ praviśatyuñcai.śravāḥ) vāsu -- (vilokya spagatam) aye! ayaṃ haparāja uñcaiḥśravāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ śrūyate | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakrāśaṃ saparihāsam) prabho śambho! sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇo'pamaśvamedhapogyo hayo doyatāṃ bhagayate hiraṇpagarbhāya | brahmā -- (saparihāsam) aho! asmāsu harerhayapratigrahaṃ kārayitumupacikīrpā | maheśaḥ -- (saharṣe viddatya) ayi kṛpṇa! senāṅgatvādapamapi hastisavidhamaghyāstām | (uñcaiḥśravāstathā karoti) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sollāsam) aye bhramayantu punarmandaraṃ bhayantaḥ | (devā surāstathā kurvanti) dhanadaḥ -- (sāścarye savitarkam) aye! mathanaṃ mantharīkṛtya dṛśyatāṃ tācat| prahādanaṃ dravyamudeti kiñcidālakṣyavṛttākṛtisaṃniveśam | yatphāntipūraprasareṇa vārddhiḥ manthakrudhā dyāmadhirohatīva || 43 || (tataḥ praviśati candraḥ) indraḥ -- (saharpe savitarkam) kimapamamṛtakumbhaḥ kinnu manthāpamarddavyathitajalaghidugdhasnehapiṇḍo'yamīddak | kimidamananubhūtaṃ bhūtamāhlādi kiñcitkimiya nahi vicitraṃ syātpayodhau yicitre || 44 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (smaraṇamabhinīya spagataṃ sotkaṇṭham) tañcitraddaṣṭaṃ kimu vaktrametadāvirbhavatyamcunigheḥ sutāyāḥ | api śrutaṃ yatkusumāyudhasya mṛtyukṣtrayatvādamṛtaṃ jigāya || 45 || (nipuṇaṃ nirūpya) aye! kalaṅkakalupamanyadeva kimapi | na tadvatrkam | (sakhedaṃ niḥśvasya) priyāmugyāśayā dṛṣṭirdhāvitā me'tra nirmale | drāgevāpasaratyepā kalaṅkagalahastitā || 46 || (nirūpya) nunamanena pīyūpamayūsvena bhavitavyam (prakrāśam) prabho! śaṅkara! sudhākaro'yaṃ samprāpsaḥ | candraḥ -- (maddeśamālokya saharṣe spagatam) diṣṭyā pramathito me pitā pāthodhiryadepa mahāmunibhirapi durāsadasandarśano nayanapathamavalīrṇe bhagavānpramathanāthaḥ | maheśaḥ -- (sudhāṃśumālokya svagatam) aye mahāphalaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ pāthodhimatha nāyāso yadayamāsādito yajcanāṃ parivṛḍhaḥ | (prakāśay) ayi kṛṣṇa! phakubhi phakubhi carpan śaityagarbhāngābhastī -- , nmathanajanitakhedaṃ khaṇḍayanyaḥ prakāmam | adhivasatu muhartta vārddhivelāvanālīṃ dvijaparivṛḍha epa grāmaṇīḥ prīṇamānaḥ || 47 || (candraratayā karoti) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saddarpolṭam) aho! pāthodhimathanaspādbhutāni phalāni | tadbhūyo'bhiyarttatāṃ mandarācarttaḥ | (surāmurāstathākurvanti) varuṇaḥ -- (puro'valokya sakhedam) āḥ! kimāmūlato vpadhitaḥ pādhodhirpadetāḥ samullasanti śevṛālalatāḥ! | indraḥ -- (sāgharyem) tāddagvidhairmendaradurthivattairvināśamāyurjalajantavo ye | prāṇanti te paśṭyana sadya eva jhampāliyācālitaghārddhipūrāḥ || 48 || sarve surāsurāḥ -- ahaha! citraṃ citraṃ modāmahe | aṅgamaṅgagamadhikṛtya varddhate tādṛgeva valavānvalodayaḥ | mandhaśailapariyarttanaśramaḥ sagha eva śamameti dāruṇaḥ || 49 || tatkimenat? | vāsu -- (mṛimṛśya) nūnamenā mahaupadhayo na śevālalatāḥ | (tavaḥ praviśanti mahaupadhayaḥ) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (maharyam) amlānapuppabharamampadupāsyamānā mṛnyucchidastyamiva śaṅkara | puṇpaśīlāḥ | abhpāgatāḥ śiāva! mahaupaghapasnadāsāmāśāṃ prayaccha mahasā hasinānalānām || 50 || maheśaḥ -- (sairpam) dugghāmyughau janma suyā sūyamā mā paropaphārāpa ramaprapharpaḥ | āmāṃ prasadgena mahānubhāyā bhapantu yelāpanaśāno'pi || 51 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- ktriyatāṃ maheśanideśaḥ | (aupadhayastathā tiṣṭanti) vāyuḥ -- (sotsāham) ayi devadānavāḥ! vivarttayata manthācalam | ahamapi nijayegavaibhavena sahasragurṇīkaromi taddhegam | vitaratu ratnākaro duṣprāpapadārthān | (devadānavāstathā kurvanti) kuveraḥ -- (sāśvaryam) āstāmāstām | paśyata paśyata vividhavarṇatāṃ mahārṇavasya | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (savitarkam) utprehkhanti tupitkaṭasya vahavāvahne kimetāḥ śikhāḥ sindhurdarśayate purandaradhanurnirjipṇu kiṃvā dhanuḥ! etatkiñcidudīyate'dbhutamayaṃ dravyāntaraṃ kinnu vā yajjayotirnicayairghanaṃ kavacito netrāyate sāgaraḥ || 52 || (tata praviśanti vividhavarṇāni ratnāni) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (nirūpya saharṣam) aye! ratnāni samāgatāni | idametepu kimapi māṃsalaṃ kuṭilaṃ pradhānaratnam | (sotkaṇṭham) kṣṛṅgāritāśepasamudrapūramidaṃ manohāri na rocipaiva | janmāntaropārjitabandhukampaṃ hārddādapi drāvayatīva cetaḥ || 53 || tadāvedayāmidevadevasya | kṣīkaṇṭha | nirūpaya nirūpayā ratnāni samāgatāni | maheśaḥ -- (saddarpam) adya kṛtārthā pṛthivī | nanu vakttavyaṃ samāgatāni nighānāni, samāgatā lakṣmīḥ , samāgatamamṛtam| tadidānīm ete'tra pāvanaśiromaṇayo bhajantāṃ velāvanābharaṇatāṃ maṇayo muharttam | āyāmibhiḥ kiraṇabāhubhiramburāśerāpraśnakālaparirambhamivāryayantaḥ || 54 || (ratnāni tayā tiṣṭanti) vāsu -- (svagataṃ saharpam) hṛdaya! hṛdaya! diṣṭyā varddhase kamalāvalokanapratyāsattyā | nahi nahi maheśavyāṣṭṛtayo vṛthā bhavanti | (praphāśaṃ sautmumyam) tvaradhvaṃ tvaradhvaṃ surāsurāḥ | bhramayantu bharvento mandhācalam | (sarve tathā kurvanti) indraḥ -- (sāścaryaṃ saṃsagbhramam) śāmyatu śāmyatu tācanmathanāvarttaḥ | ayanarati kimapisaumpataraṃ vastu | (sarve sāścarye nirūpayanti) vāsu -- (vilokya savitarkam) samullasatsaumyamhomahormiḥ sahodaraḥ kiṃ bhavittāyamindoḥ | apūrako netramahotsavasya madhye sa tādṛṅ na tu kālimāsti || 55 || indraḥ -- (nirūpya sāścaryam) aho! sahasaiva nirgatpa sphuṭīvamūva strīrūpamidam | vāsu -- (vibhāvya sānyaryem) aho! srūpamasyāḥ | adhiñjalanidhigarbha ko'pi lāvaṇyavārddhirnivasani jananirasyāsnatra nanaṃ vamūva | bhavati hi kaghamirntha yogyanā'syaiva vārddheramṛnapharasudhāghā yatprasṛtiḥ praśṭrātpā || 56 || api gha asyāḥ sphṛratkāntivimūpināvgheḥ kalloladolānaralādgayaṣṭeḥ | āpṛrayantyāḥ kakṛbho'kṣipajhairāphanpamepābharaṇanyameni || 57 || (pratpabhijñāpa svagataṃ soṭaphaṣṭham) nūnamipaṃ gadgayā āliruya kadhinā mā papobhipustrī bhavippati | tadhādi ālekhye dṛṣṭghaitāṃ yaścetasi paricayo mamāhuritaḥ | utpallavaḥ sa sahasā sahasrabhāsatvamabhyeti || 58 || (tataḥ praviśati lakṣmīḥ) lakṣamīḥ -- haddhī! haddhī! aho maha haajīvassa kadiṇattaṇaṃ ja eārise vi visamavaiare ṇa ṇīharadi | (puraḥ kṛṇṇamālokya sapratyamijñamiva) kaghaṃ ālekkhadiṭṭhaṃ taṃ suhṛaṃ aṇuharadi esā rūvariddhī | (niḥśvasya) ahavā kṛdo eārisāiṃ bhaggāiṃ? | kiṃ karemi | tahavi ahiramadi igha me diṭṭo | (idi abhramavalokrate) vāsu -- (svagataṃ sadvarṣam) hṛdaya! diṣṭyā varddhase | mahatyapi sambhrame sākṛtamiva dṛṣṭamasyāḥ | tathāhi sābhogavegamathanaklamambhṛtopmakṣīrāvghivocipaṭalīparitāpitāni | aṅgāni me śiśiārayanti saromhākṣyā akliṣṭamugdhalaharīsuhṭadaḥ kaṭākṣāḥ || 59 || maheśaḥ -- (lakṣmīṃ dṛṣṭvā svagatam) nṛnamipaṃ sā bhāvinī purupottamasya vallabhā lakṣmīstadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśaṃ sākūtam.) ayi purupottama! samuddharaitāmadvitīyāmaśaraṇāṃ pāṇigrahaṇena yopinam | lakṣmīḥ -- (svagataṃ sairpam) kaghaṃ eso purisottamo! | edaṃ esa kovi avaro mahāṇubhāvo ādiśadi! tā kiṃ ayukaṃpissadi maṃ pāavarha | vāsu -- epa sampādayāmi śivanideśam | (iti pārṇi prasārya lakṣmīmānayati) lakṣamīḥ -- (svagataṃ sotkaṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhamavalambamānā) acchariaṃ acchariaṃ tādassa mahaṇadukkhe virahe caṃdādivaṃdhuvaggassa | ukkaṇe pāṇāṇaṃ ko eso pahariso jāo || (prakāśaṃ vivṛtya samudramavalokya sakhedam) aho me piduṇo mahaṇaveaṇāe pajjñāulattaṇaṃ | vāsu -- (sollāsam) mukṣca subhrṛ! bhayamepa te pitā prārthyate na khalu matyate'mvudhiḥ | āgatānvadati devadānavānmandarastamavahelanipṭhuram || 60 || (svagatam) iyadeya me sukhaṃ, parārthaḥ kāyalkeśo'paraḥ | (ivi savrīḍaṃ kathaṭhkathamapi kaṇṭhāttāmavatārayati) lakṣmīḥ -- (saddarpamātmagatam) aṇūbhūdaṃ mae amaaṃ, aṇusūdo caṃdo, aṇaṇubhūdaṃ mae eaṃ vaaṇamahurattaṇaṃ | tā ṇūṇaṃ esa so jjeva suhao | saṃvadanti te gaṃgādo āaṇṇidā guṇā edassi | vāsu -- (sapraśrayam) api parameśa! āgateyaṃ lakṣmīḥ | maheśaḥ -- kṛpṇa!kṛpṇa! prathamata eva mayā jñātaṃ, yattaralāpitamaspā jananyā ratnākarapatnyā mama maulimandākinyā | (gaṅgāṃ prati) ayi gaṅge kāmarūpe! viśramaya velāvane kabhalālayām | (gaṅgā sahasotthāya tayā karoti) valiḥ -- (svagataṃ savipādam)aho! durāśayatāmiva maheśakeśavādīnāmavaghārayāmi | padaite dhārayanti, na vibhajante pāthīdhimathanopāttāni vastūni | (sāvajñam) bhavatu | paścādapi vāhuvalenaiva sulabhānītarāṇi vastūni, yāvanna divipadaḥ pīyūpaṃ nipīyāmarā bhavanti | tadamṛtāvirbhāvasamaye mayā avahitena bhāvyam | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) sakhe kujambha! ehyehi | kujambha -- (praviśya) kimādiśayate? (valiḥ | karṇe evameva) kṛjambhaḥ -- (saharpollāsam) siddhametat | indraḥ -- agavannārāyaṇa! tvatparāyaṇo'yaṃ vyavasāyaḥ | kimidānīmeva bhandāyase? | vāsu -- (mandaramāvarttayansvagataṃ sotkaṇṭham) yāvadvabhūva hariṇārbhakalocanāyāratrāsapragalbhaparirambhasukhopabhogaḥ | vāhvoryalaṃ mativalaṃ vyapanīya kāmastāvadviḍamvayati māṃ karavai kimatra || 61 || (prakāśaṃ sāvahittham) ayi gīrvāṇāḥ! ayi dānavāḥ! sarvaprāṇena paribhramayata punarmanthācalam | (sarve tathā kurvanti) dhanadaḥ -- paśyata paśyata kumbhānāmiva_mukhānyutpreṅkhanti | indraḥ -- (sasambhramam) āstāmāstāṃ tāvanmandarāvarttanam | kathaṃ samagrā eva kumbhāḥ samuttaranti | (savitarpham) kimamī sphuditatvādvivikttāḥ kathamanyathottānamugkhāstaranti | dhanadaḥ -- (savitarkam) vicinrā kimiyamuttānamukhī kaumbho nauradbhutanidhau payodhī! | vāsu -- (nirūṣya sahapaim) kaumbhī dhravaṃ nauriyamabhyupaiti vinirmitā kinnu nidhānakumbhaiḥ | yasyāḥ prasiddhā bhuvanatrnaye'pi dārighavārddhestaraṇe prasūktti || 62 || indraḥ -- (sāścaryam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! paśya paśya upanidhānakumgtaṃ kiñcidaparaṃ vinirgacchati | (kṣaṇaṃ nirūpya saharpākṣcaryam) kumbho'yamambhonidhipūramadhpādatyadbhutaḥ ko'pyudayāṃtrabhūva | asaṃstutaṃ kiñcidudayanti yadbhandhayāhāḥ paramapramodam || 63 || kṛpṇaḥ -- (saddarpe spagatam) nṛnamanena pīyūpakumbhena bhayitavyaṃ, yadspa sandarśanādeva mamāpyantarātmmā praharpavyākulatāmupaiti | (prakāśaṃ saddarpam) maheśa! maheśa! diṣṭavā varddhase poyūpasamāgamena | nighānakumbhā appamī samāgatāḥ | maheśaḥ -- (saddarpe sasambhramam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! avahitenātra bhavatā bhavitavyam | svayameva sanbhāyayantu velāvanaṃ nighānakumbhā | āhaya samarpaya hutamujaḥ pīyūpakumbham | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (saddarpamughaiḥ phāram) pāyanaśiromaṇe pāvaka! eghyehi | valiḥ -- (sasagbhramamipa) sakhe kujambha! syayameva devadevo janārdanaḥ pāyaphamāhvapate | tattvaṃ gatvā samānaya velāvanātpāvapham | (iti kākṣeṇa yīkṣane) kujambhaḥ -- (saddasā nirgatya pāvapacepaḥ praviśya sapraśrayam) krimādiśati deyadecaḥ keśayaḥ? | kṛpṇaḥ -- (maddarpam) sakhe śociḥkeśa! mugpamasi sarvepāṃ, mugpyo'si sarvepu, tadgṛhāṇa pīyūpaphumbham | (phujambhaṃ pratīnchati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (ptopahāmamii) sakheśiṣvin! kiṃ punatnavaṃ mandatejāḥ saṃghṛttaḥ? | kujambhaḥ -- (sapraśrayam)phimasmadādīnāṃtyatsamīpe'pi tejaḥ samudīyate?! (iti nipphāmati) valiḥ -- (svagavaṃ saddarpam) sāghu sāghu samardhitaṃ phujambhena | vāsu -- (maharpomāham) ayi dānapāḥ! kṛnakṛtpāḥ maṃpṛttāḥsmastadidānīmuddāmarabhasāḥ sahastramuṇavalena calayana mandhācalam | (sarye tayā gurpanti) vāyuḥ -- (sabhayam) ahaha! kruddhamivedānīṃ caivarṇyamāpadyamānamambhonidhimavalokayāmi | itaśca kaścihuṣṭo jalajanturiva nirgacchati | indraḥ -- (samyagvibhāvyaṃ) naipa jalajantuḥ | bhīpaṇo'tikuṭilaḥ kaṭhinātmā marmakarttanacicakṣaṇavakraḥ | aṅkuśaḥ khala ivaipa payodherduṣṭaceṣṭinanidhiḥ samupaiti || 64 || dhanadaḥ -- (sāśvaryam) paśyata paśyata | itaścāyam duḥsahaḥ surapaterivṛ daṇḍo daṇḍa epa samupaiti kaṭhoraḥ | yadbhayena jalajantusamṛho dūrato'pasarati kacidavdhau || 69 || vāyuḥ -- (samayam) samullasatkāntiṣūrānusāradṛśyamānaśarīro mīnaḥ kaścidito'bhivarttate | indraḥ -- (nirūpya) maivam āyarttate timirayaṃ yadi tatkimasya sparśādvidīorṇatanavastimayo mriyante | sakttābhirāmapulakotkarasaṅkalāṅgastadvāridherayamudaścati maṇṭalāgraḥ || 66 || vāsu -- ayi parameśa! paśya paśya | parikupitaḥ pārāvāraḥ | maheśaḥ -- (sāppajñam) kimasya sainikāḥ sāyudhā vinirgatā utāyameva svayamudāyugho vikrāmati?| gabhīro'yaṃ mahātmā vaideśiphaḥ kopaprakāreṣu | mathanāyāsollusitāni mahānubhāvāni svayamāyudhāni nipkāmanti | tadetāni sādhidaivatāni namaskṛtya vāsaya velāvane | devānāmevaitāni sulabhāni mahate phalāya bhavipyanti | (kṛyṇaḥ tathā kṛtvā punastathaiva mathanāvartte pravarttayati) mahendraḥ -- (vilokya sāścaryam) kṛṣṇa! kṛṣṇa! paśya paśya | āścaryamayaṃ kimapyatipramāṇaṃ marakataratnaṃ samullasati | vāsu -- (nirūpya) ānandasandohanidānaśaktte rudīyate pātrāmidaṃ surāyāḥ tadbhadhagādhyagrahagāḍhalag bhṛṅgotkaraimarakataṃ vibhāti || 67 || dhanadaḥ -- (sasanbhramam) atyāhitamatyāhitam paśyata tāvaditaḥ| ihoparipṭādvihagā bhramantaḥ kallolavātopahatāḥ patanti | parāsaco'mī timayo bhavanti drāgāranālatvamupaiti dugdham || 68 || indraḥ -- (vibhāvya) paśyata paśyata | vinirgataiva kācidiha vallī | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (nirūṣya) nūmaṃ vipamidam | ahaha! atyāhitamāpatitam | śiva! śiva! surā samāgatā, vipaṃ cāgatam | maheśaḥ -- (sasambhramam) kṛṣṇa! kṛṣṇa! sādhidaivataṃ dravyadvamidaṃ prasāgha velāvane niveśayatu bhavān | (kṛṣṇastathā karoti) mahendraḥ -- (sarabhasam) ayi surāsurāḥ.! tathedārnī samadhikabalā viracayata viloḍanaṃ , yathā samāsāditāṅbhutapadārthāḥ punarviloḍanāya na spṛhayāmahe | (sarve tayā kurvanti) (nepathye kalakalaḥ) vāsu -- (samākarṇya sasambhramam) āḥ!kaepa mandarāparapārśve surāsurāṇāṃ bhopaṇaḥ kalakalo vijṛmbhate? | (punarnepadhye) dhūmaḥ predvati ko'pi sārddhamaśucirnetrāṇi nirvāsayan jvālaughāmṛtamāraṇāpraṇayinaḥ praṅkhanti pakṣcadamī | dugdhaplopavirūkṣagarvavipamacchaṅkāravācālitaḥ kṣīrābghiḥ punareti mecakaruciḥ ko'pyepa voparyudhaḥ || 69 || vāsu -- (sabhayaṃ sāścarye samantādalokya) kathamahaha! kṣaṇādeva na kimapi paśayāmi | naṣṭaḥ kutra mahārṇayaḥ kka nu yayau tādṛksa manthācalo vidrāṇaḥ ka phaṇīśvaraḥ kka nu gatāste hanta devāsurāḥ | dikūcakraṃ jvalayanniraḍuśamiladaddhorānghakārormibhiḥ pātālāyitarodasīparikaraḥ ko'yaṃ prakāro'bhavat || 70 || maheśaḥ -- (sasambhramam) ayi kṛpṇa! pālane tava niyogastadidānīṃ saha devāsūraiḥ samudramathanopāttavastṛni gṛhītvā kkacitparipālaya | ahamenamanarthaṃ śāmayāmi | (iti niṣphāntāḥ sarve) prathamo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśati kapaṭakāminīvepo caikuṇṭhaḥ sakhīvepo vainateyaśca) vainateyaḥ -- (saharṣam) api janārddana! sakalajagadrūpasya keyaṃ bhavato'drutarūpanirmāṇanaipuṇe kṣlāghā? | adya punaryadidaṃ bhavanā vanitārūpamāviṣkṛtaṃ nahi tadbhavanāpyanubhūtapūrvam | kiṃ punarayaṃ purupaśūnye velāvane nikuñje nirarthako bhavatā saphalīkṛtamadanaprākttanasukṛtaparipāko hevākaḥ prasāryate? | tathāhi dṛśordvandvaṃ khelatyalasamalasaṃ karṇasavidhe naṭantī bhrūvallī kusumaviśikhaṃ vījayati ca | muhuḥ smerasmeraṃ madayati mukhāmbhoruhamidaṃ svataḥ kṣobhaṃ yāssi tvamapi mukuraṃ paśyasi yadā || 1 || vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- sakhe vainateya! arthakṣṛṅgāro'yamadbhuto mahate'rthāya pragalbhate | hevākābhinayaṃ cātrākasmikapurupāgamanaśaṅkayā prasārayāmi | vaina -- (sasambhramam) kathaṃ śabda iveha kṣūyate! | nnṛnamāyāti kaścit | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (sāśaṅkam) sakhe vainateya! taditaḥprabhṛti yopidbhāvābhinayārthaśmāvābhyāṃ prākṛtabhāpayā tadanurūpaḥ kṛnārthīkṛnakusumacāpaḥ saṃlāpaḥ kriyatām | vaina -- (patrāntarālairālokya apavāritakena) āyāta eva sānucaraḥ kaścinmahānubhāvaḥ purupaviśepa | (tataḥ praviśati valiḥ kujambhaśca) valiḥ -- (saparitoṣam) sakhe kujambha! sādhu sādhu bhavatā kṛrta, panmahatā naipugena pīyūyamānīotarmaṃ | kiṃ punaḥ pīyūpaṃ labdhamapyalabdhameva, yanmayā na samāsāditā jaladhikanyāvamānilāvaṇyā kāpi kanyā | kujambhaḥ -- (svagataṃ sajuguṣsam) aho! aspa madanamohānghatā, padayamamṛtaṃ kāminīsamāgamādadharamavadhārayati | (prakāśaṃ sapraśrayam)tadapi na bhavato valavadbhāgyasya valerddhaṣprāpamavadhārayāmi | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagataṃ sopahāsam) dvayamapi dupprāpaṃ bhavippati | valiḥ -- sakhe kujambha! kiṃ punarito mṛgamadāmodaḥ pravarttane? | kujambhaḥ -- (āvrāṇamabhinīya sāścaryam) ayi dānaveśa! nāyaṃ vipinalatānāṃ sahasraśāḥparicito hi tadganghaḥ | mṛgamadaparimalalaharī piśunayati kimapyadhiṣṭhānam || 2 || tadutthāya nirūpayāmi tāvat | (tathā kṛtvā saharṣāścaryam) dānaveśa! ehyehi kṛtārthaya cakṣupī | adyaprabhṛti te saphalaṃ janma || adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ paśya kanyāratnam | (valiḥ sotkaṇṭhamuttiṣṭati) vaina -- (apapārya) vaikuṇṭha! abhinīyantāṃ vipralambhānubhāyāḥ | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagatam) taistaiḥ pūthukṣvasitapāṇḍimatānavādyairye vipralambhamabhinetumahaṃ samīhe | so'yaṃ payonidhisutāvyavadhānaduḥkhasandhukṣito bhavati samprati satya eva || 3 || vaina -- piyasahi mohaṇie! kiṃ uṇa attāṇaṃ aṇavekkhiya evaṃ uttammasi? | sāhesu me śiāviṇāadiṭṭha taṃ suhaaṃ | mohanikā -- ṇiuṇie! alaṃ sāhideṇa | ṇahu ṇahu teṇa sārikkheṇa tihuaṇammi kovi atthi | valiḥ -- (ākarṇya sotkaṇṭham) kiṃ punaritdhamadbhutasambhāvanayā sukṛtī sudṛśā kṛtārthākriyate | kujambhaḥ -- ehi tāvatprakaṭībhavāvaḥ | (umāvupamarpataḥ) nipuṇikā -- (sahamotyāya sapraśrayam) maddābhāa! paṇāmobhaṭṭidāriāe | valiḥ -- (sagandam) abhilapitamāsādayatu bhavadbhartṛdārikā | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagadam) gadbhadagalitākṣarāpi sampūrṇeyamupaśrutirbhaviṣyati | kujambhaḥ -- (uttarīyamāsanavatkṛtvā) idamalaṅkarotu dānavendraḥ | valiḥ -- (upaviśya sahapoṃtkraṭhaṃ svagataṃ sāścarya) anubhūtapūrvamitthaṃ strīratnaṃ na khalu vedhasaḥ śilpe | madanasya bhuvanajayinaḥ śākttimīyāmayī kimiyaṃ? || (prakāśaṃ sakhīrūpaṃ vainateyaṃ prati) bhadre? keyaṃ bhavadbhartṛdārikā? | kiṃ nimitamuttāmyati? | nipuṇikāvepo vainateyaḥ -- mahābhāa! esā khu kamalāe kaṇiṭṭhā samuddaduhidā! jadopahudi imīe kovi abbhudarūvo suhao siviṇae' puloido tadopahudi avbhaṃtaraviaṃbhamāhuḍḍāmaraveaṇāe ṇiviḍavilayāvaguṇṭhaṇā kilammadi | paraṃ paramasāhasiavca ṇa vīhedi maraṇādo aṇpgahā agyāi karuṇaaṃ kā jhaṃpai kā malayagaṃdhavāhammi | kā jīvie saaṇhā kalaaṃṭhakuhūjhuṇiṃ suṇāi || 4 || (sākṛtarimatam) saṃpai uṇa tumhāṇa daṃsaṇādo pahudi kiṃpi kiṃpi āsartti va vihāvemi | kā muṇedi atthi tumhāṇa siviṇayadiṭṭhasārikkhaṃ ṇa veti | (nipuṇikāvepaṃ vainateyaṃ tarjayanniva tiryagavalokanaiḥ savrīḍamadhomukhaṃ tiṣṭati) valiḥ -- (sautsukyaṃ sotkaṇṭham) māmanugṛhāṇa mugghe! dṛkpātairamṛtapāṭavagrahilaiḥ | jīvitamajīvitaṃ me samprati subhru! tvadāyattam || 5 || (paikuṇṭhaḥ avāḍmukha eva sasmitaṃ paśyati) valiḥ -- (sahapoṃtkaṇṭha m) locanasarojamālā premaguṇeneyamadbhutā grathitā | vikṣrāmyati mayi diṣṭayā sutanoḥ saṃvaraṇamāleya || 6 || (prakrāśam) sakhe kujambha! sambhāvito'smi sudṛśā prasādena | kiṃ punaścirayati gururno bhagavānbhārgavaḥ? | sa hi mayā amṛtaprāśanamahotsave agrāsanārthaṃ sanghānakaṃ prepya samāhṛtasnatki sandhānakaḥ paṅgu karmāntaravyagro vā guruḥ? | (tavaḥ praviśati sandhānakenānugamyamāno bhārgavaḥ) sandhānakaḥ -- (sapraṇāmam) dāṇavesa! eso bhaggavo gurū saṃpatto | (valiḥ sasambhramaṃ yathāvadupasthāya praṇamati) śukraḥ -- (saddarpam) varddhanāṃ varddhatāṃ kaliḥ| (svagataṃ savailakṣyam) āḥ kathaṃ me harpabharavyākulasya valiriti vakttavye kaliriti samāgatam! | bhavatu | yātu tāvadavidinamevainat | sandhānakaḥ -- (vṛṣīmupanīya) alaṃkaredu edaṃ ajjo | śukaḥ -- (upaviśpa kanyārūpaṃ vaikuṇṭhamālokya svagavaṃ sāścaryam) aho adṛṣṭapūrvamadbhutamidaṃ strīrūpaṃ prajāpateḥ sarge | tatveyaṃ bhāyāmayīva? | (rutrīrūpo vaiphuṇṭhamtathaitra savrīḍamāsne) valiḥ -- (saddarpam) bhagavanbhārgava! ratnākarasya tanayeyamaparā rūpopahasitakamalālayā mayi sarāgā | anaḥparaṃ bhagavānpramāṇam | śukraḥ -- (saddarṣam) kimatra vimṛśyamasti | nippratyūho bhava sarvābhyudayaparamparāṇāṃ pātram | (nepathye) na manyate sudāruṇaṃ daivamenat | yadenairgṛhonasakalasamudropārjinadravyairdevairapahasnitāḥ parityakttasamarāṅgaṇāḥ samāpatanni viklavā dānavāḥ | valiḥ -- (sakrodhamutthāya) āḥ! kiṃ duryalo valiḥ saṃvṛttaḥ? , yadevaṃ bhavipyati | kujambhaḥ -- sajjaya sajjaya sainyāni | śukraḥ -- (vāmākṣimpandanaṃ sūcayitvā sdagataṃ savipādam) āḥ! kathaṃ madupaśrunidurnimittaṃ durnimittānnaramapyanuvarttate | tadevaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) ayi dānavarāja | na yujyate tadājimahotsayaḥ | samprani samudinā devāḥ | valiḥ -- (sopahāsam) guro bhārgava! jānātyeva bhavānvalervalam | tatkimidamucyate? | (sasarambham) maddoḥstambhavighūrṇitena tarasā yenaiva manthādriṇā pāthodhiḥ sa tathā tathā pramathitastaddracyajātaṃ dadau | tenaivāgha vṛthā bhujoṣmacapalān nippipya daitpadruho bhūyo'syāḥ pitaraṃ karomi sahasā durddharpaharpotkaṭam || 7 || śukraḥ -- daityapate! kṛtāmṛtaprāśanasya bhavato mṛtyuñjayasya sukhāvahaḥ samarārambhaḥ | valiḥ (sagarvam) guro! bhaipajyamātramidaṃ pīyūpamū | kimanena? | asāgarotpannamatīva citraṃ pīyūpametadbhujayorddhayaṃ me nirmāya yadvairikulāvasānaṃ mamāmaratvaṃ sahasā vibhartti || 8 || pratijñātamidaṃ mayā bhagavato guroḥ purataḥ | pīyūpābhyadhikaṃ praharpasuhitānsaṃsārayātrātyajo dhārātīrthagatāyupaḥ pratibhaṭānkṛtvā raṇaprāṅgaṇe | tvayyagrāsanapūjite kulagurau sārddha suhṛdvānghavaiḥ mohinyā saha kāntayā sarabhasaḥ prāpnomi no vā sudhām ||9|| mohinīcepo vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagataṃ saharpam) diṣṭyā bhagnastāvadbhārgavaspa mantra | diṣṭayā kṛtāntadolāmiva duppratijñāmārūḍho valiḥ | śukaḥ -- (sakrodham) bale! avasannaṃ dāmacakulaṃ yadevamasadgrahagṛhīto bhavān | tadapyavavodhayāmi bhavantam | caritraṃ pātaṅgaṃ yadasiśikhini prāpuracirānmahādaityāste te madhumurahiraṇyākhyanarakāḥ | idānīṃ ghaikuṇṭhaḥ kisu sa mahilābhāvamūgamaghadetatprāgalbhyaṃ sphurati bhavato dormadamayam || 10 || (vaikuṇṭhavainateyau sāphūtamanyonyamayalophya saṃvaraṇaṃ nāṭayataḥ) valiḥ -- (sagarram) guro bhārgava! kiṃ pralapasi? | mahilaigha mamāprato vaikuṇṭhaḥ | etadeva bhaghatāmahamabhyarthaye vicitrarūpāmanuyandhirāgāṃ svayaṃ samenāṃ mahate sukhāya | kanyāmapūrvī paripālayaitāṃ mābhūnmamāyaṃ viphalaḥ prayāsaḥ || 11 || sakhe kujambha! upanaya me pīyūpabhājanam | (kujambhaḥ upanayati) valiḥ -- (pīyūpanamādāya kanyāvepaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ pravi) pīyūpametaddapite! gṛhāṇa tvameva pīyūpamidaṃ vṛthā me | sampūrṇākāmā katicinmuhūrtairbhava priye yāmi raṇotsavāya || 12 || (iti pīyūpapātramagrato dhārayati) kanyārūpo vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (sakaruṇaṃ sagadgadamiva)samaravijayatthaṃ pautye aghcau(ityarghoktte salajjamiva sagadgadam) duve tiṇṇi muṭṭuttāiṃ paḍivālaissaṃ | puṇo edaṃ ṇiruvauttaṃ taṇuṃ pāvaasamāgaṃmi pariccaissaṃ | valiḥ -- (sasanbhramam.)subhru! ka idānīṃ śophāvasaraḥ? āgataprāyo'ham| (iti tvaritapadaṃ niṣtrkamati) strīrūpo vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagadaṃ saharpam) siddhaṃ samīhitena mahāpratyūheneva ganamanena | tadalamihasthitena | tadevaṃ tāvat | (praphāśaṃ salajjamiva) piasahi! karehi hatye edaṃ amaabhāaṇaṃ | ṇiuṇiā khu tumaṃ | ṇahu kahavi tumāhinto edaṃ patrbhaṭṭhaṃ bhodi | puṇovi tae edaṃ āṇidaṃ | (vainaneyastayā karoti) śukraḥ -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) āḥ! parakare bhavati poyūpaṃ viśaṅkate ca mamātmā tatkimatra karavai | bhavatu kimanena valereva durvilasinamidam | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svagatam) alamidānīṃ vilamvena!(anusmṛtya) | vidravāya pāvakamānayāmi | (iti pāvakasmaraṇamabhinayati) śukraḥ -- (samantādacalokya sasambhramam) āḥ kimatet? viśālajvālābhiḥ kavacayati dikūcakramacirānmahādhūmastomairjanayati nabhaḥ pīvarataram | atikkāthādūrddha taralayati ca kṣīrajaladhiṃ vinā kalpāpāyaṃ prasaratitarāṃ ko'yamanalaḥ? || 13 || api ca dhūmastomakadarthanādigha gataṃ kutrāpi tigmatvipā tatkṛtyaḥ kripate tūdepa śikhinā śaśvatprakāśaḥ svayam | jvālājālaparamparābhiranilavyādhūṇiṃnābhircalādbhūyo viśvamidaṃ hiraṇmayamahāvrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍāyate || 14 || tatkimatrocitam? | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- piasahi ṇiuṇie! | pātthi tassa suhaassa bhaiṃ | tā ehi jalaṇapasaṃgeṇa attāṇaṃ kaatthaṃ karemha | (ubhācutiṣṭataḥ) śukraḥ -- (svagataṃ sāśaṅkam) aho'syāḥ pūrvānurāga eva maraṇāntaṃ prema | gṛhītāmṛtaiva caipā pāvakapraveśamārabhate | taddvayamapi na mayā parirakṣinam | bhavatu vārayāmi | (prakāśam) ayi kalyāṇi! kimakalyāṇamidamakasmādārabhyate?! pratipālaya katicinmuhrarttān | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (savipādaṃ salañcamitra) aghya! kiṃ aṇaypocidaṃ mantesi! evaṃ yyeva tassi tuddasisse vaddharāgāe maha ucidaṃ bhodi | śukraḥ -- ayi mugghe! tavāmṛtasya ca rakṣāyai tvatsamakṣameva dānavekṣvareṇābhyardhito'smi | tadyadei vāryamāṇā na nivarttase tadgnistambhamapi karipye | vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (svayatam) haste gataṃ tāvadamṛnaṃ saṃvṛttam | tadidānīmasyāpi paśyāmi kautukam | (prakāśam) kareṃdu ajñlo jaṃ ucidaṃ bhodi | śukraḥ -- (agnistambhamantrābhinayaṃ kṛtvā sāścaryam) ahaha! | viśālaphālaiḥ prasabhaṃ prasarppannagragrato impati tīvratejāḥ | na manyate mantramayaṃ prayogaṃ vīravratāviṣṭa ivaipa vahniḥ || 14 || (vimṛśya) api lapasamayotthe vītihotre prayuktā nahi nahi vimukhīsyādbhārgavī mantraśaktiḥ | satatamasuravaṃśadhvaṃsavaddhāvadhānaḥ kkacidapi tadihāsti phrodhanaḥ kaiṭabhāriḥ || 15 || tannirūpayāmi dhyānena | (dhyānābhinayaṃ kṛtvā svagatam) ahaha!! murārirayaṃ mahilārūpastatsampravṛttasnāvadanarthaḥ | kimadyāpi bhayena? | (prakāśaṃ sagaryopahāsam) vaikuṇṭha! vaikuṇṭha | dhigdhigsudhāṃ vārddhiviloṭanotthāṃ ghigghiph ca tahurlabhavastujātam | kinnāma nāptaṃ danujapravīrairvaikuṇṭha! yattvaṃ mahilīkṛno'si || 16 || vaikuṇṭhaḥ -- (sopadāsaṃ maddilārūpaṃ parityajya) bhārgava! tcameva nayamārge nipuṇāḥ | kimitthaṃ vyāharasi? | vainateyaḥ -- (srīrūpaṃ parityajya sopahāsam) daityācārya! sāghayāmasnāvat | tvamapi gatvā daityaiḥ sahāgrāsanībhavāmṛtaprāśanamahotsave | (iti nipkāntā sarve) dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ (tataḥ praviśati kṛṣṇo lakṣmīśca) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (lakṣmīṃ vibhāvya svagataṃ saharpotphaṇṭham) nṛnamodṛgvidhastrosargaśilpe vaideśika eva vedhāḥ | tathāhi indoḥ kalāstridaśapādapapallavāni pīyūpamujjvalaruco maṇayaśca te te | yasyādbhutopakaraṇāvaliritthamasti sruṣṭuṃ sa e̱va bhavati̱ prabhruravghṛirenām || 1 || (sakhedum) kiṃ punarimāṃ vipādavaśaṃvadāmica cibhāvayāmi? | (vimṛśya) nūmamasyāḥ pāṇigrahaṇasamayāsattimākarṇya kanyābhāvasulabhamāvirbhavati vaimanasyam | bhavatu samvodhayāmi | (prakāśam) muñca priye! pitṛviyogabhayākulatvaṃ metre niyantrayasi kiṃ caraṇāṅgulīpu | tvatsaumanasyasukhasañcapanaikanānaḥ sthāspāmi subhru! jalajantuvadantaravgheḥ || 2 || lakṣmīḥ -- (svagataṃ saddarpam) evaṃpi bhodi, ādu āsāsedi maṃ suhao? | (prakārśaṃ sabāppagadradam) kudo edaṃ mahaṇaveaṇādo pahudi daṃsaṇamettapi maha dullaiṃ devadārūvassa tādassa edaṃyyeva tava rūvaṃ paaḍaṃ pecchāmi | kṛṣṇaṃḥ -- api sutanu! pratyāsannameva tava tātadarśanam | nanu prabhuṇā pinākinā prajāpatipramukhatridaśairapi lobhavaśavihitānaucityairaparādhīnamivātmānamāśaṅkamānairbhagavantamambhodhimānetuṃ varuṇaḥ prepito'sti | gāmbhīryāvadheśca tava tātasya mandarāvarttamātreṇa kā vedanā? | mathanārjitadravyajātādapi yadyadyasya mahodadhidasyati tattasya bhaviṣyati | tatsamākṣvasītu bhavatī | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (vibhāvya svagatam) aho saṅkaṭaṃ kanyakānām | (lakṣmīḥ samāśvarsya sakaruṇasnehaṃ sāgaramamalokate) jñātivikṣlepavaikkṛvyātpriyalābhamahotsavāt | muhurjvalati kanyānāṃ prīyate ca muhurmanaḥ || 3 || tadeyaṃ tāvat | (prakāśam) priye priye | ākṣlepalālasamiladvahuvīcivāhuḥ kāraṇḍavakaṇinakalpitapeśalāsīḥ | tvāṃ draṣṭumutka iva sambhṛtanetralaśīḥ lolākṣi! rājati calattimiramyurāśiḥ || 4 || (lakṣmīḥ saharpamāste) kṛpṇaḥ -- (vāmākṣispandanaṃ sūcayitvā svagavaṃ saviṣādam) āḥ! kimadyāpi ko'pi pratyūho'sti? | (nepathye) kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭam | ahnāya lumpanniva sarvalokānākāśamāśāḥ pṛthivīṃ pidhāya | kalpāntaphālāttinaye paṭīyānvijṛmbhate ko'pi naṭo'nghakāraḥ || 5 || api ca upārjitāḥ sāgaramanthakhedācandrādayo'mī paramāḥ padāthīḥ | durcātaghāghāvidhurāḥ prasahya punaryiyāsanti payodhimadhyam || 6|| kṛpṇaḥ -- (kṣrutvā sasagbhramamucaiḥkāram) ayi dikpālāḥ! pālapataṃ pālayata muhurtta … …… …….. … … …… ……. vārttāmupalabdhuṃ prepinaḥ | ahaṃ ca pīyūpaṃ kamalāṃcaparirakṣunnasmi | iha kila rniralasā lālasannā durdaityānām | (sanirvedapedṛm) āḥ! kathaṃ so'pi śivo'satyaśiva iya saṃvṛtto yaḥ kālakṛṣṭamātrādapi dāruṇāṃ vipadamanubhavati | (tataḥ praviśāti kṛtaphapaṭakaparddipepo bhārgapaḥ) bhārgavaḥ -- (sāvegaṃ sasambhramam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇa! vilīyante mamādgani vipopmaṇā | dehi dehi tadetanme pīyūpaṃ kiṃ vilamyase? ||7 || kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagataṃ savipādam) āḥ! kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭapūrvam | ahaha! idameva durnimittaṃ yaddhoro'ndhakāro yaddāruṇaḥ samīraḥ | tatpāyayāmi pīyūpaṃ, na punarasya samīpe paśyāmi vainateyam | aho mahadidaṃ vimarśasthānam | tathāhi dahatu dahatu ghoraḥ śaṅkaraṃ kālakūṭo nahi nahi tadapi syāditthamatyākulatvam | abhinayamapi divyasyānabhijño vidhātuṃ sa hi parataratejomūrttiradhṛṣyaḥ ||8 || tannirūpayāmi dhyānena) (dhyānābhinayaṃ kṛtvā sakodham) āḥ śukra vakrayuddhe | kimidaṃ kṛtavānasi? | śaṅkaravepadharo'si dvijo'si ceti kṛnāparādho'pi na me vadhyo'si | tadgaccha yāvanna śivanayanagocaratāṃ prapadyase | (śukraḥ sabhayaṃ tiroghate) (tataḥ praviśati vainateyenānugamyamānaḥ śaṅkaraḥ) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (vilokya sapraśrayamutthāya sāphūtaṃsmitam) namo namo nipkapaṭaśaṅkarāya | ita āsyatām | śaṅkaraḥ -- (vainateyopanītamāsanamadhiṣṭāya sasmitam) kṛpṇa! kṛpṇā! keyamadbhutā tavādya viṭreopottiḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (sasmitam) kiṃ vijñapyate sarvajñāya? | śaṅkaraḥ -- (saddarṣe viddasya) kṛte pratikṛtaṃ samucitamārabdhaṃ bhārgapeṇa | tvayā hi kṛtakainaṃvakāntārūpeṇa vañcitā daityāḥ | pratyāhṛtaṃ pīyūpam kimucyate tvayaivedaṃ vicitrarūpaṃ divipatkāryanirvahaṇakoṭimāropyate | tatkiṃ cirayati vārddhimānetuṃ prepito varuṇaḥ? | kṛṣṇaḥ -- ayi vainatepa! tvamapi maheśādeśena gatvā tvaritamānaya sāgaram | vaina -- (phaticitpadāni dattvā vyāvṛtya) āyāntyamo vrahmādayo devāḥ,epa cābhpeti varuṇenānugamyamāno ratnākaraḥ | tatkimenamete pratyutthātuṃ gatāḥ? | kṛṣṇaḥ -- vainateya! nahi nahi | ete kila bhārgayotpāditamāyāndhakāradurvṛttavidravaccandrādighāraṇodvignā, nnṛnaṃ tīradeśe militāḥ samāyānti | (tataḥ praviśanti yathānirddiṣṭā trahmādayo devā varuṇenānugamyamānaḥ sāgaraśca) maheśakṛṇṇau -- (saśraymuyayū), abhivādyāvahe atrabhavantaṃ jagajjyeṣṭam | ita āsyatāṃ saha mahendrādibhiryethāyatham | sāgaraḥ -- (sapraśrayam) epa vaḥ praṇamati samudraḥ | kṛpṇaḥ -- (sagaiauravam) nipīdatu pratyāsanno'tra savamṇo bhavān | (sāgaraḥ tayā karoti) lakṣmīḥ -- (sakaruṇaṃ sāsnam) tād | kiṃ edaṃ saṃyuttaṃ? | (iti phaṇṭhe lagavi) samudraḥ -- (sapharuṇaṃ) putri putri! mā vipīd | bhadraṃ bhavipyati nirvahaṇaṃ rudraprasādena | maheśaḥ -- (apavārya) kṛpṇa kṛpṇa! na śakromi mukhamasya darśayitum | (iti savipādamadhomuratastiṣṭati) samudraḥ -- (sapraśrayam) dākṣiṇpatastrijagadīśā! kimākulo'si? paśaya prasannanayano mukhamunnamayya | śreṣṭo'si me nahi nahi pramumātrakastvaṃ manye'vamānamapi mānamahaṃ bhayattaḥ || 9 || api ca | nāhaṃ klīvo'smi na cānyena kenāpi parābhūto yadevaṃ vipīdati deyastathāhi cañcadvīcicapeṭatāḍitamukhairddaṣṭo'smi daityaiḥ phadā maināphaṃ parirakṣituṃ kuliśataḥ śakttouhamakeḥ param | samyuddho'sni mayā'ntarīryadahanagtrailokyadāhotsṛkaḥ sarge'pi pralaye'pyagvaṇdṛmahimā śambhoḥ prasādādaham || 10 || śaṅkaraḥ -- (saharpe sagauravam) kimucyate? sargasnvamaghastvayi labghajanmā sasarja saptāpi jaganti veghāḥ | sarvopajībyo'si tavopajībyo na sindhurājaḥ phacidasni kaścit || 11 || tadidaṃ gṛhāṇa dravyajātam | kṣamasva naścāpalam | samudraḥ -- (saddarpe sapraśrayam) bhagavanbharga! anugraho'yaṃ mapi kṛtaḥ | kimidānīṃ pratyarpaṇena nigrahaḥ kriyate? | śaṅkaraḥ -- tadbhavāneva svamukhena vibhajya sammānayatu devān | samudraḥ -- epa sampādyāmi devādeśam | (samantāduvalophya) vinodayantu madutsaṅgamākandaviyogavedanāṃ viriñcicadanāravindakānane susvarā vedendindirāḥ | (vedāḥ saṅkāmanti) samudraḥ -- kṛtārthayatu māṃ pramathanāthaśironepathyapadavīmāsādya suputraścandramāḥ | (candrastayā karoti) lakṣmīḥ -- (svagataṃ saviṣādam) kaṃṭhammi saṃṭhidaṃ maha jīvidaṃ | ṇa jāṇe kiṃ bhaṇissadi tādo | kṛṣṇaḥ -- (svagataṃ sotkaṇṭham) idānīṃ me sukṛtaparipākasya phalāvasaraḥ | samudraḥ -- (saharpam) ujjvālayatu matkulaṃ kamalākarakamalaparigraheṇa bhakttajanānugrahagrahilo govinduḥ | (iti lakṣmīpārṇi kṛṣṇapāṇau niveśayati) ayaṃ cāstu kanyāmahādānasya dakṣiṇākaustubho maṇiḥ | (iti kaustubhamarpayati) kṛṣṇaḥ -- (lakṣmīṃ vibhāvya svagataṃ sotkaṇṭham) ye tanau sutanormagrāḥ kandarpasya śarāṅkarāḥ | matpāṇiācumyakākṛṣṭāste'mī romāñcakaitavāt || 12 || samudraḥ -- ayaṃ ca nipkandayatu dudonrodetyakulakamalakānanaṃ devarājādhyāsanopabṛṃhitastuṃragarājoccaiḥśravasahacaraḥ kumbhīndraḥ | (airāvataḥ sahoñcaiḥkṣrayasā puruhūtamāśrayati) samudraḥ ete'pi sakalajagadupakṛtiparāṇāṃ mahaupadhīnāṃ ratnānāṃ cāghārataya ghanyatarā bhavantu bherumandarādayo dharādharāḥ | (aupadhayaḥ saha ratnairmerumandarādīnākṣrayanti) samudraḥ svīkuryantu kṛtadārighanidhanāni nighānāni ghanādhinātham | (nidhānāni tathā yurvanti) samudraḥ -- aṅgīkarotu sakalajagadāhlādakāriṇīṃ vāruṇīṃ kṛtāhitavināśaṃ pāśaṃ ca varuṇaḥ (varuṇastathā karoti) samudraḥ -- aṅluśaṃ mahāyudhamādāya pragalbhatāṃ ripuvaṃśaviśasane niraṅkaśo gandhavāhaḥ (vāyustathā karoti) samudraḥ -- kalayatu jagadrakṣāparāyaṇaṃ kauṇapanāyakaḥ kṛpāṇam | (nirtrkṣatistathā karoti) samudraḥ -- bhavatuca sakalajagatprāṇaśamanaḥ śamano'munā daṇḍena caṇḍataraḥ | (yamaḥ saharpamutyāyādaṇḍamādatte) samudraḥ -- vipamurarīkṛtya durddharpatarā bhavantu vāsukipramukhā ' mahoragāḥ vipamataramidaṃ ca | (vāsukiḥ saharpamutthāya vipamādatte) samudraḥ -- sarvadevamukhamuparbudhamadhitiṣṭhatu pīyūpam | etatprāśanena bhavantu nirjarā amarāḥ surāḥ | (pīyūṣaṃ vahnimāśrayati) samudraḥ -- (saharpollāsam) ayi bhagavanpīyūpamayūkhaśekhara! adya tvayā pramathanātha! kṛtaḥ kṛtārtho manthopamarddamahamutsavameva manye | dravyāṇyamūni vitarannamarārthisārthe yaddātṛtāmupagato'smi kimanyadīhe || 13 || tathāpīdamastu audāryaśauryarasikāḥ sukhayantu bhūṣāḥ sanmārgavāsitadhipo vilasantu lokāḥ | varpantu yaddhaparitopabharāḥ payodāḥ sārasvatotsavamayāḥ kavayo bhavantu || 14 || (iti niṣkāntāḥ sarve) tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ iti mahakavivatsarājaviracitaḥ samudramayanābhidhānaḥ samavakāraḥ samāptaḥ
